19063.label: Jeremiah 1:1
19063.text: These are the words of Jeremiah the son of Hil·kiʹah, one of the priests in Anʹa·thoth in the land of Benjamin.

19064.label: Jeremiah 1:2
19064.text: The word of Jehovah came to him in the days of Jo·siʹah the son of Aʹmon, the king of Judah, in the 13th year of his reign.

19065.label: Jeremiah 1:3
19065.text: It came also in the days of Je·hoiʹa·kim the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, until the completion of the 11th year of Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, until Jerusalem went into exile in the fifth month.

19066.label: Jeremiah 1:4
19066.text: The word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

19067.label: Jeremiah 1:5
19067.text: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, And before you were born I sanctified you. I made you a prophet to the nations.”

19068.label: Jeremiah 1:6
19068.text: But I said: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! I do not know how to speak, for I am just a boy.”

19069.label: Jeremiah 1:7
19069.text: Jehovah then said to me: “Do not say, ‘I am just a boy.’ For you must go to all those to whom I send you,And you should say everything that I command you.

19070.label: Jeremiah 1:8
19070.text: Do not be afraid because of their appearance, For ‘I am with you to save you,’ declares Jehovah.”

19071.label: Jeremiah 1:9
19071.text: Then Jehovah stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. And Jehovah said to me: “I have put my words in your mouth.

19072.label: Jeremiah 1:10
19072.text: See, I have commissioned you this day to be over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to pull down, to destroy and to tear down, to build and to plant.”

19073.label: Jeremiah 1:11
19073.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying: “What do you see, Jeremiah?” So I said: “I see the branch of an almond tree.”

19074.label: Jeremiah 1:12
19074.text: Jehovah said to me: “You have seen correctly, for I am wide awake concerning my word to carry it out.”

19075.label: Jeremiah 1:13
19075.text: The word of Jehovah came to me a second time, saying: “What do you see?” So I said: “I see a boiling pot, and its mouth is tilted away from the north.”

19076.label: Jeremiah 1:14
19076.text: Then Jehovah said to me: “Out of the north the calamity will break looseAgainst all the inhabitants of the land.

19077.label: Jeremiah 1:15
19077.text: For ‘I am summoning all the families of the kingdoms of the north,’ declares Jehovah, ‘And they will come; each one will set up his throneAt the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, Against her walls all aroundAnd against all the cities of Judah.

19078.label: Jeremiah 1:16
19078.text: And I will declare my judgments against them over all their wickedness,Because they have abandoned me, And they are making sacrificial smoke to other gods And bowing down to the works of their own hands.’

19079.label: Jeremiah 1:17
19079.text: But you should prepare for action, And you must stand up and tell them everything that I command you. Do not be terrified of them, So that I do not terrify you before them.

19080.label: Jeremiah 1:18
19080.text: For today I have made you a fortified city,An iron pillar, and copper walls against all the land, Toward the kings of Judah and her princes,Toward her priests and the people of the land.

19081.label: Jeremiah 1:19
19081.text: And they will certainly fight against you,But they will not prevail against you, For ‘I am with you,’ declares Jehovah, ‘to save you.’”

19082.label: Jeremiah 2:1
19082.text: The word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

19083.label: Jeremiah 2:2
19083.text: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “I well remember the devotion of your youth, The love you showed when you were engaged to marry, How you followed me in the wilderness,In a land not sown with seed.

19084.label: Jeremiah 2:3
19084.text: Israel was holy to Jehovah, the firstfruits of his harvest.”’ ‘Anyone devouring him would become guilty. Disaster would come upon them,’ declares Jehovah.”

19085.label: Jeremiah 2:4
19085.text: Hear the word of Jehovah, O house of Jacob,And all you families of the house of Israel.

19086.label: Jeremiah 2:5
19086.text: This is what Jehovah says: “What fault did your forefathers find in me, So that they strayed so far from me,And they walked after worthless idols and became worthless themselves?

19087.label: Jeremiah 2:6
19087.text: They did not ask, ‘Where is Jehovah,The One who brought us out of the land of Egypt, Who led us through the wilderness,Through a land of deserts and pits,Through a land of drought and of deep shadow,Through a land where no man travelsAnd where no humans dwell?’

19088.label: Jeremiah 2:7
19088.text: I then brought you to a land of orchards,To eat its fruitage and its good things. But you came in and defiled my land;You made my inheritance something detestable.

19089.label: Jeremiah 2:8
19089.text: The priests did not ask, ‘Where is Jehovah?’ Those handling the Law did not know me,The shepherds rebelled against me, The prophets prophesied by Baʹal, And they followed those who could bring no benefit.

19090.label: Jeremiah 2:9
19090.text: ‘So I will contend further with you,’ declares Jehovah,‘And I will contend with the sons of your sons.’

19091.label: Jeremiah 2:10
19091.text: ‘But cross over to the coastlands of the Kitʹtim and see. Yes, send to Keʹdar and consider carefully;See whether anything like this has happened.

19092.label: Jeremiah 2:11
19092.text: Has a nation ever changed its gods for those that are not gods? But my own people have exchanged my glory for what is useless.

19093.label: Jeremiah 2:12
19093.text: Stare in amazement at this, you heavens;Shudder in absolute horror,’ declares Jehovah,

19094.label: Jeremiah 2:13
19094.text: ‘Because my people have done two bad things: They have abandoned me, the source of living water, And dug for themselves cisterns,Broken cisterns, that cannot hold water.’

19095.label: Jeremiah 2:14
19095.text: ‘Is Israel a servant or a slave born in the household? Then why has he been given over to plunder?

19096.label: Jeremiah 2:15
19096.text: Against him young lions roar; They have raised their voice. They made his land an object of horror. His cities have been set on fire, so that there is no inhabitant.

19097.label: Jeremiah 2:16
19097.text: The people of Noph and Tahʹpan·es feed on the crown of your head.

19098.label: Jeremiah 2:17
19098.text: Have you not brought this on yourselfBy abandoning Jehovah your God While he was leading you in the way?

19099.label: Jeremiah 2:18
19099.text: Now why do you wish for the way to Egypt To drink the waters of Shiʹhor? Why do you wish for the way to As·syrʹi·a To drink the waters of the River?

19100.label: Jeremiah 2:19
19100.text: Your wickedness should correct you,And your own unfaithfulness should reprove you. Know and realize how bad and bitter it is To abandon Jehovah your God;You have shown no fear of me,’ declares the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies.

19101.label: Jeremiah 2:20
19101.text: ‘For long ago I smashed your yoke And tore off your shackles. But you said: “I am not going to serve,” For on every high hill and under every luxuriant tree You were lying sprawled out, prostituting yourself.

19102.label: Jeremiah 2:21
19102.text: I planted you as a choice red vine, all of it pure seed;So how have you turned into the degenerate shoots of a foreign vine before me?’

19103.label: Jeremiah 2:22
19103.text: ‘Though you should wash with soda and use much lye, Your guilt would still be a stain before me,’ declares the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

19104.label: Jeremiah 2:23
19104.text: How can you say, ‘I have not defiled myself. I have not followed the Baʹals’? Look at your way in the valley. Consider what you have done. You are like a swift, young she-camel,Aimlessly running back and forth in her ways,

19105.label: Jeremiah 2:24
19105.text: A wild donkey accustomed to the wilderness,Sniffing the wind in her lust. Who can restrain her when she is in heat? None of those looking for her will need to weary themselves. In her season they will find her.

19106.label: Jeremiah 2:25
19106.text: Keep your feet from going bareAnd your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is hopeless! No! I have fallen in love with strangers, And I will follow them.’

19107.label: Jeremiah 2:26
19107.text: Like the shame of a thief when he is caught,So the house of Israel has been put to shame,They, their kings and their princes,Their priests and their prophets.

19108.label: Jeremiah 2:27
19108.text: They say to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ And to a stone, ‘You gave birth to me.’ But to me they turn their back and not their face. And in the time of their calamity they will say,‘Rise up and save us!’

19109.label: Jeremiah 2:28
19109.text: Now where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them rise up if they can save you in your time of calamity,For your gods have become as numerous as your cities, O Judah.

19110.label: Jeremiah 2:29
19110.text: ‘Why do you keep contending against me? Why have all of you rebelled against me?’ declares Jehovah.

19111.label: Jeremiah 2:30
19111.text: I have struck your sons in vain. They would accept no discipline; Your own sword devoured your prophets, Like a marauding lion.

19112.label: Jeremiah 2:31
19112.text: O generation, consider for yourselves the word of Jehovah. Have I become like a wilderness to IsraelOr a land of oppressive darkness? Why have these, my people, said, ‘We roam freely. We will come to you no more’?

19113.label: Jeremiah 2:32
19113.text: Can a virgin forget her ornaments,A bride her breastbands? And yet my own people have forgotten me for countless days.

19114.label: Jeremiah 2:33
19114.text: How skillfully, O woman, you set your course to seek love! You have trained yourself in the ways of wickedness.

19115.label: Jeremiah 2:34
19115.text: Even your skirts are stained with the blood of the innocent poor ones, Though I did not find them in the act of breaking in;It is on all your skirts.

19116.label: Jeremiah 2:35
19116.text: But you say, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned back from me.’ Now I am bringing judgment against youBecause you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

19117.label: Jeremiah 2:36
19117.text: Why do you treat so lightly your unstable course? You will become ashamed of Egypt too, Just as you became ashamed of As·syrʹi·a.

19118.label: Jeremiah 2:37
19118.text: For this reason also you will go out with your hands on your head, For Jehovah has rejected those in whom you put confidence;They will not bring you success.”

19119.label: Jeremiah 3:1
19119.text: People ask: “If a man sends his wife away and she leaves him and becomes another man’s, should he return to her anymore?” Has that land not been utterly polluted? “You have committed prostitution with many companions, And should you now return to me?” declares Jehovah.

19120.label: Jeremiah 3:2
19120.text: “Raise your eyes to the bare hills and see. Where have you not been raped? You sat along the roadways for them,Like a nomad in the wilderness. You keep polluting the landWith your prostitution and your wickedness.

19121.label: Jeremiah 3:3
19121.text: So showers of rain are withheld, And there is no rain in the spring. You have the brazen look of a wife who commits prostitution;You refuse to feel shame.

19122.label: Jeremiah 3:4
19122.text: But now you call out to me,‘My Father, you are the companion of my youth!

19123.label: Jeremiah 3:5
19123.text: Should one stay resentful forever,Or always hold a grudge?’ This is what you say,But you keep doing all the evil you are capable of doing.”

19124.label: Jeremiah 3:6
19124.text: In the days of King Jo·siʹah, Jehovah said to me: “‘Have you seen what unfaithful Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and underneath every luxuriant tree to commit prostitution.

19125.label: Jeremiah 3:7
19125.text: Even after she did all these things, I kept telling her to return to me, but she did not return; and Judah kept watching her treacherous sister.

19126.label: Jeremiah 3:8
19126.text: When I saw that, I sent unfaithful Israel away with a full certificate of divorce because of her adultery. But her treacherous sister Judah did not become afraid; she too went out and committed prostitution.

19127.label: Jeremiah 3:9
19127.text: She took her prostitution lightly, and she kept polluting the land and committing adultery with stones and with trees.

19128.label: Jeremiah 3:10
19128.text: Despite all this, her treacherous sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, only in pretense,’ declares Jehovah.”

19129.label: Jeremiah 3:11
19129.text: Jehovah then said to me: “Unfaithful Israel has shown herself to be more righteous than treacherous Judah.

19130.label: Jeremiah 3:12
19130.text: Go and proclaim these words to the north: “‘“Return, O renegade Israel,” declares Jehovah.’ ‘“I will not look down angrily on you, for I am loyal,” declares Jehovah.’ ‘“I will not stay resentful forever.

19131.label: Jeremiah 3:13
19131.text: Only acknowledge your guilt, for you have rebelled against Jehovah your God. You continued scattering your favors to strangers under every luxuriant tree, but you would not obey my voice,” declares Jehovah.’”

19132.label: Jeremiah 3:14
19132.text: “Return, you renegade sons,” declares Jehovah. “For I have become your true master; and I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

19133.label: Jeremiah 3:15
19133.text: And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, and they will feed you with knowledge and insight.

19134.label: Jeremiah 3:16
19134.text: You will become many and will bear fruit in the land in those days,” declares Jehovah. “No more will they say, ‘The ark of the covenant of Jehovah!’ It will not come up into the heart, nor will they remember it or miss it, and it will not be made again.

19135.label: Jeremiah 3:17
19135.text: At that time they will call Jerusalem the throne of Jehovah; and all the nations will be brought together to the name of Jehovah at Jerusalem, and they will no longer stubbornly follow their own wicked heart.”

19136.label: Jeremiah 3:18
19136.text: “In those days they will walk together, the house of Judah alongside the house of Israel, and together they will come from the land of the north into the land that I gave to your forefathers as an inheritance.

19137.label: Jeremiah 3:19
19137.text: And I thought, ‘How I placed you among the sons and gave you the desirable land, the most beautiful inheritance among the nations!’ I also thought that you would call me, ‘My Father!’ and that you would not turn away from following me.

19138.label: Jeremiah 3:20
19138.text: ‘Truly as a wife treacherously leaves her husband, so also you, O house of Israel, have dealt treacherously with me,’ declares Jehovah.”

19139.label: Jeremiah 3:21
19139.text: On the bare hills a sound is heard,The weeping and the pleading of the people of Israel,For they have distorted their way;They have forgotten Jehovah their God.

19140.label: Jeremiah 3:22
19140.text: “Return, you renegade sons. I will heal your renegade condition.” “Here we are! We have come to you,For you, O Jehovah, are our God.

19141.label: Jeremiah 3:23
19141.text: Truly the hills and the turmoil on the mountains are a delusion. Truly in Jehovah our God is the salvation of Israel.

19142.label: Jeremiah 3:24
19142.text: But the shameful thing has consumed the toil of our forefathers since our youth, Their flocks and their herds,Their sons and their daughters.

19143.label: Jeremiah 3:25
19143.text: Let us lie down in our shame,And let our disgrace cover us,For we have sinned against Jehovah our God, We and our fathers since our youth until this day, And we have not obeyed the voice of Jehovah our God.”

19144.label: Jeremiah 4:1
19144.text: “If you will return, O Israel,” declares Jehovah,“If you will return to meAnd if you will remove your disgusting idols from before me,Then you will not be a fugitive.

19145.label: Jeremiah 4:2
19145.text: And if you swear,‘As surely as Jehovah is alive!’ in truth, justice, and righteousness,Then the nations will obtain a blessing for themselves by him,And in him they will boast.”

19146.label: Jeremiah 4:3
19146.text: For this is what Jehovah says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: “Plow for yourselves arable land,And do not keep sowing among thorns.

19147.label: Jeremiah 4:4
19147.text: Circumcise yourselves to Jehovah,And remove the foreskins of your hearts, You men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem,So that my wrath may not blaze up like a fireAnd burn with no one to extinguish it,Because of your evil deeds.”

19148.label: Jeremiah 4:5
19148.text: Declare it in Judah, and proclaim it in Jerusalem. Shout and blow a horn throughout the land. Call out loudly and say: “Gather together,And let us flee into the fortified cities.

19149.label: Jeremiah 4:6
19149.text: Raise a signal toward Zion. Seek shelter, and do not stand still,” For I am bringing in calamity from the north, a great crash.

19150.label: Jeremiah 4:7
19150.text: He has emerged like a lion from his thicket; The destroyer of nations has set out. He has gone out from his place to make your land an object of horror. Your cities will be reduced to ruins, without an inhabitant.

19151.label: Jeremiah 4:8
19151.text: Therefore, put on sackcloth, Mourn and wail,Because the burning anger of Jehovah has not turned away from us.

19152.label: Jeremiah 4:9
19152.text: “In that day,” declares Jehovah, “the heart of the king will fail him, Also the heart of the princes;The priests will be horrified, and the prophets will be amazed.”

19153.label: Jeremiah 4:10
19153.text: Then I said: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Truly you have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace,’ when the sword is at our throats.”

19154.label: Jeremiah 4:11
19154.text: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem: “A scorching wind from the barren hills of the desertWill sweep down on the daughter of my people;It is not coming to winnow or to cleanse.

19155.label: Jeremiah 4:12
19155.text: The full wind comes from these places at my bidding. Now I will pronounce judgments against them.

19156.label: Jeremiah 4:13
19156.text: Look! He will come like rain clouds,And his chariots are like a storm wind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are ruined!

19157.label: Jeremiah 4:14
19157.text: Wash your heart clean of wickedness, O Jerusalem, in order to be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts?

19158.label: Jeremiah 4:15
19158.text: For a voice tells the news from Dan, And it proclaims disaster from the mountains of Eʹphra·im.

19159.label: Jeremiah 4:16
19159.text: Report it, yes, to the nations;Proclaim it against Jerusalem.” “Sentinels are coming from a distant land,And they will raise their voices against the cities of Judah.

19160.label: Jeremiah 4:17
19160.text: They come against her on all sides like guards of the open field, Because she has rebelled against me,” declares Jehovah.

19161.label: Jeremiah 4:18
19161.text: “Your own ways and your actions will be brought upon you. How bitter is your disaster,For it reaches clear to your heart!”

19162.label: Jeremiah 4:19
19162.text: O my anguish, my anguish! I feel great pain in my very heart. My heart pounds within me. I cannot keep silent,For I have heard the sound of the horn,The alarm signal of war.

19163.label: Jeremiah 4:20
19163.text: Disaster after disaster has been reported,For the whole land has been destroyed. Suddenly my own tents are destroyed,In a moment my tent cloths.

19164.label: Jeremiah 4:21
19164.text: How long will I keep seeing the signal, Keep hearing the sound of the horn?

19165.label: Jeremiah 4:22
19165.text: “For my people are foolish; They take no note of me. They are stupid sons, with no understanding. They are clever enough when it comes to doing bad,But they do not know how to do good.”

19166.label: Jeremiah 4:23
19166.text: I saw the land, and look! it was empty and desolate. I looked at the heavens, and their light was no more.

19167.label: Jeremiah 4:24
19167.text: I saw the mountains, and look! they were quaking,And the hills were shaking.

19168.label: Jeremiah 4:25
19168.text: I saw, and look! there was no man,And the birds of the heavens had all fled.

19169.label: Jeremiah 4:26
19169.text: I saw, and look! the orchard had become a wilderness,And its cities had all been torn down. It was because of Jehovah,Because of his burning anger.

19170.label: Jeremiah 4:27
19170.text: For this is what Jehovah says: “The whole land will become desolate, But I will not carry out a complete extermination.

19171.label: Jeremiah 4:28
19171.text: For this reason the land will mourn, And the heavens above will become dark. It is because I have spoken, I have decided,And I will not change my mind, nor will I turn back from it.

19172.label: Jeremiah 4:29
19172.text: At the sound of the horsemen and the archers,The entire city flees. They enter into the thickets,And they climb the rocks. Every city is abandoned,And no man dwells in them.”

19173.label: Jeremiah 4:30
19173.text: Now that you are devastated, what will you do? You used to clothe yourself with scarlet,To deck yourself with gold ornaments,And to enlarge your eyes with black paint. But it is in vain that you beautified yourself, For those lusting after you have rejected you;They are now seeking to take your life.

19174.label: Jeremiah 4:31
19174.text: For I have heard the sound like that of a sick woman,The distress like that of a woman giving birth to her first child,The voice of the daughter of Zion who keeps gasping for breath. She says as she spreads out her palms: “Woe to me, for I am exhausted because of the killers!”

19175.label: Jeremiah 5:1
19175.text: Roam the streets of Jerusalem. Look around and take note. Search her public squares to seeWhether you can find a man who acts with justice, One who seeks to be faithful,And I will forgive her.

19176.label: Jeremiah 5:2
19176.text: Even if they say: “As surely as Jehovah is alive!” They would still swear to what is false.

19177.label: Jeremiah 5:3
19177.text: O Jehovah, do your eyes not look for faithfulness? You struck them, but it made no impact on them. You exterminated them, but they refused to accept discipline. They made their faces harder than a rock, And they refused to turn around.

19178.label: Jeremiah 5:4
19178.text: But I said to myself: “Surely these must be the lowly. They act foolishly, for they do not know the way of Jehovah,The judgment of their God.

19179.label: Jeremiah 5:5
19179.text: I will go to the prominent men and speak with them,For they must have taken note of the way of Jehovah,The judgment of their God. But they had all broken the yokeAnd torn apart the restraints.”

19180.label: Jeremiah 5:6
19180.text: That is why a lion of the forest attacks them,A wolf of the desert plains keeps ravaging them,A leopard lies awake at their cities. Everyone going out from them is torn to pieces. For their transgressions are many;Their acts of unfaithfulness are numerous.

19181.label: Jeremiah 5:7
19181.text: How can I forgive you for this? Your sons have abandoned me,And they swear by what is no God. I satisfied their needs,But they kept committing adultery,And they flocked to the house of a prostitute.

19182.label: Jeremiah 5:8
19182.text: They are like eager, lustful horses,Each neighing after another man’s wife.

19183.label: Jeremiah 5:9
19183.text: “Should I not call them to account for these things?” declares Jehovah. “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation?”

19184.label: Jeremiah 5:10
19184.text: “Come up against her vineyard terraces and bring ruin,But do not make a complete extermination. Take away her spreading shoots,For they do not belong to Jehovah.

19185.label: Jeremiah 5:11
19185.text: For the house of Israel and the house of JudahHave been utterly treacherous with me,” declares Jehovah.

19186.label: Jeremiah 5:12
19186.text: “They have denied Jehovah, and they keep saying,‘He will do nothing. No calamity will come upon us;We will not see sword or famine.’

19187.label: Jeremiah 5:13
19187.text: The prophets are full of wind,And the word is not in them. Let this happen to them!”

19188.label: Jeremiah 5:14
19188.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah, the God of armies, says: “Because these men are saying this,Here I am making my words a fire in your mouth, And this people is the wood,And it will consume them.”

19189.label: Jeremiah 5:15
19189.text: “Here I am bringing in on you a nation from far away, O house of Israel,” declares Jehovah. “It is an enduring nation. It is an ancient nation,A nation whose language you do not know,And whose speech you cannot understand.

19190.label: Jeremiah 5:16
19190.text: Their quiver is like an open grave;All of them are warriors.

19191.label: Jeremiah 5:17
19191.text: They will devour your harvest and your bread. They will devour your sons and your daughters. They will devour your flocks and your herds. They will devour your vines and your fig trees. They will destroy with the sword your fortified cities in which you trust.”

19192.label: Jeremiah 5:18
19192.text: “But even in those days,” declares Jehovah, “I will not carry out a complete extermination of you.

19193.label: Jeremiah 5:19
19193.text: And when they ask, ‘Why has Jehovah our God done all these things to us?’ you should answer them, ‘Just as you abandoned me to serve a foreign god in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land that is not yours.’”

19194.label: Jeremiah 5:20
19194.text: Declare this in the house of Jacob,And proclaim it in Judah, saying:

19195.label: Jeremiah 5:21
19195.text: “Hear this, you foolish and senseless people: They have eyes but cannot see; They have ears but cannot hear.

19196.label: Jeremiah 5:22
19196.text: ‘Do you not fear me?’ declares Jehovah,‘Should you not tremble before me? It is I who placed the sand as the boundary for the sea,A permanent regulation that it cannot pass over. Although its waves toss, they cannot prevail;Although they roar, they still cannot pass beyond it.

19197.label: Jeremiah 5:23
19197.text: But this people has a stubborn and rebellious heart;They have turned aside and gone their own way.

19198.label: Jeremiah 5:24
19198.text: And they do not say in their heart: “Let us now fear Jehovah our God,The One who gives the rain in its season,Both the autumn rain and the spring rain,The One who guards for us the appointed weeks of the harvest.”

19199.label: Jeremiah 5:25
19199.text: Your own errors have prevented these things from coming;Your own sins have deprived you of what is good.

19200.label: Jeremiah 5:26
19200.text: For among my people there are wicked men. They keep peering, as when birdcatchers crouch down. They set a deadly trap. It is men whom they catch.

19201.label: Jeremiah 5:27
19201.text: Like a cage full of birds,So their houses are full of deception. That is why they have become powerful and rich.

19202.label: Jeremiah 5:28
19202.text: They have grown fat and smooth;They overflow with evil. They do not plead the legal case of the fatherless, That they may gain success;And they deny justice to the poor.’”

19203.label: Jeremiah 5:29
19203.text: “Should I not call them to account for these things?” declares Jehovah. “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation?

19204.label: Jeremiah 5:30
19204.text: Something appalling and horrible has occurred in the land:

19205.label: Jeremiah 5:31
19205.text: The prophets prophesy lies, And the priests dominate by their own authority. And my own people love it that way. But what will you do when the end comes?”

19206.label: Jeremiah 6:1
19206.text: Take shelter, O sons of Benjamin, away from Jerusalem. Blow the horn in Te·koʹa; Light a fire signal over Beth-hac·cheʹrem! For a calamity looms from the north, a great disaster.

19207.label: Jeremiah 6:2
19207.text: The daughter of Zion resembles a beautiful and delicate woman.

19208.label: Jeremiah 6:3
19208.text: The shepherds and their droves will come. They will pitch their tents all around her, Each grazing the flock in his care.

19209.label: Jeremiah 6:4
19209.text: “Prepare for war against her! Rise up, and let us attack her at midday!” “Woe to us, for the day is declining,For the shadows of evening are getting longer!”

19210.label: Jeremiah 6:5
19210.text: “Rise up, and let us attack during the nightAnd destroy her fortified towers.”

19211.label: Jeremiah 6:6
19211.text: For this is what Jehovah of armies says: “Cut down wood and raise up a siege rampart against Jerusalem. She is the city that must be held to account;There is nothing but oppression within her.

19212.label: Jeremiah 6:7
19212.text: As a cistern keeps its water cool, So she keeps her wickedness cool. Violence and destruction are heard in her; Sickness and plague are constantly before me.

19213.label: Jeremiah 6:8
19213.text: Be warned, O Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you in disgust; I will make you desolate, a land without inhabitants.”

19214.label: Jeremiah 6:9
19214.text: This is what Jehovah of armies says: “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as the last grapes on a vine. Pass your hand again like one gathering grapes from the vines.”

19215.label: Jeremiah 6:10
19215.text: “To whom should I speak and give warning? Who will listen? Look! Their ears are closed, so that they are unable to pay attention. Look! The word of Jehovah has become something they scorn; They find no pleasure in it.

19216.label: Jeremiah 6:11
19216.text: So I am filled with the wrath of Jehovah,And I am tired of holding it in.” “Pour it out on the child in the street, On the groups of young men gathered together. They will all be captured, a man along with his wife,The old men along with the very old.

19217.label: Jeremiah 6:12
19217.text: Their houses will be turned over to others,Together with their fields and their wives. For I will stretch my hand out against the inhabitants of the land,” declares Jehovah.

19218.label: Jeremiah 6:13
19218.text: “For from the least to the greatest, each one is making dishonest gain; From the prophet to the priest, each one is practicing fraud.

19219.label: Jeremiah 6:14
19219.text: And they try to heal the breakdown of my people lightly, saying,‘There is peace! There is peace!’ When there is no peace.

19220.label: Jeremiah 6:15
19220.text: Do they feel ashamed of the detestable things they have done? They feel no shame at all! They do not even know how to feel humiliated! So they will fall among the fallen. When I bring punishment on them they will stumble,” says Jehovah.

19221.label: Jeremiah 6:16
19221.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Stand at the crossroads and see. Ask about the ancient roadways,Ask where the good way is, and walk in it, And find rest for yourselves.” But they say: “We will not walk in it.”

19222.label: Jeremiah 6:17
19222.text: “And I appointed watchmen who said,‘Pay attention to the sound of the horn!’” But they said: “We will not pay attention.”

19223.label: Jeremiah 6:18
19223.text: “Therefore hear, O nations! And know, O assembly,What will happen to them.

19224.label: Jeremiah 6:19
19224.text: Listen, O earth! I am bringing calamity on this people As the fruitage of their own schemes,For they paid no attention to my wordsAnd they rejected my law.”

19225.label: Jeremiah 6:20
19225.text: “What do I care that you bring frankincense from SheʹbaAnd sweet cane from a distant land? Your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable,And your sacrifices do not please me.”

19226.label: Jeremiah 6:21
19226.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says: “Here I am setting for this people stumbling blocks,And they will stumble over them,Fathers and sons together,A neighbor and his companion,And they will all perish.”

19227.label: Jeremiah 6:22
19227.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Look! A people is coming from the land of the north,And a great nation will be awakened from the remotest parts of the earth.

19228.label: Jeremiah 6:23
19228.text: They will grab hold of the bow and the javelin. They are cruel and will have no mercy. Their voice will roar like the sea,And they ride on horses. They draw up in battle order like a man of war against you, O daughter of Zion.”

19229.label: Jeremiah 6:24
19229.text: We have heard the report about it. Our hands fall limp; Distress has seized us,Anguish like that of a woman giving birth.

19230.label: Jeremiah 6:25
19230.text: Do not go out into the field,And do not walk on the road,For the enemy has a sword;There is terror all around.

19231.label: Jeremiah 6:26
19231.text: O daughter of my people,Put on sackcloth and roll in the ashes. Mourn as for an only son, with bitter wailing, For suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.

19232.label: Jeremiah 6:27
19232.text: “I have made you a metal tester among my people,One making a thorough search;You must take note and examine their way.

19233.label: Jeremiah 6:28
19233.text: All of them are the most stubborn men, Walking about as slanderers. They are like copper and iron;All of them are corrupt.

19234.label: Jeremiah 6:29
19234.text: The bellows have been scorched. Out from their fire there is lead. One keeps refining intensely simply for nothing, And those who are bad have not been separated.

19235.label: Jeremiah 6:30
19235.text: Rejected silver is what people will certainly call them,For Jehovah has rejected them.”

19236.label: Jeremiah 7:1
19236.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19237.label: Jeremiah 7:2
19237.text: “Stand in the gate of the house of Jehovah and proclaim there this message, ‘Hear the word of Jehovah, all you people of Judah who enter these gates to bow down to Jehovah.

19238.label: Jeremiah 7:3
19238.text: This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “Reform your ways and your actions, and I will allow you to keep residing in this place.

19239.label: Jeremiah 7:4
19239.text: Do not put your trust in deceptive words and say, ‘This is the temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah!’

19240.label: Jeremiah 7:5
19240.text: For if you truly reform your ways and actions; if you truly uphold justice between a man and his neighbor;

19241.label: Jeremiah 7:6
19241.text: if you do not oppress foreign residents, orphans, and widows; if you do not shed innocent blood in this place; and if you do not follow other gods to your own harm;

19242.label: Jeremiah 7:7
19242.text: then I will allow you to keep residing in this place, in the land I gave to your forefathers for all time.”’”

19243.label: Jeremiah 7:8
19243.text: “But you are putting your trust in deceptive words —it will bring absolutely no benefit.

19244.label: Jeremiah 7:9
19244.text: Can you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, make sacrifices to Baʹal, and follow after gods you had not known,

19245.label: Jeremiah 7:10
19245.text: and then come and stand before me in this house that bears my name and say, ‘We will be saved,’ despite your doing all these detestable things?

19246.label: Jeremiah 7:11
19246.text: Has this house that bears my name become a cave of robbers in your eyes? Here I have seen it for myself,” declares Jehovah.

19247.label: Jeremiah 7:12
19247.text: “‘However, go now to my place in Shiʹloh, where I first caused my name to reside, and see what I did to it because of the badness of my people Israel.

19248.label: Jeremiah 7:13
19248.text: But you kept doing all these things,’ declares Jehovah, ‘and even though I spoke to you again and again, you did not listen. I kept calling you, but you would not answer.

19249.label: Jeremiah 7:14
19249.text: So I will do to the house that bears my name, in which you are trusting, and to this place that I gave to you and your forefathers, just as I did to Shiʹloh.

19250.label: Jeremiah 7:15
19250.text: I will throw you out of my sight, just as I threw out all your brothers, all the descendants of Eʹphra·im.’

19251.label: Jeremiah 7:16
19251.text: “As for you, do not pray in behalf of this people. Do not cry out or offer a prayer or plead with me in their behalf, for I will not listen to you.

19252.label: Jeremiah 7:17
19252.text: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

19253.label: Jeremiah 7:18
19253.text: The sons are gathering wood, the fathers are lighting the fire, and the wives are kneading dough in order to make sacrificial cakes to the Queen of Heaven, and they are pouring out drink offerings to other gods to offend me.

19254.label: Jeremiah 7:19
19254.text: ‘But am I the one they are hurting?’ declares Jehovah. ‘Is it not they themselves, to their own shame?’

19255.label: Jeremiah 7:20
19255.text: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says, ‘Look! My anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and the fruitage of the ground; it will burn and will not be extinguished.’

19256.label: Jeremiah 7:21
19256.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Go ahead, add your whole burnt offerings to your other sacrifices, and eat the flesh yourselves.

19257.label: Jeremiah 7:22
19257.text: For on the day I brought your forefathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not speak with them or command them concerning whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

19258.label: Jeremiah 7:23
19258.text: But I did give them this command: “Obey my voice, and I will become your God, and you will become my people. You must walk in all the way that I command, so that it may go well with you.”’

19259.label: Jeremiah 7:24
19259.text: But they did not listen or incline their ear; instead, they walked in their own schemes, stubbornly following their wicked heart, and they went backward, not forward,

19260.label: Jeremiah 7:25
19260.text: from the day your forefathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day. So I kept sending all my servants the prophets to you, sending them each day, again and again.

19261.label: Jeremiah 7:26
19261.text: But they refused to listen to me, and they did not incline their ear. Instead, they were stubborn, and they acted worse than their forefathers!

19262.label: Jeremiah 7:27
19262.text: “You will speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you; you will call to them, but they will not answer you.

19263.label: Jeremiah 7:28
19263.text: And you will say to them, ‘This is the nation that did not obey the voice of Jehovah their God and refused to accept discipline. Faithfulness has perished and is not even mentioned among them.’

19264.label: Jeremiah 7:29
19264.text: “Shear off your uncut hair and throw it away, and on the bare hills raise a dirge, for Jehovah has rejected and will abandon this generation that has infuriated him.

19265.label: Jeremiah 7:30
19265.text: ‘For the people of Judah have done what is bad in my eyes,’ declares Jehovah. ‘They have set up their disgusting idols in the house that bears my name, in order to defile it.

19266.label: Jeremiah 7:31
19266.text: They have built the high places of Toʹpheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinʹnom, in order to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, something that I had not commanded and that had never even come into my heart.’

19267.label: Jeremiah 7:32
19267.text: “‘Therefore look! the days are coming,’ declares Jehovah, ‘when it will no longer be called Toʹpheth or the Valley of the Son of Hinʹnom but the Valley of the Slaughter. They will bury in Toʹpheth until there is no place left.

19268.label: Jeremiah 7:33
19268.text: And the dead bodies of this people will become food for the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth, with no one to frighten them away.

19269.label: Jeremiah 7:34
19269.text: I will put an end to the sound of exultation and the sound of rejoicing, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will be reduced to ruins.’”

19270.label: Jeremiah 8:1
19270.text: “At that time,” declares Jehovah, “the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of its princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem will be taken from their graves.

19271.label: Jeremiah 8:2
19271.text: They will be spread out to the sun and to the moon and to all the army of the heavens that they loved and served and followed and sought after and bowed down to. They will not be gathered, nor will they be buried. They will become like manure on the surface of the ground.”

19272.label: Jeremiah 8:3
19272.text: “And the remnant of this evil family who survive will choose death over life in all the places where I disperse them,” declares Jehovah of armies.

19273.label: Jeremiah 8:4
19273.text: “And you must say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Will they fall and not get up again? If one would turn back, will the other not also turn back?

19274.label: Jeremiah 8:5
19274.text: Why is this people, Jerusalem, unfaithful with an enduring unfaithfulness? They hold fast to deception;They refuse to turn back.

19275.label: Jeremiah 8:6
19275.text: I paid attention and kept listening, but the way they spoke was not right. Not a man repented over his wickedness or asked, ‘What have I done?’ Each one keeps returning to the popular course, like a horse dashing into the battle.

19276.label: Jeremiah 8:7
19276.text: Even the stork in the sky knows its seasons; The turtledove and the swift and the thrush keep to the time of their return. But my own people do not understand the judgment of Jehovah.”’

19277.label: Jeremiah 8:8
19277.text: ‘How can you say: “We are wise, and we have the law of Jehovah”? For in fact, the lying stylus of the scribes has been used only for falsehood.

19278.label: Jeremiah 8:9
19278.text: The wise have been put to shame. They have become terrified and will be caught. Look! They have rejected the word of Jehovah,And what wisdom do they have?

19279.label: Jeremiah 8:10
19279.text: So I will give their wives to other men,Their fields to other owners; For from the least to the greatest, each one is making dishonest gain; From the prophet to the priest, each one is practicing fraud.

19280.label: Jeremiah 8:11
19280.text: And they try to heal the breakdown of the daughter of my people lightly, saying,“There is peace! There is peace!” When there is no peace.

19281.label: Jeremiah 8:12
19281.text: Do they feel ashamed of the detestable things they have done? They feel no shame at all! They do not even know how to feel humiliated! So they will fall among the fallen. When I bring punishment on them they will stumble,’ says Jehovah.

19282.label: Jeremiah 8:13
19282.text: ‘When I gather them, I will bring them to their end,’ declares Jehovah. ‘There will be no grapes left on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaves will wither. And what I gave to them will be lost to them.’”

19283.label: Jeremiah 8:14
19283.text: “Why are we sitting here? Let us gather together and enter the fortified cities and perish there. For Jehovah our God will do away with us,And he gives us poisoned water to drink, Because we have sinned against Jehovah.

19284.label: Jeremiah 8:15
19284.text: There was a hope for peace, but nothing good came,For a time of healing, but there is terror!

19285.label: Jeremiah 8:16
19285.text: From Dan is heard the snorting of his horses. At the sound of the neighing of his stallions,The whole land quakes. They come in and devour the land and everything in it,The city and its inhabitants.”

19286.label: Jeremiah 8:17
19286.text: “For here I am sending in serpents among you,Poisonous snakes that cannot be charmed,And they will certainly bite you,” declares Jehovah.

19287.label: Jeremiah 8:18
19287.text: My grief is incurable;My heart is sick.

19288.label: Jeremiah 8:19
19288.text: From a distant land there is a cry for helpFrom the daughter of my people: “Is Jehovah not in Zion? Or is her king not in her?” “Why have they offended me with their graven images,With their worthless foreign gods?”

19289.label: Jeremiah 8:20
19289.text: “The harvest has passed, the summer has ended,But we have not been saved!”

19290.label: Jeremiah 8:21
19290.text: I am shattered over the breakdown of the daughter of my people; I am dejected. Horror has seized me.

19291.label: Jeremiah 8:22
19291.text: Is there no balsam in Gilʹe·ad? Or is there no healer there? Why has the daughter of my people not been restored to health?

19292.label: Jeremiah 9:1
19292.text: O that my head were waters,My eyes a fountain of tears! Then I would weep day and nightFor the slain ones of my people.

19293.label: Jeremiah 9:2
19293.text: O that I had a traveler’s lodging place in the wilderness! Then I would leave my people and go away from them,For they are all adulterers, A band of treacherous people.

19294.label: Jeremiah 9:3
19294.text: They bend their tongue like a bow;Falsehood, not faithfulness, prevails in the land. “They advance from evil to evil,And they pay no attention to me,” declares Jehovah.

19295.label: Jeremiah 9:4
19295.text: “Everyone, be on guard against your neighbor,And do not trust even your brother. For every brother is a betrayer, And every neighbor is a slanderer.

19296.label: Jeremiah 9:5
19296.text: Each one cheats his neighbor,And no one speaks truth. They have taught their tongue to speak falsehood. They wear themselves out doing what is wrong.

19297.label: Jeremiah 9:6
19297.text: You are living in the midst of deception. In their deception they refused to know me,” declares Jehovah.

19298.label: Jeremiah 9:7
19298.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies says: “I will smelt them and test them, For what else can I do with the daughter of my people?

19299.label: Jeremiah 9:8
19299.text: Their tongue is a deadly arrow that speaks deception. With his mouth a person speaks of peace to his neighbor,But inside he lays an ambush.”

19300.label: Jeremiah 9:9
19300.text: “Should I not call them to account for these things?” declares Jehovah. “Should I not avenge myself on such a nation?

19301.label: Jeremiah 9:10
19301.text: I will weep and lament over the mountainsAnd take up a dirge over the pastures of the wilderness,For they have been burned up so that no man passes through,And the sound of livestock is not heard. The birds of heaven and the beasts have fled; they are gone.

19302.label: Jeremiah 9:11
19302.text: I will make Jerusalem piles of stones, the lair of jackals, And I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.

19303.label: Jeremiah 9:12
19303.text: Who is wise enough to understand this? To whom has the mouth of Jehovah spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished? Why is it scorched like the wilderness,So that no one is passing through?”

19304.label: Jeremiah 9:13
19304.text: Jehovah replied: “Because of their rejecting my law that I set before them, and because they have not followed it and obeyed my voice.

19305.label: Jeremiah 9:14
19305.text: Instead, they stubbornly followed their own hearts, and they followed the Baʹal images, as their fathers had taught them to do.

19306.label: Jeremiah 9:15
19306.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Here I am making this people eat wormwood, and I will make them drink poisoned water.

19307.label: Jeremiah 9:16
19307.text: I will scatter them among the nations that they and their fathers have not known, and I will send a sword after them until I will have exterminated them.’

19308.label: Jeremiah 9:17
19308.text: This is what Jehovah of armies says,‘Behave with understanding. Summon the women who sing dirges, And send for the skilled women to come,

19309.label: Jeremiah 9:18
19309.text: So that they may hurry and raise a lamentation for us,So that our eyes may stream with tearsAnd our eyelids trickle with water.

19310.label: Jeremiah 9:19
19310.text: For the sound of lamentation has been heard from Zion: “How we have been devastated! How great our shame is! For we have left the land, and they have thrown down our homes.”

19311.label: Jeremiah 9:20
19311.text: You women, hear the word of Jehovah. May your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters this lamentation,And teach one another this dirge.

19312.label: Jeremiah 9:21
19312.text: For death has come up through our windows;It has entered our fortified towersTo take away the children from the streetsAnd the young men from the public squares.’

19313.label: Jeremiah 9:22
19313.text: Say, ‘This is what Jehovah declares: “The dead bodies of people will fall like manure on the surface of the field,Like a row of newly cut grain after the reaper,With no one to gather them up.”’”

19314.label: Jeremiah 9:23
19314.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Let not the wise man boast about his wisdom; Let not the mighty man boast about his mightiness;And let not the rich man boast about his riches.”

19315.label: Jeremiah 9:24
19315.text: “But let the one boasting boast about this: That he has insight and knowledge of me, That I am Jehovah, the One showing loyal love, justice, and righteousness in the earth, For in these things I take delight,” declares Jehovah.

19316.label: Jeremiah 9:25
19316.text: “Look! Days are coming,” declares Jehovah, “and I will hold an accounting with everyone circumcised and yet uncircumcised,

19317.label: Jeremiah 9:26
19317.text: with Egypt and Judah and Eʹdom and the Amʹmon·ites and Moʹab and with all of those with hair clipped at the temples who are dwelling in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.”

19318.label: Jeremiah 10:1
19318.text: Hear the word that Jehovah has spoken against you, O house of Israel.

19319.label: Jeremiah 10:2
19319.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Do not learn the way of the nations, And do not be terrified by the signs of the heavensBecause the nations are terrified by them.

19320.label: Jeremiah 10:3
19320.text: For the customs of the peoples are a delusion. It is just a tree of the forest that is cut down,Worked by the hands of the craftsman with his tool.

19321.label: Jeremiah 10:4
19321.text: They adorn it with silver and gold And fasten it with hammer and nails so that it will not fall over.

19322.label: Jeremiah 10:5
19322.text: Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, they cannot speak; They have to be carried, for they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm,Nor can they do any good.”

19323.label: Jeremiah 10:6
19323.text: No one is like you, O Jehovah. You are great, and your name is great and mighty.

19324.label: Jeremiah 10:7
19324.text: Who should not fear you, O King of the nations, for it is fitting;Because among all the wise ones of the nations and among all their kingdoms,There is no one at all like you.

19325.label: Jeremiah 10:8
19325.text: They are all unreasoning and stupid. Instruction from a tree is an utter delusion.

19326.label: Jeremiah 10:9
19326.text: Silver plates are imported from Tarʹshish and gold from Uʹphaz,The work of a craftsman, of the hands of a metalworker. Their clothing is blue thread and purple wool. They are all made by skilled workers.

19327.label: Jeremiah 10:10
19327.text: But Jehovah is truly God. He is the living God and the eternal King. Because of his indignation the earth will quake, And no nations will endure his denunciation.

19328.label: Jeremiah 10:11
19328.text: This is what you should say to them: “The gods that did not make the heavens and the earthWill perish from the earth and from under these heavens.”

19329.label: Jeremiah 10:12
19329.text: He is the Maker of the earth by his power,The One who established the productive land by his wisdom And who stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

19330.label: Jeremiah 10:13
19330.text: When he makes his voice heard,The waters in the heavens are in turmoil, And he causes clouds to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain,And he brings the wind out of his storehouses.

19331.label: Jeremiah 10:14
19331.text: Every man acts unreasonably and without knowledge. Every metalworker will be put to shame because of the carved image; For his metal image is a falsehood,And there is no spirit in them.

19332.label: Jeremiah 10:15
19332.text: They are a delusion, a work of mockery. When their day of reckoning comes, they will perish.

19333.label: Jeremiah 10:16
19333.text: The Share of Jacob is not like these things,For he is the One who formed everything,And Israel is the staff of his inheritance. Jehovah of armies is his name.

19334.label: Jeremiah 10:17
19334.text: Gather up your bundle from the ground,O woman dwelling under siege.

19335.label: Jeremiah 10:18
19335.text: For this is what Jehovah says: “Here I am hurling the inhabitants out of the land at this time, And I will cause them to experience distress.”

19336.label: Jeremiah 10:19
19336.text: Woe to me because of my breakdown! My wound is incurable. And I said: “Surely this is my sickness, and I must bear it.

19337.label: Jeremiah 10:20
19337.text: My tent has been devastated, and my tent cords have all been torn apart. My sons have left me and are no more. There is no one left to stretch out my tent or raise up my tent cloths.

19338.label: Jeremiah 10:21
19338.text: For the shepherds have behaved senselessly, And they have not inquired of Jehovah. That is why they have not acted with insight,And all their flocks have been scattered.”

19339.label: Jeremiah 10:22
19339.text: Listen! A report! It is coming! A great pounding from the land of the north, To make the cities of Judah desolate, a lair of jackals.

19340.label: Jeremiah 10:23
19340.text: I well know, O Jehovah, that man’s way does not belong to him. It does not belong to man who is walking even to direct his step.

19341.label: Jeremiah 10:24
19341.text: Correct me, O Jehovah, with judgment,But not in your anger, that you may not reduce me to nothing.

19342.label: Jeremiah 10:25
19342.text: Pour out your wrath on the nations who ignore you And on the families who do not call on your name. For they have devoured Jacob, Yes, they have devoured him to the point of extermination, And they have desolated his homeland.

19343.label: Jeremiah 11:1
19343.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19344.label: Jeremiah 11:2
19344.text: “Hear the words of this covenant, you people! “Speak them to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem

19345.label: Jeremiah 11:3
19345.text: and say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says: “Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,

19346.label: Jeremiah 11:4
19346.text: which I commanded your forefathers on the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace, saying, ‘Obey my voice, and do all the things that I command you; and you will become my people and I will be your God,

19347.label: Jeremiah 11:5
19347.text: so that I may fulfill the oath that I swore to your forefathers, to give them the land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day.’”’” And I answered: “Amen, O Jehovah.”

19348.label: Jeremiah 11:6
19348.text: Jehovah then said to me: “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and carry them out.

19349.label: Jeremiah 11:7
19349.text: For I solemnly admonished your forefathers in the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt and to this day, admonishing them again and again: “Obey my voice.”

19350.label: Jeremiah 11:8
19350.text: But they did not listen or incline their ear; instead, each kept stubbornly following his own wicked heart. So I brought on them all the words of this covenant that I commanded them to do and that they refused to carry out.’”

19351.label: Jeremiah 11:9
19351.text: Jehovah then said to me: “There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

19352.label: Jeremiah 11:10
19352.text: They have returned to the errors of their forefathers of old, who refused to obey my words. They too have followed other gods and have served them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant that I made with their forefathers.

19353.label: Jeremiah 11:11
19353.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says, ‘Here I am bringing on them a calamity that they will not be able to escape. When they call to me for help, I will not listen to them.

19354.label: Jeremiah 11:12
19354.text: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go to the gods to which they are making sacrifices and call for help, but these will by no means save them in the time of their calamity.

19355.label: Jeremiah 11:13
19355.text: For your gods have become as many as your cities, O Judah, and you have set up as many altars to the shameful thing as there are streets in Jerusalem, altars to make sacrifices to Baʹal.’

19356.label: Jeremiah 11:14
19356.text: “As for you, do not pray in behalf of this people. Do not cry out in their behalf or offer a prayer for them, for I will not be listening when they call out to me because of their calamity.

19357.label: Jeremiah 11:15
19357.text: What right does my beloved one have to be in my houseWhen so many have carried out evil schemes? With holy flesh will they avert the calamity when it comes upon you? Will you exult at that time?

19358.label: Jeremiah 11:16
19358.text: Jehovah once called you a thriving olive tree,Beautiful with fine fruit. With a great roaring sound, he has set her on fire,And they have broken its branches.

19359.label: Jeremiah 11:17
19359.text: “Jehovah of armies, your Planter, has declared that a calamity will come upon you because of the evil committed by the house of Israel and the house of Judah, who have offended me by making sacrifices to Baʹal.”

19360.label: Jeremiah 11:18
19360.text: Jehovah informed me so that I would know;At that time you caused me to see what they were doing.

19361.label: Jeremiah 11:19
19361.text: I was like a docile lamb being brought to the slaughter. I did not know that they were scheming against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit,And let us cut him off from the land of the living,So that his name may be remembered no more.”

19362.label: Jeremiah 11:20
19362.text: But Jehovah of armies judges with righteousness;He examines the innermost thoughts and the heart. Let me see your vengeance on them,For to you I have committed my legal case.

19363.label: Jeremiah 11:21
19363.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says against the men of Anʹa·thoth who are seeking to take your life and who say: “You must not prophesy in the name of Jehovah, or you will die by our hand”;

19364.label: Jeremiah 11:22
19364.text: therefore this is what Jehovah of armies says: “Here I am going to call them to account. The young men will die by the sword, and their sons and their daughters will die by famine.

19365.label: Jeremiah 11:23
19365.text: Not even a remnant will be left of them, because I will bring calamity on the men of Anʹa·thoth in the year of their being called to account.”

19366.label: Jeremiah 12:1
19366.text: You are righteous, O Jehovah, when I make my complaint to you,When I speak about matters of justice with you. But why is the way of wicked ones successful, And why are the treacherous unworried?

19367.label: Jeremiah 12:2
19367.text: You planted them, and they have taken root. They have grown and produced fruit. You are on their lips, but far away from their innermost thoughts.

19368.label: Jeremiah 12:3
19368.text: But you know me well, O Jehovah, you see me;You have examined my heart and found it in union with you. Single them out like sheep for slaughtering,And set them apart for the day of killing.

19369.label: Jeremiah 12:4
19369.text: How much longer should the land wither awayAnd the vegetation of every field dry up? Because of the evil of those dwelling in it,The beasts and the birds have been swept away. For they have said: “He does not see what will happen to us.”

19370.label: Jeremiah 12:5
19370.text: If you get tired running with footmen,How can you run a race against horses? Even if you are confident in the land of peace,How will you fare among the dense thickets along the Jordan?

19371.label: Jeremiah 12:6
19371.text: For even your own brothers, the household of your own father,Have dealt treacherously with you. They have raised a loud cry against you. Do not put faith in them,Even if they speak good things to you.

19372.label: Jeremiah 12:7
19372.text: “I have abandoned my house; I have deserted my inheritance. I have given my dearly beloved one into the hand of her enemies.

19373.label: Jeremiah 12:8
19373.text: My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest. She has roared against me. So I have come to hate her.

19374.label: Jeremiah 12:9
19374.text: My inheritance is like a multicolored bird of prey to me;The other birds of prey surround it and attack it. Come, gather together, all you beasts of the field,Come to eat.

19375.label: Jeremiah 12:10
19375.text: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard; They have trampled my portion of land. They have turned my desirable portion of land into a desolate wilderness.

19376.label: Jeremiah 12:11
19376.text: It has become a wasteland. It has withered; It is desolate before me. The whole land has been made desolate,But no man takes it to heart.

19377.label: Jeremiah 12:12
19377.text: On all the worn paths through the wilderness the destroyers have come,For the sword of Jehovah is devouring from one end of the land to the other end. There is no peace for anyone.

19378.label: Jeremiah 12:13
19378.text: They have sown wheat, but they have reaped thorns. They have worn themselves out, but to no benefit. They will be ashamed of their produceBecause of the burning anger of Jehovah.”

19379.label: Jeremiah 12:14
19379.text: This is what Jehovah says against all my wicked neighbors, who are touching the inheritance that I caused my people Israel to possess: “Here I am uprooting them from their land, and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.

19380.label: Jeremiah 12:15
19380.text: But after I uproot them, I will again have mercy on them and bring each of them back to his inheritance and to his land.”

19381.label: Jeremiah 12:16
19381.text: “And if they make sure to learn the ways of my people and to swear by my name, ‘As surely as Jehovah is alive!’ just as they taught my people to swear by Baʹal, they will then be built up among my people.

19382.label: Jeremiah 12:17
19382.text: But if they refuse to obey, I will also uproot that nation, uprooting and destroying it,” declares Jehovah.

19383.label: Jeremiah 13:1
19383.text: This is what Jehovah told me: “Go and buy a linen belt for yourself and put it around your waist, but do not dip it in water.”

19384.label: Jeremiah 13:2
19384.text: So I bought the belt according to the word of Jehovah and put it around my waist.

19385.label: Jeremiah 13:3
19385.text: And the word of Jehovah came to me a second time:

19386.label: Jeremiah 13:4
19386.text: “Take the belt that you bought and are wearing and get up, go to the Eu·phraʹtes, and hide it there in a cleft of the crag.”

19387.label: Jeremiah 13:5
19387.text: So I went and hid it by the Eu·phraʹtes, just as Jehovah had commanded me.

19388.label: Jeremiah 13:6
19388.text: But many days later Jehovah said to me: “Get up, go to the Eu·phraʹtes, and take from there the belt that I commanded you to hide there.”

19389.label: Jeremiah 13:7
19389.text: So I went to the Eu·phraʹtes and dug up the belt and took it from the place where I had hidden it, and I saw that the belt had been ruined; it was completely useless.

19390.label: Jeremiah 13:8
19390.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to me:

19391.label: Jeremiah 13:9
19391.text: “This is what Jehovah says, ‘In the same way I will destroy the pride of Judah and the immense pride of Jerusalem.

19392.label: Jeremiah 13:10
19392.text: These evil people who refuse to obey my words, who stubbornly follow their own heart, and who are following other gods, serving and bowing down to them, will become just like this belt that is completely useless.’

19393.label: Jeremiah 13:11
19393.text: ‘For just as a belt clings to the waist of a man, so I made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to me,’ declares Jehovah, ‘to become to me a people, a name, a praise, and something beautiful. But they did not obey.’

19394.label: Jeremiah 13:12
19394.text: “And you must also give this message to them, ‘This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says: “Every large jar should be filled with wine.”’ And they will reply to you, ‘Do we not already know that every large jar should be filled with wine?’

19395.label: Jeremiah 13:13
19395.text: Then say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Here I am filling with drunkenness all the inhabitants of this land, the kings sitting on the throne of David, the priests and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

19396.label: Jeremiah 13:14
19396.text: And I will smash them against each other, fathers and sons alike,” declares Jehovah. “I will not show compassion or feel any sorrow or have any mercy on them; nothing will stop me from bringing them to ruin.”’

19397.label: Jeremiah 13:15
19397.text: Hear and pay attention. Do not be haughty, for Jehovah has spoken.

19398.label: Jeremiah 13:16
19398.text: Give glory to Jehovah your GodBefore he brings darknessAnd before your feet stumble on the mountains at dusk. You will hope for the light,But he will bring deep shadow;He will turn it into thick gloom.

19399.label: Jeremiah 13:17
19399.text: And if you refuse to listen,I will weep in secret because of your pride. I will shed many tears, and my eyes will stream with tears, Because the flock of Jehovah has been carried away captive.

19400.label: Jeremiah 13:18
19400.text: Tell the king and the queen mother, ‘Sit in a lower place,For your beautiful crown will fall from your head.’

19401.label: Jeremiah 13:19
19401.text: The cities of the south are shut, with no one to open them. All of Judah has been taken into exile, taken completely into exile.

19402.label: Jeremiah 13:20
19402.text: Raise your eyes and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock you were given, your beautiful sheep?

19403.label: Jeremiah 13:21
19403.text: What will you say when your punishment comesFrom your close friends whom you cultivated from the start? Will not birth pains seize you, like those of a woman giving birth?

19404.label: Jeremiah 13:22
19404.text: And when you say in your heart, ‘Why have these things befallen me?’ It is because of your great error that your skirts have been stripped off And your heels have been treated violently.

19405.label: Jeremiah 13:23
19405.text: Can a Cushʹite change his skin, or a leopard its spots? If so, then you can do good,You who are trained to do bad.

19406.label: Jeremiah 13:24
19406.text: So I will scatter them like straw blown by the desert wind.

19407.label: Jeremiah 13:25
19407.text: This is your lot, the portion that I have measured out to you,” declares Jehovah,“Because you have forgotten me and you trust in lies.

19408.label: Jeremiah 13:26
19408.text: Therefore, I will lift up your skirts over your face,And your shame will be seen,

19409.label: Jeremiah 13:27
19409.text: Your acts of adultery and your lustful neighing,Your obscene prostitution. On the hills, in the field,I have seen your disgusting behavior. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How much longer will you remain unclean?”

19410.label: Jeremiah 14:1
19410.text: This is the word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah concerning the droughts:

19411.label: Jeremiah 14:2
19411.text: Judah mourns, and its gates have faded away. They sink to the ground dejected,And a cry goes up from Jerusalem.

19412.label: Jeremiah 14:3
19412.text: And their masters send their servants for water. They go to the water holes and find no water. They return with their vessels empty. They are ashamed and disappointed,And they cover their heads.

19413.label: Jeremiah 14:4
19413.text: Because the ground is cracked,For there is no rain on the land, The farmers are dismayed and cover their heads.

19414.label: Jeremiah 14:5
19414.text: Even the doe in the field forsakes her newbornBecause there is no grass.

19415.label: Jeremiah 14:6
19415.text: The wild donkeys stand on the bare hills. They pant for air like jackals;Their eyes fail because there is no vegetation.

19416.label: Jeremiah 14:7
19416.text: Although our own errors testify against us,O Jehovah, act for the sake of your name. For our acts of unfaithfulness are many, And it is against you that we have sinned.

19417.label: Jeremiah 14:8
19417.text: O hope of Israel, his Savior in times of distress,Why are you like a stranger in the land,Like a traveler who stops only to spend the night?

19418.label: Jeremiah 14:9
19418.text: Why are you like a man who is stunned,Like a mighty man who cannot save? For you are among us, O Jehovah, And your name has been called on us. Do not abandon us.

19419.label: Jeremiah 14:10
19419.text: This is what Jehovah says concerning this people: “They love to wander about; they have not restrained their feet. So Jehovah finds no pleasure in them. Now he will remember their error and call them to account for their sins.”

19420.label: Jeremiah 14:11
19420.text: Then Jehovah said to me: “Do not pray for good to come to this people.

19421.label: Jeremiah 14:12
19421.text: When they fast, I do not listen to their entreaties, and when they offer whole burnt offerings and grain offerings, I take no pleasure in them, for by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence, I will do away with them.”

19422.label: Jeremiah 14:13
19422.text: At this I said: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Here the prophets are saying to them, ‘You will not see the sword, and famine will not come upon you, but I will give you true peace in this place.’”

19423.label: Jeremiah 14:14
19423.text: Jehovah then said to me: “The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I have not sent them or commanded them or spoken to them. A lying vision and a worthless divination and the deceit of their own heart is what they are prophesying to you.

19424.label: Jeremiah 14:15
19424.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says concerning the prophets who are prophesying in my name, though I did not send them, and who say that no sword or famine will occur in this land: ‘By sword and by famine those prophets will perish.

19425.label: Jeremiah 14:16
19425.text: And the people to whom they are prophesying will be cast out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword, with no one to bury them —them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters—for I will pour out on them the calamity they deserve.’

19426.label: Jeremiah 14:17
19426.text: “You must speak this word to them,‘Let my eyes stream with tears night and day, let them not cease, For the virgin daughter of my people has been completely crushed and broken, With an extremely severe wound.

19427.label: Jeremiah 14:18
19427.text: If I go out into the field and look,I see those slain by the sword! And if I come into the city,I see the diseases from the famine! For both the prophet and the priest have gone around in a land that they do not know.’”

19428.label: Jeremiah 14:19
19428.text: Have you completely rejected Judah, or have you abhorred Zion? Why have you struck us, so that there is no healing for us? There was a hope for peace, but nothing good came,For a time of healing, but there is terror!

19429.label: Jeremiah 14:20
19429.text: We acknowledge our wickedness, O Jehovah,And the error of our forefathers,For we have sinned against you.

19430.label: Jeremiah 14:21
19430.text: For the sake of your name, do not reject us; Do not despise your glorious throne. Remember, and do not break your covenant with us.

19431.label: Jeremiah 14:22
19431.text: Can any of the worthless idols of the nations give rain,Or can even the heavens send showers of rain on their own? Are you not the only One, O Jehovah our God? And we hope in you,For you alone have done all these things.

19432.label: Jeremiah 15:1
19432.text: Then Jehovah said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel were standing before me, I would show no favor toward this people. Drive them out from before me. Let them go.

19433.label: Jeremiah 15:2
19433.text: And if they say to you, ‘Where should we go?’ you must say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Whoever is for deadly plague, to deadly plague! Whoever is for the sword, to the sword! Whoever is for the famine, to the famine! And whoever is for the captivity, to the captivity!”’

19434.label: Jeremiah 15:3
19434.text: “‘And I will appoint over them four calamities,’ declares Jehovah, ‘the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth to devour and to destroy.

19435.label: Jeremiah 15:4
19435.text: And I will make them an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of Ma·nasʹseh the son of Hez·e·kiʹah, the king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.

19436.label: Jeremiah 15:5
19436.text: Who will show compassion to you, O Jerusalem,Who will sympathize with you,And who will stop to ask about your welfare?’

19437.label: Jeremiah 15:6
19437.text: ‘You have deserted me,’ declares Jehovah. ‘You keep turning your back on me. So I will stretch out my hand against you and destroy you. I am tired of feeling pity for you.

19438.label: Jeremiah 15:7
19438.text: And I will winnow them with a fork in the gates of the land. I will bereave them of children. I will destroy my people,Since they refuse to turn back from their ways.

19439.label: Jeremiah 15:8
19439.text: Their widows will become more numerous before me than the sand of the seas. I will bring a destroyer against them at midday, against mothers and young men. I will bring agitation and terror upon them suddenly.

19440.label: Jeremiah 15:9
19440.text: The woman who bore seven children has grown faint;She struggles for breath. Her sun has set while it is yet day,Causing shame and humiliation.’ ‘And those few remaining ones of themI will give to the sword before their enemies,’ declares Jehovah.”

19441.label: Jeremiah 15:10
19441.text: Woe to me, O my mother, because you gave birth to me, A man subject to quarrel and strife with all the land. I have neither loaned nor borrowed;But all of them curse me.

19442.label: Jeremiah 15:11
19442.text: Jehovah said: “I will surely minister to you for good;I will surely intercede for you in the time of calamity,In the time of distress against the enemy.

19443.label: Jeremiah 15:12
19443.text: Can anyone break iron in pieces,Iron from the north, and copper?

19444.label: Jeremiah 15:13
19444.text: Your resources and your treasures I will give as plunder, Not for a price, but because of all your sins throughout all your territories.

19445.label: Jeremiah 15:14
19445.text: I will give them to your enemiesTo take to a land you do not know. For a fire has been ignited by my anger,And it is burning against you.”

19446.label: Jeremiah 15:15
19446.text: You know, O Jehovah,Remember me and turn your attention to me. Take vengeance on my persecutors for me. Do not let me perish because of your slowness to anger. Know that for your sake I bear this reproach.

19447.label: Jeremiah 15:16
19447.text: Your words were found, and I ate them; And your word became to me the exultation and the rejoicing of my heart,For your name has been called on me, O Jehovah God of armies.

19448.label: Jeremiah 15:17
19448.text: I do not sit in the company of merrymakers and rejoice. Because your hand is upon me, I sit alone,For you have filled me with indignation.

19449.label: Jeremiah 15:18
19449.text: Why is my pain chronic and my wound incurable? It refuses to be healed. Will you become to me like a deceptive water supplyThat cannot be relied on?

19450.label: Jeremiah 15:19
19450.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says: “If you return, then I will restore you,And you will stand before me. If you separate what is precious from what is worthless,You will become like my own mouth. They will have to turn to you,But you will not turn to them.”

19451.label: Jeremiah 15:20
19451.text: “I am making you a fortified copper wall to this people. They will certainly fight against you,But they will not prevail against you, For I am with you, to save you and to rescue you,” declares Jehovah.

19452.label: Jeremiah 15:21
19452.text: “And I will rescue you from the hand of the wickedAnd redeem you from the palm of the ruthless.”

19453.label: Jeremiah 16:1
19453.text: The word of Jehovah again came to me, saying:

19454.label: Jeremiah 16:2
19454.text: “You must not take a wife for yourself, and you must not have sons and daughters in this place.

19455.label: Jeremiah 16:3
19455.text: For this is what Jehovah says concerning the sons and daughters who are born here and concerning their mothers who give birth to them and concerning their fathers who cause their birth in this land:

19456.label: Jeremiah 16:4
19456.text: ‘They will die of deadly diseases, but no one will mourn them or bury them; they will become like manure on the surface of the ground. They will perish by the sword and by famine, and their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth.’

19457.label: Jeremiah 16:5
19457.text: For this is what Jehovah says,‘Do not enter a house where a mourners’ feast is held,And do not go to wail or offer sympathy.’ ‘For I have taken away my peace from this people,’ declares Jehovah,‘As well as my loyal love and mercy.

19458.label: Jeremiah 16:6
19458.text: Both the great and the small will die in this land. They will not be buried,No one will mourn them,Nor will anyone cut himself or make himself bald for them.

19459.label: Jeremiah 16:7
19459.text: And no one will provide food for those in mourning,To comfort them over their dead;Nor will anyone give them the cup of consolationTo drink over the loss of their father or mother.

19460.label: Jeremiah 16:8
19460.text: And do not enter a house of feastingTo sit down with them to eat and drink.’

19461.label: Jeremiah 16:9
19461.text: “For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Here in this place, in your days and before your very eyes, I will put an end to the sounds of exultation and rejoicing, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.’

19462.label: Jeremiah 16:10
19462.text: “When you tell this people all these words, they will ask you, ‘Why has Jehovah spoken of all this great calamity against us? What error and what sin have we committed against Jehovah our God?’

19463.label: Jeremiah 16:11
19463.text: You must reply to them, ‘“Because your forefathers abandoned me,” declares Jehovah, “and they kept following other gods and serving them and bowing down to them. But me they abandoned, and my law they did not keep.

19464.label: Jeremiah 16:12
19464.text: And you have behaved far worse than your forefathers, and each one of you follows the stubbornness of his wicked heart instead of obeying me.

19465.label: Jeremiah 16:13
19465.text: So I will hurl you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your forefathers have known, and there you will have to serve other gods day and night, because I will show you no favor.”’

19466.label: Jeremiah 16:14
19466.text: “‘However, the days are coming,’ declares Jehovah, ‘when they will no longer say: “As surely as Jehovah is alive, who brought the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt!”

19467.label: Jeremiah 16:15
