19467.text: but rather: “As surely as Jehovah is alive, who brought the people of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands to which he had dispersed them!” and I will bring them back to their land, which I gave to their forefathers.’

19468.label: Jeremiah 16:16
19468.text: ‘Here I am sending for many fishermen,’ declares Jehovah,‘And they will fish for them. After that I will send for many hunters,And they will hunt them down on every mountain and every hillAnd out of the clefts of the crags.

19469.label: Jeremiah 16:17
19469.text: For my eyes are on everything they do. They have not been hidden from before me,Nor has their error been hidden from my eyes.

19470.label: Jeremiah 16:18
19470.text: First, I will repay the full amount due for their error and their sin, For they have profaned my land with the lifeless figures of their disgusting idolsAnd have filled my inheritance with their detestable things.’”

19471.label: Jeremiah 16:19
19471.text: O Jehovah, my strength and my stronghold,My place to flee in the day of distress, To you the nations will come from the ends of the earth,And they will say: “Our forefathers inherited utter falsehood,Futility and useless things of no benefit.”

19472.label: Jeremiah 16:20
19472.text: Can a man make gods for himselfWhen they are not really gods?

19473.label: Jeremiah 16:21
19473.text: “So I will make them know,At this time I will make them know my power and my might,And they will have to know that my name is Jehovah.”

19474.label: Jeremiah 17:1
19474.text: “The sin of Judah is written down with an iron stylus. With a diamond point it is engraved on the tablet of their heartAnd on the horns of their altars,

19475.label: Jeremiah 17:2
19475.text: While their sons remember their altars and their sacred poles Beside a luxuriant tree, on the high hills,

19476.label: Jeremiah 17:3
19476.text: On the mountains in the open countryside. Your resources, all your treasures, I will give as plunder —Yes, your high places because of sin throughout your territories.

19477.label: Jeremiah 17:4
19477.text: You will forfeit, of your own accord, your inheritance that I gave you. And I will make you serve your enemies in a land you do not know, For you have kindled my anger like a fire. It will burn for all time.”

19478.label: Jeremiah 17:5
19478.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Cursed is the man who puts his trust in mere humans, Who relies on human power, And whose heart turns away from Jehovah.

19479.label: Jeremiah 17:6
19479.text: He will become like a solitary tree in the desert. He will not see when good comes,But he will reside in parched places in the wilderness,In a salt land where no one can live.

19480.label: Jeremiah 17:7
19480.text: Blessed is the man who puts his trust in Jehovah,Whose confidence is in Jehovah.

19481.label: Jeremiah 17:8
19481.text: He will become like a tree planted by the waters,That sends out its roots to the stream. He will not notice when heat comes,But his leaves will always flourish. And in the year of drought he will not be anxious,Nor will he quit producing fruit.

19482.label: Jeremiah 17:9
19482.text: The heart is more treacherous than anything else and is desperate. Who can know it?

19483.label: Jeremiah 17:10
19483.text: I, Jehovah, am searching the heart, Examining the innermost thoughts, To give to each one according to his ways,According to the fruitage of his works.

19484.label: Jeremiah 17:11
19484.text: Like a partridge that gathers what it has not laid,So is the one who acquires riches dishonestly. They will leave him in midlife,And in the end he will prove senseless.”

19485.label: Jeremiah 17:12
19485.text: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning,Is the place of our sanctuary.

19486.label: Jeremiah 17:13
19486.text: O Jehovah, the hope of Israel,All those who abandon you will be put to shame. Those apostatizing from you will be written in the dust, Because they have abandoned Jehovah, the source of living water.

19487.label: Jeremiah 17:14
19487.text: Heal me, O Jehovah, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved, For you are the object of my praise.

19488.label: Jeremiah 17:15
19488.text: Look! There are those saying to me: “Where is the word of Jehovah? Let it come, please!”

19489.label: Jeremiah 17:16
19489.text: But as for me, I did not run away from following you as a shepherd,Nor did I long for the day of disaster. You well know everything my lips have spoken;It all took place before your face!

19490.label: Jeremiah 17:17
19490.text: Do not be a cause of terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of calamity.

19491.label: Jeremiah 17:18
19491.text: Let my persecutors be put to shame, But do not let me be put to shame. Let them be struck with terror,But do not let me be struck with terror. Bring the day of calamity on them, And crush them and destroy them completely.

19492.label: Jeremiah 17:19
19492.text: This is what Jehovah told me: “Go and stand in the gate of the sons of the people by which the kings of Judah go in and out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.

19493.label: Jeremiah 17:20
19493.text: You must say to them, ‘Hear the word of Jehovah, you kings of Judah, all people of Judah, and all inhabitants of Jerusalem, who enter by these gates.

19494.label: Jeremiah 17:21
19494.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Watch yourselves, and do not carry any load on the Sabbath day or bring it in through the gates of Jerusalem.

19495.label: Jeremiah 17:22
19495.text: You must not bring any load out of your homes on the Sabbath day; and you must do no work at all. Keep the Sabbath day sacred, just as I commanded your forefathers.

19496.label: Jeremiah 17:23
19496.text: But they did not listen or incline their ear, and they stubbornly refused to obey or to accept discipline.”’

19497.label: Jeremiah 17:24
19497.text: “‘“However, if you strictly obey me,” declares Jehovah, “and you bring in no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and you keep the Sabbath day sacred by not doing any work on it,

19498.label: Jeremiah 17:25
19498.text: then kings and princes who sit on the throne of David will also enter in through the gates of this city, riding in the chariot and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will be inhabited for all time.

19499.label: Jeremiah 17:26
19499.text: And people will come from the cities of Judah, from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the mountainous region, and from the Negʹeb, bringing whole burnt offerings, sacrifices, grain offerings, frankincense, and thanksgiving sacrifices into the house of Jehovah.

19500.label: Jeremiah 17:27
19500.text: “‘“But if you do not obey me by keeping the Sabbath day sacred and by not carrying loads and bringing them through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, I will set her gates on fire, and it will certainly consume the fortified towers of Jerusalem and will not be extinguished.”’”

19501.label: Jeremiah 18:1
19501.text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah:

19502.label: Jeremiah 18:2
19502.text: “Rise up and go down to the house of the potter, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”

19503.label: Jeremiah 18:3
19503.text: So I went down to the house of the potter, and he was working on the potter’s wheels.

19504.label: Jeremiah 18:4
19504.text: But the vessel that the potter was making with the clay was spoiled in his hand. So the potter reworked it into another vessel, just as he saw fit.

19505.label: Jeremiah 18:5
19505.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

19506.label: Jeremiah 18:6
19506.text: “‘Can I not do to you just as this potter did, O house of Israel?’ declares Jehovah. ‘Look! As the clay in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hand, O house of Israel.

19507.label: Jeremiah 18:7
19507.text: Whenever I may speak about uprooting and pulling down and destroying a nation or a kingdom,

19508.label: Jeremiah 18:8
19508.text: and that nation abandons its wickedness that I spoke against, I will also change my mind concerning the calamity that I intended to bring against it.

19509.label: Jeremiah 18:9
19509.text: But whenever I speak about building up and planting a nation or a kingdom,

19510.label: Jeremiah 18:10
19510.text: and it does what is bad in my eyes and does not obey my voice, I will change my mind concerning the good that I intended to do for it.’

19511.label: Jeremiah 18:11
19511.text: “Now say, please, to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Here I am preparing a calamity and devising a scheme against you. Turn back, please, from your bad ways, and reform your ways and your practices.”’”

19512.label: Jeremiah 18:12
19512.text: But they said: “It is hopeless! For we will walk after our own thoughts, and each of us will act according to the stubbornness of his wicked heart.”

19513.label: Jeremiah 18:13
19513.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says: “Ask for yourselves, please, among the nations. Who has heard anything like this? The virgin of Israel has done a most horrible thing.

19514.label: Jeremiah 18:14
19514.text: Does the snow of Lebʹa·non disappear from the rocks on its slopes? Or will cool waters flowing from afar dry up?

19515.label: Jeremiah 18:15
19515.text: But my people have forgotten me. For they make sacrifices to something worthless, And they make men stumble in their ways, the ancient paths, To walk on back roads that are not smooth and level,

19516.label: Jeremiah 18:16
19516.text: In order to make their land an object of horror And something to whistle at forever. Every last one passing by it will stare in horror and shake his head.

19517.label: Jeremiah 18:17
19517.text: Like the east wind, I will scatter them before the enemy. I will show them my back, not my face, in the day of their disaster.”

19518.label: Jeremiah 18:18
19518.text: And they said: “Come, let us devise a plot against Jeremiah, for the law will not perish from our priests or counsel from the wise men or the word from the prophets. Come and let us speak against him and pay no attention to what he says.”

19519.label: Jeremiah 18:19
19519.text: Do pay attention to me, O Jehovah,And listen to what my opponents are saying.

19520.label: Jeremiah 18:20
19520.text: Should good be repaid with bad? For they have dug a pit for my life. Remember how I stood before you to speak good about them,To turn your wrath away from them.

19521.label: Jeremiah 18:21
19521.text: So give their sons over to the famine,And hand them over to the power of the sword. May their wives become bereaved of children and widowed. May their men be killed with deadly plague,Their young men struck down with the sword in battle.

19522.label: Jeremiah 18:22
19522.text: Let a cry be heard from their housesWhen you bring marauders on them suddenly. For they have dug a pit to capture meAnd have laid traps for my feet.

19523.label: Jeremiah 18:23
19523.text: But you, O Jehovah,Well know all their schemes against me to kill me. Do not cover their error,And do not wipe out their sin from before you. Let them stumble before you When you take action against them in your anger.

19524.label: Jeremiah 19:1
19524.text: This is what Jehovah said: “Go and buy an earthenware flask from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests,

19525.label: Jeremiah 19:2
19525.text: and go out to the Valley of the Son of Hinʹnom, at the entrance of the Gate of the Potsherds. And there proclaim the words that I speak to you.

19526.label: Jeremiah 19:3
19526.text: You will say, ‘Hear the word of Jehovah, you kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “‘“I am about to bring a calamity on this place, and the ears of anyone who hears about it will tingle.

19527.label: Jeremiah 19:4
19527.text: It is because they abandoned me and made this place unrecognizable. In it they are sacrificing to other gods, whom they and their forefathers and the kings of Judah had not known, and they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent ones.

19528.label: Jeremiah 19:5
19528.text: They built the high places of Baʹal in order to burn their sons in the fire as whole burnt offerings to Baʹal, something that I had not commanded or spoken of and that had never even come into my heart.”’

19529.label: Jeremiah 19:6
19529.text: “‘“Therefore look! the days are coming,” declares Jehovah, “when this place will no longer be called Toʹpheth or the Valley of the Son of Hinʹnom but the Valley of the Slaughter.

19530.label: Jeremiah 19:7
19530.text: I will thwart the plans of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies and by the hand of those seeking to take their life. And I will give their dead bodies as food to the birds of the heavens and to the beasts of the earth.

19531.label: Jeremiah 19:8
19531.text: And I will make this city an object of horror and something to whistle at. Every last one passing by it will stare in horror and whistle over all its plagues.

19532.label: Jeremiah 19:9
19532.text: And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will each eat the flesh of his fellow man, because of the siege and their desperation when they are hemmed in by their enemies and those seeking to take their life.”’

19533.label: Jeremiah 19:10
19533.text: “Then break the flask before the eyes of the men who go with you,

19534.label: Jeremiah 19:11
19534.text: and say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies says: “This is how I will break this people and this city, like someone who breaks a potter’s vessel so that it can never be repaired; and they will bury the dead in Toʹpheth until there is no more room to bury them.”’

19535.label: Jeremiah 19:12
19535.text: “‘That is what I will do to this place,’ declares Jehovah, ‘and to its inhabitants, to make this city like Toʹpheth.

19536.label: Jeremiah 19:13
19536.text: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will become unclean like this place, Toʹpheth, yes, all the houses on whose roofs they offered sacrifices to all the army of the heavens and where they poured out drink offerings to other gods.’”

19537.label: Jeremiah 19:14
19537.text: When Jeremiah returned from Toʹpheth where Jehovah sent him to prophesy, he stood in the courtyard of the house of Jehovah and said to all the people:

19538.label: Jeremiah 19:15
19538.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Here I am bringing on this city and on all its towns all the calamity that I have spoken against it, because they stubbornly refused to obey my words.’”

19539.label: Jeremiah 20:1
19539.text: Now Pashʹhur the son of Imʹmer, the priest, who was also the leading commissioner in the house of Jehovah, was listening when Jeremiah prophesied these things.

19540.label: Jeremiah 20:2
19540.text: Then Pashʹhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of Jehovah.

19541.label: Jeremiah 20:3
19541.text: But on the following day when Pashʹhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him: “Jehovah has named you, not Pashʹhur, but Terror All Around.

19542.label: Jeremiah 20:4
19542.text: For this is what Jehovah says, ‘I will make you an object of terror to yourself and to all your friends, and they will fall by the sword of their enemies while your eyes are looking on; and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take them into exile in Babylon and put them to death by the sword.

19543.label: Jeremiah 20:5
19543.text: And I will give all the wealth of this city, all its resources, all its precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. And they will plunder them and seize them and take them to Babylon.

19544.label: Jeremiah 20:6
19544.text: And as for you, Pashʹhur, and all who live in your house, you will go into captivity. You will go off to Babylon and die there, and you will be buried there with all your friends, because you have prophesied lies to them.’”

19545.label: Jeremiah 20:7
19545.text: You have fooled me, O Jehovah, and I was fooled. You used your strength against me, and you prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day long;Everyone ridicules me.

19546.label: Jeremiah 20:8
19546.text: For whenever I speak, I must cry out and proclaim,“Violence and destruction!” For me the word of Jehovah has been the cause of insults and jeering all day long.

19547.label: Jeremiah 20:9
19547.text: So I said: “I am not going to make mention of him,And I will speak no more in his name.” But in my heart it became like a burning fire shut up in my bones,And I was tired of holding it in;I could no longer endure it.

19548.label: Jeremiah 20:10
19548.text: For I heard many evil rumors;Terror surrounded me. “Denounce him; let us denounce him!” Every man wishing me peace was watching for my downfall: “Perhaps he will make a foolish mistake,And we can prevail and take our revenge against him.”

19549.label: Jeremiah 20:11
19549.text: But Jehovah was with me like a fearsome warrior. That is why those persecuting me will stumble and will not prevail. They will be put to great shame, for they will not succeed. Their everlasting humiliation will not be forgotten.

19550.label: Jeremiah 20:12
19550.text: But you, O Jehovah of armies, are examining the righteous one;You see the innermost thoughts and the heart. Let me see your vengeance on them, For to you I have committed my legal case.

19551.label: Jeremiah 20:13
19551.text: Sing to Jehovah! Praise Jehovah! For he has rescued the poor one from the hand of evildoers.

19552.label: Jeremiah 20:14
19552.text: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother gave birth to me not be blessed!

19553.label: Jeremiah 20:15
19553.text: Cursed be the man who brought good news to my father, saying: “A son has been born to you, a boy!” Making him rejoice greatly.

19554.label: Jeremiah 20:16
19554.text: May that man become like cities that Jehovah overthrew without regret. May he hear an outcry in the morning and the sound of alarm at midday.

19555.label: Jeremiah 20:17
19555.text: Why did he not put me to death in the womb,So that my mother would become my burial placeAnd her womb would always remain pregnant?

19556.label: Jeremiah 20:18
19556.text: Why did I have to come out of the wombTo see trouble and grief,To end my days in shame?

19557.label: Jeremiah 21:1
19557.text: Jeremiah received the word from Jehovah when King Zed·e·kiʹah sent to him Pashʹhur son of Mal·chiʹjah and Zeph·a·niʹah son of Ma·a·seiʹah, the priest, requesting:

19558.label: Jeremiah 21:2
19558.text: “Please inquire of Jehovah in our behalf, because King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon is waging war against us. Perhaps Jehovah will perform one of his wonderful works in our behalf, so that he will withdraw from us.”

19559.label: Jeremiah 21:3
19559.text: Jeremiah said to them: “This is what you should say to Zed·e·kiʹah,

19560.label: Jeremiah 21:4
19560.text: ‘This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says: “Here I am turning around against you the weapons of war that are in your own hands, with which you are fighting the king of Babylon and the Chal·deʹans who are outside the wall besieging you. And I will gather them into the middle of this city.

19561.label: Jeremiah 21:5
19561.text: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, with anger and wrath and great indignation.

19562.label: Jeremiah 21:6
19562.text: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast. By a great pestilence they will die.”’

19563.label: Jeremiah 21:7
19563.text: “‘“And after that,” declares Jehovah, “I will give King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah and his servants and the people of this city—those who survive the pestilence, the sword, and the famine—into the hand of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon, into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who are seeking to take their life. He will strike them down with the sword. He will not feel sorry for them, nor will he show compassion or have any mercy.”’

19564.label: Jeremiah 21:8
19564.text: “And to this people you should say, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Here I am putting before you the way of life and the way of death.

19565.label: Jeremiah 21:9
19565.text: Those who remain in this city will die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chal·deʹans who are besieging you will keep living, and he will have his life as a spoil.”’

19566.label: Jeremiah 21:10
19566.text: “‘“For I have set my face against this city for calamity and not for good,” declares Jehovah. “It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.”

19567.label: Jeremiah 21:11
19567.text: “‘To the household of the king of Judah: Hear the word of Jehovah.

19568.label: Jeremiah 21:12
19568.text: O house of David, this is what Jehovah says: “Uphold justice every morning,And rescue the one being robbed from the hand of the defrauder, So that my wrath does not blaze like a fire And burn with no one to extinguish itBecause of your evil deeds.”’

19569.label: Jeremiah 21:13
19569.text: ‘Here I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, O rock of the level land,’ declares Jehovah. ‘As for you who say: “Who will come down against us? And who will invade our dwellings?”

19570.label: Jeremiah 21:14
19570.text: I will hold an accounting against youAs your deeds deserve,’ declares Jehovah. ‘And I will set her forest ablaze,And it will consume all the things around her.’”

19571.label: Jeremiah 22:1
19571.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and deliver this message.

19572.label: Jeremiah 22:2
19572.text: You must say, ‘Hear the word of Jehovah, O king of Judah who sits on the throne of David, you with your servants and your people, those who enter through these gates.

19573.label: Jeremiah 22:3
19573.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Uphold justice and righteousness. Rescue the one being robbed from the hand of the defrauder. Do not mistreat any foreign resident, and do not harm any fatherless child or widow. And do not shed any innocent blood in this place.

19574.label: Jeremiah 22:4
19574.text: For if you are careful to carry out this word, then the kings who sit on the throne of David will enter through the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses, they with their servants and their people.”’

19575.label: Jeremiah 22:5
19575.text: “‘But if you will not obey these words, by myself I do swear,’ declares Jehovah, ‘that this house will become a devastated place.’

19576.label: Jeremiah 22:6
19576.text: “For this is what Jehovah says concerning the house of the king of Judah,‘You are as Gilʹe·ad to me,Like the summit of Lebʹa·non. But I will make you a wilderness;Not one of your cities will be inhabited.

19577.label: Jeremiah 22:7
19577.text: And I will appoint destroyers against you,Each with his weapons. They will cut down your choicest cedarsAnd make them fall into the fire.

19578.label: Jeremiah 22:8
19578.text: “‘And many nations will pass by this city and say to one another: “Why did Jehovah do this to this great city?”

19579.label: Jeremiah 22:9
19579.text: And they will reply: “Because they abandoned the covenant of Jehovah their God and bowed down to other gods and served them.”’

19580.label: Jeremiah 22:10
19580.text: Do not weep for the dead one,And do not sympathize with him. Instead, weep profusely for the one going away,For he will return no more to see the land of his birth.

19581.label: Jeremiah 22:11
19581.text: “For this is what Jehovah says concerning Shalʹlum son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah who is reigning instead of his father Jo·siʹah and who has gone out of this place: ‘He will return there no more.

19582.label: Jeremiah 22:12
19582.text: For he will die in the place where they have taken him into exile, and he will see this land no more.’

19583.label: Jeremiah 22:13
19583.text: Woe to the one who builds his house without righteousnessAnd his upper rooms without justice,Who makes his fellow man serve him for nothing,Whose wages he refuses to pay;

19584.label: Jeremiah 22:14
19584.text: The one saying, ‘I will build for myself a roomy houseWith spacious upper rooms. I will fit it with windowsAnd panel it with cedar and paint it with vermilion.’

19585.label: Jeremiah 22:15
19585.text: Will you continue reigning because you outdo others in your use of cedar? Your father also ate and drank,But he upheld justice and righteousness, And it went well with him.

19586.label: Jeremiah 22:16
19586.text: He defended the legal claim of the afflicted one and the poor one,So that it went well. ‘Is that not what it means to know me?’ declares Jehovah.

19587.label: Jeremiah 22:17
19587.text: ‘But your eyes and heart are set only on your dishonest gain,On shedding innocent blood,And on committing fraud and extortion.’

19588.label: Jeremiah 22:18
19588.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah says concerning Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah,‘They will not mourn him: “Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!” They will not mourn him: “Alas, O master! Alas, his majesty!”

19589.label: Jeremiah 22:19
19589.text: With the burial of a donkey he will be buried, Dragged about and thrown away,Outside the gates of Jerusalem.’

19590.label: Jeremiah 22:20
19590.text: Go up to Lebʹa·non and cry out,Raise your voice in Baʹshan,And cry out from Abʹa·rim, For all your passionate lovers have been crushed.

19591.label: Jeremiah 22:21
19591.text: I spoke to you when you felt secure. But you said, ‘I will not obey.’ This has been your course since youth,For you have not obeyed my voice.

19592.label: Jeremiah 22:22
19592.text: A wind will shepherd all your shepherds, And your passionate lovers will go into captivity. Then you will be put to shame and humiliated because of all your calamity.

19593.label: Jeremiah 22:23
19593.text: O you who dwell in Lebʹa·non, Nestled among the cedars, How you will groan when pangs come on you,Anguish like that of a woman giving birth!”

19594.label: Jeremiah 22:24
19594.text: “‘As surely as I am alive,’ declares Jehovah, ‘even if Co·niʹah son of Je·hoiʹa·kim, the king of Judah, were the seal ring on my right hand, I would pull you off from there!

19595.label: Jeremiah 22:25
19595.text: I will give you into the hand of those seeking to take your life, into the hand of those whom you fear, into the hand of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chal·deʹans.

19596.label: Jeremiah 22:26
19596.text: And I will hurl you and your mother who gave birth to you into another land where you were not born, and there you will die.

19597.label: Jeremiah 22:27
19597.text: And they will never return to the land they yearn for.

19598.label: Jeremiah 22:28
19598.text: Is this man Co·niʹah just a despised, broken pot,A vessel that nobody wants? Why are he and his descendants hurled downAnd thrown into a land they do not know?’

19599.label: Jeremiah 22:29
19599.text: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of Jehovah.

19600.label: Jeremiah 22:30
19600.text: This is what Jehovah says: ‘Write down this man as childless,As a man who will not have any success during his lifetime, For none of his descendants will succeedIn sitting on David’s throne and ruling again in Judah.’”

19601.label: Jeremiah 23:1
19601.text: “Woe to the shepherds who are destroying and scattering the sheep of my pasture!” declares Jehovah.

19602.label: Jeremiah 23:2
19602.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah the God of Israel says against the shepherds who are shepherding my people: “You have scattered my sheep; you kept dispersing them, and you have not turned your attention to them.” “So I will turn my attention to you because of your evil deeds,” declares Jehovah.

19603.label: Jeremiah 23:3
19603.text: “Then I will gather together the remnant of my sheep from all the lands to which I have dispersed them, and I will bring them back to their pasture, and they will be fruitful and become many.

19604.label: Jeremiah 23:4
19604.text: And I will raise up over them shepherds who will really shepherd them. They will no longer be afraid or be terrified, and none will be missing,” declares Jehovah.

19605.label: Jeremiah 23:5
19605.text: “Look! The days are coming,” declares Jehovah, “when I will raise up to David a righteous sprout. And a king will reign and show insight and uphold justice and righteousness in the land.

19606.label: Jeremiah 23:6
19606.text: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will reside in security. And this is the name by which he will be called: Jehovah Is Our Righteousness.”

19607.label: Jeremiah 23:7
19607.text: “However, the days are coming,” declares Jehovah, “when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as Jehovah is alive, who brought the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt!’

19608.label: Jeremiah 23:8
19608.text: but rather, ‘As surely as Jehovah is alive, who brought out and brought back the descendants of the house of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands to which I had dispersed them,’ and they will dwell in their own land.”

19609.label: Jeremiah 23:9
19609.text: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me. All my bones are shaking. I am like a man who is drunkAnd like a man overcome by wine,Because of Jehovah and because of his holy words.

19610.label: Jeremiah 23:10
19610.text: For the land is full of adulterers; Because of the curse the land has gone into mourning And the pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and they abuse their power.

19611.label: Jeremiah 23:11
19611.text: “Both the prophet and the priest are polluted. Even in my own house I have found their wickedness,” declares Jehovah.

19612.label: Jeremiah 23:12
19612.text: “So their path will become slippery and dark; They will be pushed and will fall. For I will bring calamity on themIn the year of reckoning,” declares Jehovah.

19613.label: Jeremiah 23:13
19613.text: “And in the prophets of Sa·marʹi·a I have seen what is repulsive. Their prophecies are incited by Baʹal,And they lead my people Israel astray.

19614.label: Jeremiah 23:14
19614.text: And in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen horrible things. They commit adultery and walk in falsehood; They encourage evildoers,And they do not turn away from their wickedness. To me they are all like Sodʹom, And her inhabitants are like Go·morʹrah.”

19615.label: Jeremiah 23:15
19615.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies says against the prophets: “Here I am making them eat wormwoodAnd giving them poisoned water to drink. For from the prophets of Jerusalem apostasy has spread throughout the land.”

19616.label: Jeremiah 23:16
19616.text: This is what Jehovah of armies says: “Do not listen to the words of the prophets who are prophesying to you. They are deluding you. The vision they speak is from their own heart, Not from the mouth of Jehovah.

19617.label: Jeremiah 23:17
19617.text: They are saying again and again to those who disrespect me,‘Jehovah has said: “You will enjoy peace.”’ And to everyone who follows his own stubborn heart they say,‘No calamity will come upon you.’

19618.label: Jeremiah 23:18
19618.text: For who has stood in the inner circle of JehovahTo see and hear his word? Who has paid attention to his word in order to hear it?

19619.label: Jeremiah 23:19
19619.text: Look! The windstorm of Jehovah will burst out in fury;Like a whirling tempest it will whirl down on the head of the wicked.

19620.label: Jeremiah 23:20
19620.text: The anger of Jehovah will not turn backUntil he has carried out and accomplished the intentions of his heart. In the final part of the days you will clearly understand this.

19621.label: Jeremiah 23:21
19621.text: I did not send the prophets, yet they ran. I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.

19622.label: Jeremiah 23:22
19622.text: But if they had stood in my inner circle,They would have made my people hear my wordsAnd would have caused them to turn back from their bad way and their evil deeds.”

19623.label: Jeremiah 23:23
19623.text: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares Jehovah, “and not a God also from far away?”

19624.label: Jeremiah 23:24
19624.text: “Can any man hide in a concealed place where I cannot see him?” declares Jehovah. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares Jehovah.

19625.label: Jeremiah 23:25
19625.text: “I have heard the prophets who are prophesying lies in my name say, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’

19626.label: Jeremiah 23:26
19626.text: How long will this continue in the heart of the prophets, to prophesy lies? They are prophets of the deceit of their own heart.

19627.label: Jeremiah 23:27
19627.text: They intend to make my people forget my name by the dreams they relate to one another, just as their fathers forgot my name because of Baʹal.

19628.label: Jeremiah 23:28
19628.text: Let the prophet who has a dream relate the dream, but the one who has my word should speak my word truthfully.” “What does the straw have in common with the grain?” declares Jehovah.

19629.label: Jeremiah 23:29
19629.text: “Is not my word just like a fire,” declares Jehovah, “and like a forge hammer that smashes the crag?”

19630.label: Jeremiah 23:30
19630.text: “So here I am against the prophets,” declares Jehovah, “who steal my words from one another.”

19631.label: Jeremiah 23:31
19631.text: “Here I am against the prophets,” declares Jehovah, “those who use their tongue to say, ‘He declares!’”

19632.label: Jeremiah 23:32
19632.text: “Here I am against the prophets of lying dreams,” declares Jehovah, “who relate them and lead my people astray because of their lies and their boasting.” “But I did not send them or command them. So they will not benefit this people at all,” declares Jehovah.

19633.label: Jeremiah 23:33
19633.text: “And when this people or a prophet or a priest asks you, ‘What is the burden of Jehovah?’ you should reply to them, ‘“You people are the burden! And I will cast you off,” declares Jehovah.’

19634.label: Jeremiah 23:34
19634.text: As for the prophet or the priest or the people who say, ‘This is the burden of Jehovah!’ I will turn my attention on that man and on his household.

19635.label: Jeremiah 23:35
19635.text: This is what each of you is saying to his fellow and to his brother, ‘What has Jehovah answered? And what has Jehovah spoken?’

19636.label: Jeremiah 23:36
19636.text: But the burden of Jehovah you should mention no more, for the burden is each one’s own word, and you have changed the words of the living God, Jehovah of armies, our God.

19637.label: Jeremiah 23:37
19637.text: “This is what you will say to the prophet, ‘What answer has Jehovah given you? And what has Jehovah spoken?

19638.label: Jeremiah 23:38
19638.text: And if you keep saying, “The burden of Jehovah!” this is what Jehovah says: “Because of your saying, ‘This word is the burden of Jehovah,’ after I told you, ‘You must not say: “The burden of Jehovah!”’

19639.label: Jeremiah 23:39
19639.text: look! I will lift you up and throw you away from my presence, both you and the city that I gave to you and your forefathers.

19640.label: Jeremiah 23:40
19640.text: And I will bring on you everlasting disgrace and everlasting humiliation, which will not be forgotten.”’”

19641.label: Jeremiah 24:1
19641.text: Then Jehovah showed me two baskets of figs set before the temple of Jehovah, after King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon had carried into exile Jec·o·niʹah son of Je·hoiʹa·kim, the king of Judah, along with the princes of Judah, the craftsmen, and the metalworkers; he took them from Jerusalem to Babylon.

19642.label: Jeremiah 24:2
19642.text: One basket had very good figs, like early figs, but the other basket had very bad figs, so bad that they could not be eaten.

19643.label: Jeremiah 24:3
19643.text: Jehovah then asked me: “What do you see, Jeremiah?” So I said: “Figs; the good figs are very good, but the bad ones are very bad, so bad that they cannot be eaten.”

19644.label: Jeremiah 24:4
19644.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:

19645.label: Jeremiah 24:5
19645.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says, ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard in a good way the exiles of Judah, whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chal·deʹans.

19646.label: Jeremiah 24:6
19646.text: I will keep my eye on them for their good, and I will cause them to return to this land. I will build them up, and I will not tear down; I will plant them, and I will not uproot.

19647.label: Jeremiah 24:7
19647.text: And I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Jehovah. They will become my people, and I will become their God, for they will return to me with all their heart.

19648.label: Jeremiah 24:8
19648.text: “‘But concerning the bad figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten, this is what Jehovah says: “So I will regard King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah, his princes, the remnant of Jerusalem who are left in this land, and those who are dwelling in the land of Egypt.

19649.label: Jeremiah 24:9
19649.text: I will make them an object of horror and calamity to all the kingdoms of the earth, a reproach, a proverbial saying, a cause for ridicule, and a curse in all the places to which I disperse them.

19650.label: Jeremiah 24:10
19650.text: And I will send against them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, until they have perished from the land that I gave to them and to their forefathers.”’”

19651.label: Jeremiah 25:1
19651.text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, which was the first year of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon.

19652.label: Jeremiah 25:2
19652.text: This is what Jeremiah the prophet spoke concerning all the people of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:

19653.label: Jeremiah 25:3
19653.text: “From the 13th year of Jo·siʹah son of Aʹmon, the king of Judah, to this day, these 23 years, the word of Jehovah has come to me, and I kept speaking to you again and again, but you would not listen.

19654.label: Jeremiah 25:4
19654.text: And Jehovah sent all his servants the prophets to you, sending them again and again, but you would not listen or incline your ear to hear.

19655.label: Jeremiah 25:5
19655.text: They would say, ‘Turn back, please, each of you from your evil ways and your evil deeds; then you will continue dwelling for a long time to come in the land that Jehovah long ago gave to you and to your forefathers.

19656.label: Jeremiah 25:6
19656.text: Do not follow other gods and serve them and bow down to them, offending me with the work of your hands; otherwise I will bring calamity on you.’

19657.label: Jeremiah 25:7
19657.text: “‘But you would not listen to me,’ declares Jehovah. ‘Instead you offended me with the work of your hands, to your own calamity.’

19658.label: Jeremiah 25:8
19658.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies says, ‘“Because you would not obey my words,

19659.label: Jeremiah 25:9
19659.text: I am sending for all the families of the north,” declares Jehovah, “sending for King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon, my servant, and I will bring them against this land and against its inhabitants and against all these surrounding nations. I will devote them to destruction and make them an object of horror and something to whistle at and a perpetual ruin.

19660.label: Jeremiah 25:10
19660.text: I will put an end to the sound of exultation and the sound of rejoicing from them, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the hand mill and the light of the lamp.

19661.label: Jeremiah 25:11
19661.text: And all this land will be reduced to ruins and will become an object of horror, and these nations will have to serve the king of Babylon for 70 years.”’

19662.label: Jeremiah 25:12
19662.text: “‘But when 70 years have been fulfilled, I will call to account the king of Babylon and that nation for their error,’ declares Jehovah, ‘and I will make the land of the Chal·deʹans a desolate wasteland for all time.

19663.label: Jeremiah 25:13
19663.text: I will bring on that land all my words that I have spoken against it, all that is written in this book that Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

19664.label: Jeremiah 25:14
19664.text: For many nations and great kings will make slaves of them, and I will repay them according to their deeds and the work of their own hands.’”

19665.label: Jeremiah 25:15
19665.text: For this is what Jehovah the God of Israel said to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath out of my hand, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.

19666.label: Jeremiah 25:16
19666.text: And they will drink and stagger and act like madmen because of the sword that I am sending among them.”

19667.label: Jeremiah 25:17
19667.text: So I took the cup out of the hand of Jehovah and made all the nations to whom Jehovah sent me drink:

19668.label: Jeremiah 25:18
19668.text: starting with Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, her kings and her princes, to make them a ruin, an object of horror, something to whistle at and a curse, as it is today;

19669.label: Jeremiah 25:19
19669.text: then Pharʹaoh king of Egypt and his servants, his princes, and all his people,

19670.label: Jeremiah 25:20
19670.text: and all their mixed populations; all the kings of the land of Uz; all the kings of the land of the Phi·lisʹtines, Ashʹke·lon, Gazʹa, Ekʹron, and those remaining of Ashʹdod;

19672.label: Jeremiah 25:22
19672.text: all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Siʹdon, and the kings of the island in the sea;

19673.label: Jeremiah 25:23
19673.text: Deʹdan, Teʹma, Buz, and all those with hair clipped at the temples;

19674.label: Jeremiah 25:24
19674.text: all the kings of the Arabians and all the kings of the mixed populations who reside in the wilderness;

19675.label: Jeremiah 25:25
19675.text: all the kings of Zimʹri, all the kings of Eʹlam, and all the kings of the Medes;

19676.label: Jeremiah 25:26
19676.text: and all the kings of the north near and far, one after the other, and all the other kingdoms of the earth that are on the surface of the ground; and the king of Sheʹshach will drink after them.

19677.label: Jeremiah 25:27
19677.text: “And you must say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “Drink and get drunk and vomit and fall so that you cannot get up because of the sword that I am sending among you.”’

19678.label: Jeremiah 25:28
19678.text: And if they refuse to take the cup out of your hand to drink, say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies says: “You must drink it!

19679.label: Jeremiah 25:29
19679.text: For look! if I am bringing calamity first on the city that bears my name, should you go unpunished?”’ “‘You will not go unpunished, for I am calling for a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth,’ declares Jehovah of armies.

19680.label: Jeremiah 25:30
19680.text: “And you are to prophesy all these words to them and say to them,‘From on high Jehovah will roar,And from his holy dwelling he will make his voice heard. He will roar loudly against his abiding place. Shouting like those treading the winepress,He will sing triumphantly against all the inhabitants of the earth.’

19681.label: Jeremiah 25:31
19681.text: ‘A noise will resound to the ends of the earth,For Jehovah has a controversy with the nations. He will personally pass judgment on all humans. And he will put the wicked to the sword,’ declares Jehovah.

19682.label: Jeremiah 25:32
19682.text: This is what Jehovah of armies says: ‘Look! A calamity is spreading from nation to nation, And a great tempest will be unleashed from the remotest parts of the earth.

19683.label: Jeremiah 25:33
19683.text: “‘And those slain by Jehovah in that day will be from one end of the earth clear to the other end of the earth. They will not be mourned, nor will they be gathered up or buried. They will become like manure on the surface of the ground.’

19684.label: Jeremiah 25:34
19684.text: Wail, you shepherds, and cry out! Wallow about, you majestic ones of the flock,Because the time of your slaughter and your dispersion has come,And you will fall like a precious vessel!

19685.label: Jeremiah 25:35
19685.text: The shepherds have no place to flee,And there is no escape for the majestic ones of the flock.

19686.label: Jeremiah 25:36
19686.text: Listen! The outcry of the shepherdsAnd the wailing of the majestic ones of the flock,For Jehovah is devastating their pasture.

19687.label: Jeremiah 25:37
19687.text: And the peaceful dwelling places have been made lifelessBecause of the burning anger of Jehovah.

19688.label: Jeremiah 25:38
19688.text: He has left his lair just like a young lion, For their land has become an object of horrorBecause of the cruel swordAnd because of his burning anger.”

19689.label: Jeremiah 26:1
19689.text: In the beginning of the reign of Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, this word came from Jehovah:

19690.label: Jeremiah 26:2
19690.text: “This is what Jehovah says, ‘Stand in the courtyard of the house of Jehovah and speak concerning all the people of the cities of Judah who are coming in to worship at the house of Jehovah. Tell them everything that I command you; do not take away a word.

19691.label: Jeremiah 26:3
19691.text: Perhaps they will listen and each one will turn back from his evil way, and I will change my mind concerning the calamity that I intend to bring on them because of their evil deeds.

19692.label: Jeremiah 26:4
19692.text: Say to them: “This is what Jehovah says, ‘If you will not listen to me by following my law that I have placed before you,

19693.label: Jeremiah 26:5
19693.text: by listening to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I am sending to you again and again, whom you have not listened to,

19694.label: Jeremiah 26:6
19694.text: then I will make this house like Shiʹloh, and I will make this city an object of cursing to all the nations of the earth.’”’”

19695.label: Jeremiah 26:7
19695.text: And the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Jehovah.

19696.label: Jeremiah 26:8
19696.text: So when Jeremiah had finished speaking all that Jehovah had commanded him to speak to all the people, then the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him and said: “You will surely die.

19697.label: Jeremiah 26:9
19697.text: Why have you prophesied in the name of Jehovah, saying, ‘This house will become like Shiʹloh, and this city will be devastated and left without an inhabitant’?” And all the people gathered around Jeremiah in the house of Jehovah.

19698.label: Jeremiah 26:10
19698.text: When the princes of Judah heard these words, they came up from the house of the king to the house of Jehovah and sat down at the entrance of the new gate of Jehovah.

19699.label: Jeremiah 26:11
19699.text: The priests and the prophets said to the princes and to all the people: “This man deserves the death penalty, because he has prophesied against this city just as you have heard with your own ears.”

19700.label: Jeremiah 26:12
19700.text: Jeremiah then said to all the princes and to all the people: “It was Jehovah who sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

19701.label: Jeremiah 26:13
19701.text: So now, reform your ways and your actions and obey the voice of Jehovah your God, and Jehovah will change his mind concerning the calamity that he has spoken against you.

19702.label: Jeremiah 26:14
19702.text: But as for me, I am in your hand. Do to me whatever seems good and right in your eyes.

19703.label: Jeremiah 26:15
19703.text: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and upon her inhabitants, for in truth Jehovah sent me to you to speak all these words in your hearing.”

19704.label: Jeremiah 26:16
19704.text: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and the prophets: “This man does not deserve the death penalty, for he spoke to us in the name of Jehovah our God.”

19705.label: Jeremiah 26:17
19705.text: Furthermore, some of the elders of the land rose up and began saying to the entire congregation of the people:

19706.label: Jeremiah 26:18
19706.text: “Miʹcah of Moʹresh·eth was prophesying in the days of King Hez·e·kiʹah of Judah, and he said to all the people of Judah, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies says: “Zion will be plowed up as a field,Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, And the mountain of the House will become like high places in a forest.”’

19707.label: Jeremiah 26:19
19707.text: “Did King Hez·e·kiʹah of Judah and all Judah then put him to death? Did he not fear Jehovah and beg for Jehovah’s favor, so that Jehovah changed his mind concerning the calamity that he had spoken against them? So we are about to bring a great calamity on ourselves.

19708.label: Jeremiah 26:20
19708.text: “And there was another man prophesying in the name of Jehovah, U·riʹjah son of She·maiʹah from Kirʹi·ath-jeʹa·rim, who prophesied against this city and against this land with words like those of Jeremiah.

19709.label: Jeremiah 26:21
19709.text: King Je·hoiʹa·kim and all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, and the king sought to put him to death. When U·riʹjah heard of it, he at once became afraid and fled to Egypt.

19710.label: Jeremiah 26:22
19710.text: Then King Je·hoiʹa·kim sent El·naʹthan the son of Achʹbor and other men with him to Egypt.

19711.label: Jeremiah 26:23
19711.text: They brought U·riʹjah from Egypt and took him to King Je·hoiʹa·kim, who then struck him down with the sword and cast his dead body into the graveyard of the common people.”

19712.label: Jeremiah 26:24
19712.text: But A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan supported Jeremiah, so that he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.

19713.label: Jeremiah 27:1
19713.text: In the beginning of the reign of Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Jehovah:

19714.label: Jeremiah 27:2
19714.text: “This is what Jehovah has told me, ‘Make for yourself straps and yoke bars, and put them on your neck.

19715.label: Jeremiah 27:3
19715.text: Then send them to the king of Eʹdom, the king of Moʹab, the king of the Amʹmon·ites, the king of Tyre, and the king of Siʹdon by the hand of the messengers who have come to Jerusalem to King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah.

19716.label: Jeremiah 27:4
19716.text: Give them this command for their masters: “‘“This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says; this is what you should say to your masters,

19717.label: Jeremiah 27:5
19717.text: ‘It is I who made the earth, mankind, and the beasts that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm; and I have given it to whomever I please.

19718.label: Jeremiah 27:6
19718.text: And now I have given all these lands into the hand of my servant King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon; even the wild beasts of the field I have given him to serve him.

19719.label: Jeremiah 27:7
19719.text: All the nations will serve him and his son and his grandson until the time for his own land comes, when many nations and great kings will make him their slave.’

19720.label: Jeremiah 27:8
19720.text: “‘“‘If any nation or kingdom refuses to serve King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon and refuses to put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will punish that nation with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence,’ declares Jehovah, ‘until I have finished them off by his hand.’

19721.label: Jeremiah 27:9
19721.text: “‘“‘Therefore, do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your dreamers, your magicians, and your sorcerers, who are saying to you: “You will not serve the king of Babylon.”

19722.label: Jeremiah 27:10
19722.text: For they are prophesying lies to you, so that you will be taken far away from your land and I will disperse you and you will perish.

19723.label: Jeremiah 27:11
19723.text: “‘“‘But the nation that brings its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will allow to remain on its land,’ declares Jehovah, ‘to cultivate it and dwell in it.’”’”

19724.label: Jeremiah 27:12
19724.text: Also to King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah I spoke in the same way, saying: “Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him and his people, and you will keep living.

19725.label: Jeremiah 27:13
19725.text: Why should you and your people die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence, as Jehovah has said about the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

19726.label: Jeremiah 27:14
19726.text: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who are saying to you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon,’ because they are prophesying lies to you.

19727.label: Jeremiah 27:15
19727.text: “‘For I have not sent them,’ declares Jehovah, ‘but they are prophesying lies in my name, with the result that I will disperse you and you will perish, you and the prophets who are prophesying to you.’”

19728.label: Jeremiah 27:16
19728.text: And to the priests and to all this people I said: “This is what Jehovah says, ‘Do not listen to the words of your prophets who are prophesying to you: “Look! The utensils of the house of Jehovah will be brought back from Babylon very soon!” for they are prophesying lies to you.

19729.label: Jeremiah 27:17
19729.text: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon and you will keep living. Why should this city become a ruin?

19730.label: Jeremiah 27:18
19730.text: But if they are prophets and if the word of Jehovah is with them, please let them beg Jehovah of armies that the remaining utensils in the house of Jehovah, in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem may not be taken away to Babylon.’

19731.label: Jeremiah 27:19
19731.text: “For this is what Jehovah of armies says concerning the pillars, the Sea, the carriages, and the remaining utensils that are left in this city,

19732.label: Jeremiah 27:20
19732.text: which King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon did not take when he took into exile Jec·o·niʹah son of Je·hoiʹa·kim, the king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, together with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

19733.label: Jeremiah 27:21
19733.text: yes, this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the utensils that are left at the house of Jehovah, in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem:

19734.label: Jeremiah 27:22
19734.text: ‘“To Babylon they will be brought, and there they will remain until the day I turn my attention to them,” declares Jehovah. “Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.”’”

19735.label: Jeremiah 28:1
19735.text: In that same year, in the beginning of the reign of King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, the prophet Han·a·niʹah the son of Azʹzur from Gibʹe·on said to me in the house of Jehovah in the presence of the priests and all the people:

19736.label: Jeremiah 28:2
19736.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

19737.label: Jeremiah 28:3
19737.text: Within two years I am bringing back to this place all the utensils of the house of Jehovah that King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon took from this place and brought to Babylon.’”

19738.label: Jeremiah 28:4
19738.text: “‘And I will bring back to this place Jec·o·niʹah son of Je·hoiʹa·kim, the king of Judah, and all the exiles of Judah who have gone to Babylon,’ declares Jehovah, ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”

19739.label: Jeremiah 28:5
19739.text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Han·a·niʹah the prophet in the presence of the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of Jehovah.

19740.label: Jeremiah 28:6
19740.text: Jeremiah the prophet said: “Amen! May Jehovah do this! May Jehovah fulfill your words that you prophesied by bringing back from Babylon to this place the utensils of the house of Jehovah and all the exiled people!

19741.label: Jeremiah 28:7
19741.text: However, hear, please, this message that I am speaking in your ears and in the ears of all the people.

19742.label: Jeremiah 28:8
19742.text: Long ago the prophets who were prior to me and prior to you used to prophesy concerning many lands and great kingdoms, about war, calamity, and pestilence.

19743.label: Jeremiah 28:9
19743.text: If a prophet prophesies about peace and the word of that prophet comes true, then it will be known that Jehovah truly sent that prophet.”

19744.label: Jeremiah 28:10
19744.text: At that Han·a·niʹah the prophet took the yoke bar off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah and broke it.

19745.label: Jeremiah 28:11
19745.text: Han·a·niʹah then said in the presence of all the people: “This is what Jehovah says, ‘Just like this I will break the yoke of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two years.’” And Jeremiah the prophet went on his way.

19746.label: Jeremiah 28:12
19746.text: After Han·a·niʹah the prophet had broken the yoke bar from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, this message of Jehovah came to Jeremiah:

19747.label: Jeremiah 28:13
19747.text: “Go and say to Han·a·niʹah, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “You have broken yoke bars of wood, but instead of them you will make yoke bars of iron.”

19748.label: Jeremiah 28:14
19748.text: For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “I will put an iron yoke bar on the neck of all these nations, to serve King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon, and they must serve him. Even the wild beasts of the field I will give him.”’”

19749.label: Jeremiah 28:15
19749.text: Jeremiah the prophet then said to Han·a·niʹah the prophet: “Listen, please, O Han·a·niʹah! Jehovah has not sent you, but you have caused this people to trust in a lie.

19750.label: Jeremiah 28:16
19750.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says, ‘Look! I am removing you from the face of the ground. This year you will die, for you have urged rebellion against Jehovah.’”

19751.label: Jeremiah 28:17
19751.text: So Han·a·niʹah the prophet died in that year, in the seventh month.

19752.label: Jeremiah 29:1
19752.text: These are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the rest of the elders among the exiled people, the priests, the prophets, and all the people, whom Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar had taken into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon,

19753.label: Jeremiah 29:2
19753.text: after King Jec·o·niʹah, the queen mother, the court officials, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen and the metalworkers had gone out of Jerusalem.

19754.label: Jeremiah 29:3
19754.text: He sent the letter by the hand of El·aʹsah the son of Shaʹphan and Gem·a·riʹah the son of Hil·kiʹah, whom King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah sent to Babylon to King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon. It said:

19755.label: Jeremiah 29:4
19755.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says to all the exiled people, whom I have caused to go into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon,

19756.label: Jeremiah 29:5
19756.text: ‘Build houses and live in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.

19757.label: Jeremiah 29:6
19757.text: Take wives and have sons and daughters; take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Become many there, and do not decrease.

19758.label: Jeremiah 29:7
19758.text: And seek the peace of the city to which I have exiled you, and pray in its behalf to Jehovah, for in its peace you will have peace.

19759.label: Jeremiah 29:8
19759.text: For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “Do not let your prophets and your diviners who are among you deceive you, and do not listen to the dreams that they are dreaming.

19760.label: Jeremiah 29:9
19760.text: For ‘they are prophesying lies to you in my name. I have not sent them,’ declares Jehovah.”’”

19761.label: Jeremiah 29:10
19761.text: “For this is what Jehovah says, ‘When 70 years at Babylon are fulfilled, I will turn my attention to you, and I will make good my promise by bringing you back to this place.’

19762.label: Jeremiah 29:11
19762.text: “‘For I well know the thoughts that I am thinking toward you,’ declares Jehovah, ‘thoughts of peace, and not of calamity, to give you a future and a hope.

19763.label: Jeremiah 29:12
19763.text: And you will call me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you.’

19764.label: Jeremiah 29:13
19764.text: “‘You will seek me and find me, for you will search for me with all your heart.

19765.label: Jeremiah 29:14
19765.text: And I will let you find me,’ declares Jehovah. ‘And I will gather your captives and collect you together out of all the nations and places to which I have dispersed you,’ declares Jehovah. ‘And I will bring you back to the place from which I caused you to go into exile.’

19766.label: Jeremiah 29:15
19766.text: “But you have said, ‘Jehovah has raised up prophets for us in Babylon.’

19767.label: Jeremiah 29:16
19767.text: “For this is what Jehovah says to the king sitting on the throne of David and to all the people dwelling in this city, your brothers who have not gone with you into exile,

19768.label: Jeremiah 29:17
19768.text: ‘This is what Jehovah of armies says: “Here I am sending against them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and I will make them like rotten figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten.”’

19769.label: Jeremiah 29:18
19769.text: “‘And I will pursue them with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, and I will make them an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, and a curse, and an object of astonishment, something to whistle at, and a reproach among all the nations to which I disperse them,

19770.label: Jeremiah 29:19
19770.text: because they have not listened to my words that I sent to them with my servants the prophets,’ declares Jehovah, ‘sending them again and again.’ “‘But you have not listened,’ declares Jehovah.

19771.label: Jeremiah 29:20
19771.text: “Therefore, hear the word of Jehovah, all you exiled people, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

19772.label: Jeremiah 29:21
19772.text: This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says concerning Aʹhab the son of Ko·laiʹah and concerning Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Ma·a·seiʹah, who are prophesying lies to you in my name, ‘Here I am giving them into the hand of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon, and he will strike them down before your eyes.

19773.label: Jeremiah 29:22
19773.text: And what happens to them will become a curse spoken by all the exiles of Judah in Babylon: “May Jehovah make you like Zed·e·kiʹah and like Aʹhab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire!”

19774.label: Jeremiah 29:23
19774.text: for they have acted disgracefully in Israel, committing adultery with the wives of their neighbors and speaking false words in my name that I did not command them. “‘“I am the One who knows, and I am a witness,” declares Jehovah.’”

19775.label: Jeremiah 29:24
19775.text: “And to She·maiʹah of Ne·helʹam you will say,

19776.label: Jeremiah 29:25
19776.text: ‘This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “Because you sent in your name letters to all the people who are in Jerusalem, to Zeph·a·niʹah son of Ma·a·seiʹah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

19777.label: Jeremiah 29:26
19777.text: ‘Jehovah has made you priest instead of Je·hoiʹa·da the priest to become the overseer of the house of Jehovah, to be in charge of any madman who acts like a prophet and to put him into the stocks and into the pillory;

19778.label: Jeremiah 29:27
19778.text: why, then, have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anʹa·thoth, who is acting as a prophet for you?

19779.label: Jeremiah 29:28
19779.text: For he even sent to us at Babylon, saying: “It will be a long time! Build houses and live in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit, —”’”’”

19780.label: Jeremiah 29:29
19780.text: When Zeph·a·niʹah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet,

19781.label: Jeremiah 29:30
19781.text: the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah, saying:

19782.label: Jeremiah 29:31
19782.text: “Send to all the exiled people, saying, ‘This is what Jehovah says concerning She·maiʹah of Ne·helʹam: “Because She·maiʹah prophesied to you, though I did not send him, and he tried to make you trust in lies,

19783.label: Jeremiah 29:32
19783.text: therefore this is what Jehovah says, ‘Here I am turning my attention to She·maiʹah of Ne·helʹam and his descendants. Not one man of his will survive among this people, and he will not see the good that I will do for my people,’ declares Jehovah, ‘for he has urged rebellion against Jehovah.’”’”

19784.label: Jeremiah 30:1
19784.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19785.label: Jeremiah 30:2
19785.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says, ‘Write in a book all the words that I speak to you.

19786.label: Jeremiah 30:3
19786.text: For “look! the days are coming,” declares Jehovah, “when I will gather the captives of my people, Israel and Judah,” says Jehovah, “and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their forefathers, and they will possess it once again.”’”

19787.label: Jeremiah 30:4
19787.text: These are the words that Jehovah spoke to Israel and Judah.

19788.label: Jeremiah 30:5
19788.text: This is what Jehovah says: “We have heard the sounds of trembling;There is terror, and no peace.

19789.label: Jeremiah 30:6
19789.text: Ask, please, whether a man can give birth. Why, then, do I see every strong man with his hands on his stomach Like a woman giving birth? Why has every face turned pale?

19790.label: Jeremiah 30:7
19790.text: Alas! For that day is a terrible one. There is none like it,A time of distress for Jacob. But he will be saved out of it.”

19791.label: Jeremiah 30:8
19791.text: “And in that day,” declares Jehovah of armies, “I will break the yoke from off your neck, and your straps I will tear in two; and no more will strangers make him their slave.

19792.label: Jeremiah 30:9
19792.text: They will serve Jehovah their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.”

19793.label: Jeremiah 30:10
19793.text: “And you, my servant Jacob, do not be afraid,” declares Jehovah,“And do not be terrified, O Israel. For I will save you from far awayAnd your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return and be calm and undisturbed,With no one to make them afraid.”

19794.label: Jeremiah 30:11
19794.text: “For I am with you,” declares Jehovah, “to save you. But I will make an extermination among all the nations to which I scattered you; However, you I will not exterminate. I will discipline you to the proper degree,And I will by no means leave you unpunished.”

19795.label: Jeremiah 30:12
19795.text: For this is what Jehovah says: “There is no cure for your breakdown. Your wound is incurable.

19796.label: Jeremiah 30:13
19796.text: There is no one to plead your cause,No means of healing your ulcer. There is no cure for you.

19797.label: Jeremiah 30:14
19797.text: All your passionate lovers have forgotten you. They no longer seek you out. For with the stroke of an enemy I have struck you, With the punishment of someone cruel,Because of your great guilt and your many sins.

19798.label: Jeremiah 30:15
19798.text: Why do you cry out because of your breakdown? Your pain is incurable! Because of your great guilt and your many sins I have done this to you.

19799.label: Jeremiah 30:16
19799.text: Therefore all those devouring you will be devoured, And all your enemies will also go into captivity. Those pillaging you will be pillaged,And I will hand all those plundering you over to plundering.”

19800.label: Jeremiah 30:17
19800.text: “But I will restore your health and heal your wounds,” declares Jehovah,“Though they called you an outcast: ‘Zion, for whom no one searches.’”

19801.label: Jeremiah 30:18
19801.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Here I am gathering the captives of the tents of Jacob, And I will have pity for his tabernacles. The city will be rebuilt on her mound, And the fortified tower will stand on its rightful site.

19802.label: Jeremiah 30:19
19802.text: And from them will come thanksgiving and the sounds of laughter. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will make them numerous, And they will not be insignificant.

19803.label: Jeremiah 30:20
19803.text: His sons will become as in the past,And before me his assembly will be firmly established. I will deal with all his oppressors.

19804.label: Jeremiah 30:21
19804.text: His majestic one will be one of his own,And from his midst his ruler will emerge. I will cause him to come near, and he will approach me.” “For otherwise, who would dare to approach me?” declares Jehovah.

19805.label: Jeremiah 30:22
19805.text: “And you will become my people, and I will be your God.”

19806.label: Jeremiah 30:23
19806.text: Look! A windstorm of Jehovah will burst out in fury, A sweeping tempest that whirls down on the head of the wicked.

19807.label: Jeremiah 30:24
19807.text: The burning anger of Jehovah will not turn backUntil he has carried out and accomplished the intentions of his heart. In the final part of the days you will understand this.

19808.label: Jeremiah 31:1
19808.text: “At that time,” declares Jehovah, “I will become God to all the families of Israel, and they will become my people.”

19809.label: Jeremiah 31:2
19809.text: This is what Jehovah says: “The people who survived the sword found favor in the wildernessWhen Israel was walking to his resting-place.”

19810.label: Jeremiah 31:3
19810.text: From far away Jehovah appeared to me and said: “I have loved you with an everlasting love. That is why I have drawn you to me with loyal love.

19811.label: Jeremiah 31:4
19811.text: Yet again I will rebuild you and you will be rebuilt. O virgin of Israel, you will again take up your tambourinesAnd go forth dancing joyfully.

19812.label: Jeremiah 31:5
19812.text: You will again plant vineyards in the mountains of Sa·marʹi·a; The planters will plant and enjoy their fruit.

19813.label: Jeremiah 31:6
19813.text: For the day will come when the watchmen in the mountains of Eʹphra·im will call out: ‘Rise up, let us go up to Zion, to Jehovah our God.’”

19814.label: Jeremiah 31:7
19814.text: For this is what Jehovah says: “Cry out to Jacob with rejoicing. Shout for joy because you are over the nations. Proclaim it; offer praise and say,‘O Jehovah, save your people, the remnant of Israel.’

19815.label: Jeremiah 31:8
19815.text: I am bringing them back from the land of the north. I will gather them together from the remotest parts of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the lame, The pregnant woman and the one giving birth, all together. As a great congregation they will return here.

19816.label: Jeremiah 31:9
19816.text: They will come weeping. I will lead them as they beg for favor. I will guide them to streams of water, On a level path that will not make them stumble. For I am a Father to Israel, and Eʹphra·im is my firstborn.”

19817.label: Jeremiah 31:10
19817.text: Hear the word of Jehovah, you nations,And proclaim it among the islands far away: “The One who scattered Israel will gather him together. He will watch over him as a shepherd does his flock.

19818.label: Jeremiah 31:11
19818.text: For Jehovah will redeem Jacob And rescue him out of the hand of the one stronger than he is.

19819.label: Jeremiah 31:12
19819.text: They will come and shout joyfully on the height of Zion And become radiant over the goodness of Jehovah,Over the grain and the new wine and the oil,And over the young of the flock and the herd. They will become like a well-watered garden, And they will never languish again.”

19820.label: Jeremiah 31:13
19820.text: “At that time the virgin will dance joyfully,Also the young men and the old men together. I will change their mourning into exultation. I will comfort them and give them joy instead of their grief.

19821.label: Jeremiah 31:14
19821.text: I will satisfy the priests with plenty, And my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” declares Jehovah.

19822.label: Jeremiah 31:15
19822.text: “This is what Jehovah says: ‘A voice is heard in Raʹmah, lamentation and bitter weeping: Rachel is weeping over her sons. She has refused to be comforted over her sons,Because they are no more.’”

19823.label: Jeremiah 31:16
19823.text: This is what Jehovah says: “‘Hold back your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears,For there is a reward for your activity,’ declares Jehovah. ‘They will return from the land of the enemy.’

19824.label: Jeremiah 31:17
19824.text: ‘And there is a hope for your future,’ declares Jehovah. ‘Your sons will return to their own territory.’”

19825.label: Jeremiah 31:18
19825.text: “I have surely heard Eʹphra·im’s moaning,‘You have corrected me, and I have been corrected,Like a calf that has not been trained. Bring me back, and I will readily turn back,For you are Jehovah my God.

19826.label: Jeremiah 31:19
19826.text: For after my turning back I felt remorse; After I was made to understand I struck my thigh in grief. I was ashamed and humiliated, For I bore the reproach of my youth.’”

19827.label: Jeremiah 31:20
19827.text: “Is Eʹphra·im not a precious son to me, a beloved child? For as often as I speak against him, I do remember him still. That is why my emotions are stirred for him. And I will surely have pity on him,” declares Jehovah.

19828.label: Jeremiah 31:21
19828.text: “Set up road markers for yourself,And put up signposts. Pay attention to the highway, the way that you have to go. Return, O virgin of Israel, return to these cities of yours.

19829.label: Jeremiah 31:22
19829.text: How long will you waver, O unfaithful daughter? For Jehovah has created something new in the earth: A woman will eagerly pursue a man.”

19830.label: Jeremiah 31:23
19830.text: This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “They will again say these words in the land of Judah and in its cities when I gather back their captives: ‘May Jehovah bless you, O righteous dwelling place, O holy mountain.’

19831.label: Jeremiah 31:24
19831.text: And in it Judah and all its cities will dwell all together, farmers and those who lead the flocks.

19832.label: Jeremiah 31:25
19832.text: For I will satisfy the weary one and fill each one who is languishing.”

19833.label: Jeremiah 31:26
19833.text: At this I awoke and opened my eyes, and my sleep had been pleasurable to me.

19834.label: Jeremiah 31:27
19834.text: “Look! The days are coming,” declares Jehovah, “when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of livestock.”

19835.label: Jeremiah 31:28
19835.text: “And just as I watched over them to uproot, to pull down, to tear down, to destroy, and to do harm, so I will watch over them to build up and to plant,” declares Jehovah.

19836.label: Jeremiah 31:29
19836.text: “In those days they will no longer say, ‘The fathers ate sour grapes, but the teeth of the sons were set on edge.’

19837.label: Jeremiah 31:30
19837.text: But then each one will die for his own error. Any man eating sour grapes will have his own teeth set on edge.”

19838.label: Jeremiah 31:31
19838.text: “Look! The days are coming,” declares Jehovah, “when I will make with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah a new covenant.

19839.label: Jeremiah 31:32
19839.text: It will not be like the covenant that I made with their forefathers on the day I took hold of their hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, ‘my covenant that they broke, although I was their true master,’ declares Jehovah.”

19840.label: Jeremiah 31:33
19840.text: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” declares Jehovah. “I will put my law within them, and in their heart I will write it. And I will become their God, and they will become my people.”

19841.label: Jeremiah 31:34
19841.text: “And they will no longer teach each one his neighbor and each one his brother, saying, ‘Know Jehovah!’ for they will all know me, from the least to the greatest of them,” declares Jehovah. “For I will forgive their error, and I will no longer remember their sin.”

19842.label: Jeremiah 31:35
19842.text: This is what Jehovah says,Who gives the sun for light by day,The laws of the moon and the stars for light by night,Who stirs up the sea and makes its waves boisterous,Whose name is Jehovah of armies:

19843.label: Jeremiah 31:36
19843.text: “‘If these regulations should ever fail,’ declares Jehovah,‘Only then would the offspring of Israel cease as a nation before me always.’”

19844.label: Jeremiah 31:37
19844.text: This is what Jehovah says: “‘If the heavens above could be measured and the foundations of the earth below could be explored, only then could I reject all the offspring of Israel for all they have done,’ declares Jehovah.”

19845.label: Jeremiah 31:38
19845.text: “Look! The days are coming,” declares Jehovah, “when the city will be built to Jehovah from the Tower of Ha·nanʹel to the Corner Gate.

19846.label: Jeremiah 31:39
19846.text: And the measuring line will go out straight ahead to the hill of Gaʹreb, and it will turn toward Goʹah.

19847.label: Jeremiah 31:40
19847.text: And all the valley of the carcasses and of ashes and all the terraces as far as the Kidʹron Valley, clear to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, will be something holy to Jehovah. It will never again be uprooted or torn down.”

19848.label: Jeremiah 32:1
19848.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah in the 10th year of King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah, that is, the 18th year of Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar.

19849.label: Jeremiah 32:2
19849.text: At that time the armies of the king of Babylon were besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the Courtyard of the Guard in the house of the king of Judah.

19850.label: Jeremiah 32:3
19850.text: For King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah had confined him, saying, “Why do you prophesy like this? You say, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it,

19851.label: Jeremiah 32:4
19851.text: and King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah will not escape from the Chal·deʹans, for he will surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will speak to him face-to-face and see him eye to eye.”’

19852.label: Jeremiah 32:5
19852.text: ‘He will take Zed·e·kiʹah to Babylon, and there he will remain until I turn my attention to him,’ declares Jehovah. ‘Although you keep fighting against the Chal·deʹans, you will not succeed.’”

19853.label: Jeremiah 32:6
19853.text: Jeremiah said: “The word of Jehovah has come to me, saying,

19854.label: Jeremiah 32:7
19854.text: ‘Here Hanʹa·mel the son of Shalʹlum your uncle will come to you and say: “Buy for yourself my field in Anʹa·thoth, because you have the first right to repurchase it.”’”

19855.label: Jeremiah 32:8
19855.text: Hanʹa·mel the son of my uncle came to me, just as Jehovah had said, into the Courtyard of the Guard, and he said to me: “Please buy my field in Anʹa·thoth, in the land of Benjamin, for you have the right to take possession of it and to repurchase it. Buy it for yourself.” At that I knew that this was by the word of Jehovah.

19856.label: Jeremiah 32:9
