19856.text: So I bought the field in Anʹa·thoth from Hanʹa·mel the son of my uncle. I weighed out the money to him, seven shekels and ten silver pieces.

19857.label: Jeremiah 32:10
19857.text: Then I recorded it in a deed, affixed the seal, called in witnesses, and weighed the money in the scales.

19858.label: Jeremiah 32:11
19858.text: I took the deed of purchase, the one that was sealed according to the commandment and legal requirements, as well as the one that was left unsealed,

19859.label: Jeremiah 32:12
19859.text: and I gave the deed of purchase to Barʹuch son of Ne·riʹah son of Mah·seiʹah in the presence of Hanʹa·mel the son of my uncle, the witnesses who wrote in the deed of purchase, and all the Jews who were sitting in the Courtyard of the Guard.

19860.label: Jeremiah 32:13
19860.text: I now commanded Barʹuch in their presence, saying:

19861.label: Jeremiah 32:14
19861.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Take these deeds, this deed of purchase, the sealed one and the other deed left unsealed, and put them into an earthenware vessel, so that they may be kept for a long time.’

19862.label: Jeremiah 32:15
19862.text: For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Houses and fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land.’”

19863.label: Jeremiah 32:16
19863.text: Then I prayed to Jehovah after giving the deed of purchase to Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah, saying:

19864.label: Jeremiah 32:17
19864.text: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Look! You made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. Nothing is too wonderful for you,

19865.label: Jeremiah 32:18
19865.text: the One showing loyal love to thousands, but repaying the error of the fathers to their sons after them, the true God, the great and mighty One, whose name is Jehovah of armies.

19866.label: Jeremiah 32:19
19866.text: You are great in counsel and mighty in deed, you whose eyes observe all the ways of men, to give to each one according to his ways and according to what he does.

19867.label: Jeremiah 32:20
19867.text: You have performed signs and miracles in the land of Egypt, which are known down to this day, and thus you have made a name for yourself in Israel and among mankind, as it is today.

19868.label: Jeremiah 32:21
19868.text: And you brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt, with signs, with miracles, with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with terrifying deeds.

19869.label: Jeremiah 32:22
19869.text: “In time you gave them this land that you swore to give to their forefathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.

19870.label: Jeremiah 32:23
19870.text: And they came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey your voice or walk in your law. They did not do anything you commanded them to do, so that you caused all this calamity to befall them.

19871.label: Jeremiah 32:24
19871.text: Look! Men have come with siege ramparts to capture the city, and because of the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, the city will certainly fall into the hands of the Chal·deʹans who are fighting against it; what you said has all happened, as you now see.

19872.label: Jeremiah 32:25
19872.text: But you have told me, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘Buy for yourself the field with money and call in witnesses,’ although the city will certainly be given into the hand of the Chal·deʹans.”

19873.label: Jeremiah 32:26
19873.text: At that the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah, saying:

19874.label: Jeremiah 32:27
19874.text: “Here I am, Jehovah, the God of all mankind. Is there anything too wonderful for me?

19875.label: Jeremiah 32:28
19875.text: So this is what Jehovah says, ‘Here I am handing this city over to the Chal·deʹans and into the hand of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon, and he will capture it.

19876.label: Jeremiah 32:29
19876.text: And the Chal·deʹans fighting against this city will come in and set this city on fire and burn it down along with the houses on whose roofs the people offered sacrifices to Baʹal and poured out drink offerings to other gods to offend me.’

19877.label: Jeremiah 32:30
19877.text: “‘For the people of Israel and of Judah have done only what was bad in my eyes, from their youth on; the people of Israel keep offending me by the work of their hands,’ declares Jehovah.

19878.label: Jeremiah 32:31
19878.text: ‘For this city, from the day that they built it down to this day, has been nothing but a cause of anger and wrath to me, so that it must be removed from before my face,

19879.label: Jeremiah 32:32
19879.text: because of all the evil that the people of Israel and of Judah have done to offend me—they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, and the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

19880.label: Jeremiah 32:33
19880.text: They kept turning their backs to me, not their faces; although I tried to teach them again and again, none of them would listen to receive discipline.

19881.label: Jeremiah 32:34
19881.text: And they put their disgusting idols in the house that bears my name, in order to defile it.

19882.label: Jeremiah 32:35
19882.text: Furthermore, they built the high places of Baʹal in the Valley of the Son of Hinʹnom, in order to make their sons and their daughters pass through the fire to Moʹlech, something that I had not commanded them and that had never come into my heart to do such a detestable thing, causing Judah to sin.’

19883.label: Jeremiah 32:36
19883.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah the God of Israel says concerning this city that you are saying will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, the famine, and the pestilence,

19884.label: Jeremiah 32:37
19884.text: ‘Here I will gather them together from all the lands where I dispersed them in my anger and in my wrath and in great indignation, and I will bring them back to this place and let them dwell in security.

19885.label: Jeremiah 32:38
19885.text: And they will be my people, and I will be their God.

19886.label: Jeremiah 32:39
19886.text: And I will give them one heart and one way so that they may always fear me, for their own good and the good of their children after them.

19887.label: Jeremiah 32:40
19887.text: And I will make with them an everlasting covenant, that I will not turn away from doing good to them; and I will put the fear of me in their hearts, so that they will not turn away from me.

19888.label: Jeremiah 32:41
19888.text: I will exult over them to do good to them, and I will firmly plant them in this land, with all my heart and with all my soul.’”

19889.label: Jeremiah 32:42
19889.text: “For this is what Jehovah says, ‘Just as I have brought on this people all this great calamity, so I will bring on them all the goodness that I am promising them.

19890.label: Jeremiah 32:43
19890.text: And fields will again be bought in this land, though you are saying: “It is a wasteland without man and beast, and it has been handed over to the Chal·deʹans.”’

19891.label: Jeremiah 32:44
19891.text: “‘Fields will be bought with money, deeds of purchase will be recorded and sealed, and witnesses will be called in the land of Benjamin, in the areas around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the mountainous region, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the south, because I will bring back their captives,’ declares Jehovah.”

19892.label: Jeremiah 33:1
19892.text: The word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still confined in the Courtyard of the Guard, saying:

19893.label: Jeremiah 33:2
19893.text: “This is what Jehovah the Maker of earth says, Jehovah who formed it and firmly established it; Jehovah is his name,

19894.label: Jeremiah 33:3
19894.text: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you and readily tell you great and incomprehensible things that you have not known.’”

19895.label: Jeremiah 33:4
19895.text: “For this is what Jehovah the God of Israel says concerning the houses of this city and the houses of the kings of Judah that are pulled down because of the siege ramparts and the sword,

19896.label: Jeremiah 33:5
19896.text: and concerning those who are coming to fight the Chal·deʹans, filling these places with the carcasses of those whom I struck down in my anger and in my wrath, those whose evil has caused me to hide my face from this city:

19897.label: Jeremiah 33:6
19897.text: ‘Here I am bringing recuperation and health to her, and I will heal them and reveal to them an abundance of peace and truth.

19898.label: Jeremiah 33:7
19898.text: And I will bring back the captives of Judah and the captives of Israel, and I will build them up as I did at the start.

19899.label: Jeremiah 33:8
19899.text: And I will purify them from all the guilt of their sins against me, and I will forgive all the guilt of their sins and their transgressions against me.

19900.label: Jeremiah 33:9
19900.text: And she will become to me a name of exultation, a praise, and a beauty before all the nations of the earth who will hear of all the goodness that I bestow on them. And they will be in dread and will tremble because of all the goodness and peace that I will bestow on her.’”

19901.label: Jeremiah 33:10
19901.text: “This is what Jehovah says: ‘In this place that you will say is a wasteland, without man or livestock, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate, without man or inhabitant or livestock, there will again be heard

19902.label: Jeremiah 33:11
19902.text: the sound of exultation and the sound of rejoicing, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those saying: “Give thanks to Jehovah of armies, for Jehovah is good; his loyal love endures forever!”’ “‘They will bring thanksgiving offerings into the house of Jehovah, for I will bring back the captives of the land, as at the start,’ says Jehovah.”

19903.label: Jeremiah 33:12
19903.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies says: ‘In this wasteland, without man or livestock, and in all its cities, there will again be pastures for the shepherds to rest their flocks.’

19904.label: Jeremiah 33:13
19904.text: “‘In the cities of the mountainous region, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the south, in the land of Benjamin, in the areas around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, flocks will again pass under the hands of the one counting them,’ says Jehovah.”

19905.label: Jeremiah 33:14
19905.text: “‘Look! The days are coming,’ declares Jehovah, ‘when I will fulfill the good promise that I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and the house of Judah.

19906.label: Jeremiah 33:15
19906.text: In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David a righteous sprout, and he will execute justice and righteousness in the land.

19907.label: Jeremiah 33:16
19907.text: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will reside in security. And this is what she will be called: Jehovah Is Our Righteousness.’”

19908.label: Jeremiah 33:17
19908.text: “For this is what Jehovah says: ‘There will never fail to be a man from David’s line to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,

19909.label: Jeremiah 33:18
19909.text: nor will the Levitical priests ever fail to have a man stand before me to offer whole burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to offer sacrifices.’”

19910.label: Jeremiah 33:19
19910.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to Jeremiah, saying:

19911.label: Jeremiah 33:20
19911.text: “This is what Jehovah says, ‘If you could break my covenant regarding the day and my covenant regarding the night, to prevent day and night from coming at their proper time,

19912.label: Jeremiah 33:21
19912.text: only then could my covenant with my servant David be broken, so that he should not have a son ruling as king on his throne, and so also my covenant with the Levitical priests, my ministers.

19913.label: Jeremiah 33:22
19913.text: Just as the army of the heavens cannot be counted and the sand of the sea cannot be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of my servant David and the Levites who are ministering to me.’”

19914.label: Jeremiah 33:23
19914.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to Jeremiah, saying:

19915.label: Jeremiah 33:24
19915.text: “Have you not taken note of what this people is saying, ‘Jehovah will reject the two families that he chose’? And they are treating my own people with disrespect, and they no longer regard them as a nation.

19916.label: Jeremiah 33:25
19916.text: “This is what Jehovah says: ‘Just as surely as I have established my covenant regarding the day and the night, the laws of heaven and earth,

19917.label: Jeremiah 33:26
19917.text: so I will never reject the offspring of Jacob and of my servant David, so as not to take from his offspring rulers over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will gather back their captives and have pity on them.’”

19918.label: Jeremiah 34:1
19918.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, when King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms of the earth under his dominion and all the peoples were fighting against Jerusalem and all her cities:

19919.label: Jeremiah 34:2
19919.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says, ‘Go and speak to King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah and tell him: “This is what Jehovah says, ‘Here I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.

19920.label: Jeremiah 34:3
19920.text: And you will not escape out of his hand, for you will without fail be caught and handed over to him. And you will see the king of Babylon eye to eye, and he will speak to you face-to-face, and you will go to Babylon.’

19921.label: Jeremiah 34:4
19921.text: However, hear the word of Jehovah, O King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah, ‘This is what Jehovah says concerning you: “You will not die by the sword.

19922.label: Jeremiah 34:5
19922.text: In peace you will die, and they will make a burning ceremony for you as they did for your fathers, the former kings who were before you, and they will mourn you, ‘Alas, O master!’ for ‘I have spoken the word,’ declares Jehovah.”’”’”

19923.label: Jeremiah 34:6
19923.text: Jeremiah the prophet then spoke all these words to King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah in Jerusalem,

19924.label: Jeremiah 34:7
19924.text: when the armies of the king of Babylon were fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Laʹchish and against A·zeʹkah; for they were the only fortified cities that remained of the cities of Judah.

19925.label: Jeremiah 34:8
19925.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah after King Zed·e·kiʹah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim liberty to them,

19926.label: Jeremiah 34:9
19926.text: that everyone should free his Hebrew slaves, male and female, so that no one would keep a fellow Jew as his slave.

19927.label: Jeremiah 34:10
19927.text: So all the princes and all the people obeyed. They had entered into the covenant that everyone should free his male and female slaves and not keep them as slaves any longer. They obeyed and let them go.

19928.label: Jeremiah 34:11
19928.text: However, they later brought back the male and female slaves whom they had freed, and they again forced them back into slavery.

19929.label: Jeremiah 34:12
19929.text: So the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19930.label: Jeremiah 34:13
19930.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says, ‘I made a covenant with your forefathers in the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying:

19931.label: Jeremiah 34:14
19931.text: “At the end of seven years, each of you should free his Hebrew brother who was sold to you and who has served you six years; you must set him free.” But your forefathers did not listen or incline their ears to me.

19932.label: Jeremiah 34:15
19932.text: And recently you yourselves turned around and did what was right in my eyes by proclaiming liberty to your fellow men, and you made a covenant before me in the house that bears my name.

19933.label: Jeremiah 34:16
19933.text: But then you turned around and profaned my name by bringing back your male and female slaves whom you had freed according to their desire, and you forced them back into slavery.’

19934.label: Jeremiah 34:17
19934.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah says: ‘You have not obeyed me in proclaiming liberty, each one to his brother and to his fellow man. So I will now proclaim liberty to you,’ declares Jehovah, ‘to the sword, to pestilence, and to famine, and I will make you an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

19935.label: Jeremiah 34:18
19935.text: And this is what will happen to the men who violated my covenant by not carrying out the words of the covenant that they made before me when they cut the calf in two and passed between the halves,

19936.label: Jeremiah 34:19
19936.text: namely, the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the halves of the calf:

19937.label: Jeremiah 34:20
19937.text: I will hand them over to their enemies and to those seeking to take their lives, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth.

19938.label: Jeremiah 34:21
19938.text: And I will give King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah and his princes into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those seeking to take their lives and into the hand of the armies of the king of Babylon, who are withdrawing from against you.’

19939.label: Jeremiah 34:22
19939.text: “‘Here I will give the order,’ declares Jehovah, ‘and I will bring them back to this city, and they will fight against it and capture it and burn it with fire; and the cities of Judah I will make a wasteland, without an inhabitant.’”

19940.label: Jeremiah 35:1
19940.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah in the days of Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, saying:

19941.label: Jeremiah 35:2
19941.text: “Go to the house of the Reʹcha·bites and speak with them and bring them into the house of Jehovah, into one of the dining rooms; then offer them wine to drink.”

19942.label: Jeremiah 35:3
19942.text: So I took Ja·az·a·niʹah the son of Jeremiah the son of Hab·az·zi·niʹah, his brothers, all his sons, and the entire house of the Reʹcha·bites

19943.label: Jeremiah 35:4
19943.text: into the house of Jehovah. I brought them to the dining room of the sons of Haʹnan the son of Ig·da·liʹah, a man of the true God, which was next to the dining room of the princes that was above the dining room of Ma·a·seiʹah the son of Shalʹlum the doorkeeper.

19944.label: Jeremiah 35:5
19944.text: Then I put cups and goblets full of wine before the men of the house of the Reʹcha·bites and said to them: “Drink wine.”

19945.label: Jeremiah 35:6
19945.text: But they said: “We will not drink wine, because Je·honʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab, our forefather, gave us this command, ‘Neither you nor your sons must ever drink wine.

19946.label: Jeremiah 35:7
19946.text: And you must not build a house, sow seed, or plant or obtain a vineyard. Instead, you must always dwell in tents, so that you may live for a long time in the land where you are residing as foreigners.’

19947.label: Jeremiah 35:8
19947.text: So we continue to obey the voice of Je·honʹa·dab the son of our forefather Reʹchab in all that he commanded us, by never drinking any wine—we, our wives, our sons, and our daughters.

19948.label: Jeremiah 35:9
19948.text: And we do not build houses to dwell in, nor do we have vineyards or fields or seed.

19949.label: Jeremiah 35:10
19949.text: We keep living in tents and obeying all that Je·honʹa·dab our forefather commanded us.

19950.label: Jeremiah 35:11
19950.text: But when King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon came up against the land, we said, ‘Come, let us go into Jerusalem to escape the army of the Chal·deʹans and of the Syrians,’ and now we are living in Jerusalem.”

19951.label: Jeremiah 35:12
19951.text: And the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah, saying:

19952.label: Jeremiah 35:13
19952.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Go and say to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: “Were you not continually urged to obey my words?” declares Jehovah.

19953.label: Jeremiah 35:14
19953.text: “Je·honʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab commanded his descendants not to drink wine, and they have carried out his words by not drinking it to this day, thus obeying the order of their forefather. However, I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not obeyed me.

19954.label: Jeremiah 35:15
19954.text: And I kept sending all my servants the prophets to you, sending them again and again, saying, ‘Turn back, please, each of you from your evil ways, and do what is right! Do not walk after other gods and serve them. Then you will keep dwelling in the land that I gave to you and your forefathers.’ But you did not incline your ear or listen to me.

19955.label: Jeremiah 35:16
19955.text: The descendants of Je·honʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab have carried out the order that their forefather gave them, but these people have not listened to me.”’”

19956.label: Jeremiah 35:17
19956.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah, the God of armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Here I am bringing on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the calamity that I have warned them about, for I have spoken to them, but they would not listen, and I kept calling to them, but they would not answer.’”

19957.label: Jeremiah 35:18
19957.text: And Jeremiah said to the household of the Reʹcha·bites: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have obeyed the order of your forefather Je·honʹa·dab and you continue to observe all his orders, doing exactly what he ordered you,

19958.label: Jeremiah 35:19
19958.text: this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “There will never fail to be a descendant of Je·honʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab to serve in my presence.”’”

19959.label: Jeremiah 36:1
19959.text: Now in the fourth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19960.label: Jeremiah 36:2
19960.text: “Take a scroll and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel and Judah and all the nations, from the first day I spoke to you in the days of Jo·siʹah to this day.

19961.label: Jeremiah 36:3
19961.text: Perhaps when those of the house of Judah hear of all the calamity that I intend to bring on them, they may turn back from their evil ways, so that I may forgive their error and their sin.”

19962.label: Jeremiah 36:4
19962.text: Jeremiah then called Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah, and Jeremiah dictated all the words that Jehovah had spoken to him, and Barʹuch wrote them in the scroll.

19963.label: Jeremiah 36:5
19963.text: Then Jeremiah commanded Barʹuch: “I am confined and unable to enter the house of Jehovah.

19964.label: Jeremiah 36:6
19964.text: So you are the one who must go in and read aloud the words of Jehovah from the scroll that you wrote at my dictation. Read them in the hearing of the people at the house of Jehovah on the day of a fast; thus you will read them to all the people of Judah who come in from their cities.

19965.label: Jeremiah 36:7
19965.text: Perhaps their request for favor will reach Jehovah, and they will turn back, each one from his evil ways, for great is the anger and the wrath that Jehovah has declared against this people.”

19966.label: Jeremiah 36:8
19966.text: So Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah did all that Jeremiah the prophet had commanded him; he read aloud from the scroll the words of Jehovah at the house of Jehovah.

19967.label: Jeremiah 36:9
19967.text: Now in the fifth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came into Jerusalem from the cities of Judah proclaimed a fast before Jehovah.

19968.label: Jeremiah 36:10
19968.text: Barʹuch then read aloud from the scroll the words of Jeremiah at the house of Jehovah, in the chamber of Gem·a·riʹah the son of Shaʹphan the copyist, in the upper courtyard, at the entrance of the new gate of the house of Jehovah, in the hearing of all the people.

19969.label: Jeremiah 36:11
19969.text: When Mi·caiʹah the son of Gem·a·riʹah the son of Shaʹphan heard all the words of Jehovah from the scroll,

19970.label: Jeremiah 36:12
19970.text: he went down to the house of the king, to the secretary’s chamber. All the princes were sitting there: E·lishʹa·ma the secretary, De·laʹiah the son of She·maiʹah, El·naʹthan the son of Achʹbor, Gem·a·riʹah the son of Shaʹphan, Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Han·a·niʹah, and all the other princes.

19971.label: Jeremiah 36:13
19971.text: Mi·caiʹah told them all the words that he had heard when Barʹuch read from the scroll in the hearing of the people.

19972.label: Jeremiah 36:14
19972.text: Then all the princes sent Je·huʹdi the son of Neth·a·niʹah the son of Shel·e·miʹah the son of Cushʹi to Barʹuch, saying: “Come and bring with you the scroll from which you read in the hearing of the people.” Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah took the scroll in his hand and went in to them.

19973.label: Jeremiah 36:15
19973.text: They said to him: “Sit down, please, and read it aloud to us.” So Barʹuch read it to them.

19974.label: Jeremiah 36:16
19974.text: Now as soon as they heard all the words, they looked at one another in dread, and they said to Barʹuch: “We must certainly tell the king all these words.”

19975.label: Jeremiah 36:17
19975.text: And they asked Barʹuch: “Tell us, please, how you wrote all these words. Was it at his dictation?”

19976.label: Jeremiah 36:18
19976.text: Barʹuch replied to them: “He dictated all these words to me, and I wrote them down with ink in this scroll.”

19977.label: Jeremiah 36:19
19977.text: The princes said to Barʹuch: “Go and hide yourselves, you and Jeremiah, and do not let anyone know where you are.”

19978.label: Jeremiah 36:20
19978.text: Then they went in to the king, to the courtyard, and deposited the scroll in the chamber of E·lishʹa·ma the secretary, and they told the king everything they had heard.

19979.label: Jeremiah 36:21
19979.text: So the king sent Je·huʹdi out to get the scroll, and he brought it from the chamber of E·lishʹa·ma the secretary. Je·huʹdi began to read it in the hearing of the king and of all the princes standing by the king.

19980.label: Jeremiah 36:22
19980.text: The king was sitting in the winter house, in the ninth month, with a fire burning in the brazier before him.

19981.label: Jeremiah 36:23
19981.text: After Je·huʹdi had read three or four columns, the king would cut off that portion with the secretary’s knife and pitch it into the fire that was burning in the brazier, until the entire scroll ended up in the fire that was in the brazier.

19982.label: Jeremiah 36:24
19982.text: And they felt no dread; neither the king nor all his servants who heard all these words ripped their garments apart.

19983.label: Jeremiah 36:25
19983.text: Although El·naʹthan, De·laʹiah, and Gem·a·riʹah pleaded with the king not to burn the scroll, he did not listen to them.

19984.label: Jeremiah 36:26
19984.text: Further, the king commanded Je·rahʹme·el the son of the king, Se·raiʹah the son of Azʹri·el, and Shel·e·miʹah the son of Abʹde·el to seize Barʹuch the secretary and Jeremiah the prophet, but Jehovah kept them concealed.

19985.label: Jeremiah 36:27
19985.text: And the word of Jehovah again came to Jeremiah after the king had burned up the scroll containing the words that Barʹuch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, saying:

19986.label: Jeremiah 36:28
19986.text: “Take another scroll and write on it all the same words that were on the first scroll, which King Je·hoiʹa·kim of Judah burned up.

19987.label: Jeremiah 36:29
19987.text: And you should say against King Je·hoiʹa·kim of Judah, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “You have burned up this scroll and said, ‘Why have you written on it: “The king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land and empty it of man and beast”?’

19988.label: Jeremiah 36:30
19988.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says against King Je·hoiʹa·kim of Judah, ‘He will have no one to sit on the throne of David, and his dead body will be left exposed to the heat by day and the frost by night.

19989.label: Jeremiah 36:31
19989.text: I will call him and his descendants and his servants to account for their error, and I will bring on them and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem and on the men of Judah all the calamity that I have spoken against them, but they did not listen.’”’”

19990.label: Jeremiah 36:32
19990.text: Jeremiah then took another scroll and gave it to Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah, the secretary, and at Jeremiah’s dictation he wrote on it all the words of the scroll that King Je·hoiʹa·kim of Judah had burned in the fire. And many more words like those were added.

19991.label: Jeremiah 37:1
19991.text: And King Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Jo·siʹah began to reign in place of Co·niʹah the son of Je·hoiʹa·kim, for King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon made him king in the land of Judah.

19992.label: Jeremiah 37:2
19992.text: But he and his servants and the people of the land did not listen to the words of Jehovah spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.

19993.label: Jeremiah 37:3
19993.text: And King Zed·e·kiʹah sent Je·huʹcal the son of Shel·e·miʹah and Zeph·a·niʹah the son of Ma·a·seiʹah the priest to Jeremiah the prophet, saying: “Please pray in our behalf to Jehovah our God.”

19994.label: Jeremiah 37:4
19994.text: Jeremiah was moving about freely among the people, for they had not yet put him in prison.

19995.label: Jeremiah 37:5
19995.text: Now Pharʹaoh’s army had set out from Egypt, and the Chal·deʹans who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report about them. So they withdrew from against Jerusalem.

19996.label: Jeremiah 37:6
19996.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah the prophet, saying:

19997.label: Jeremiah 37:7
19997.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says, ‘This is what you should say to the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Look! The army of Pharʹaoh that is coming to assist you will have to go back to its land, Egypt.

19998.label: Jeremiah 37:8
19998.text: And the Chal·deʹans will come back and fight against this city and capture it and burn it with fire.”

19999.label: Jeremiah 37:9
19999.text: This is what Jehovah says, “Do not deceive yourselves by saying, ‘The Chal·deʹans will surely go away from against us,’ because they will not go away.

20000.label: Jeremiah 37:10
20000.text: Even if you were to strike down the entire army of the Chal·deʹans who are fighting against you and only their wounded men were left, they would still rise up from their tents and burn this city with fire.”’”

20001.label: Jeremiah 37:11
20001.text: When the Chal·deʹan army had withdrawn from against Jerusalem because of Pharʹaoh’s army,

20002.label: Jeremiah 37:12
20002.text: Jeremiah set out from Jerusalem to the land of Benjamin to receive his portion there among his people.

20003.label: Jeremiah 37:13
20003.text: But when he reached the Gate of Benjamin, the officer in charge of the guard, whose name was I·riʹjah the son of Shel·e·miʹah the son of Han·a·niʹah, seized Jeremiah the prophet and said: “You are deserting to the Chal·deʹans!”

20004.label: Jeremiah 37:14
20004.text: But Jeremiah said: “It is not true! I am not deserting to the Chal·deʹans.” But he did not listen to him. So I·riʹjah arrested Jeremiah and brought him in to the princes.

20005.label: Jeremiah 37:15
20005.text: The princes were furious with Jeremiah, and they beat him and imprisoned him in the house of Je·honʹa·than the secretary, which had been made into a prison.

20006.label: Jeremiah 37:16
20006.text: Jeremiah was put into the dungeon, into the vaulted rooms, and he remained there many days.

20007.label: Jeremiah 37:17
20007.text: Then King Zed·e·kiʹah sent for him, and the king secretly questioned him in his house. He asked, “Is there any word from Jehovah?” Jeremiah said, “There is!” and he continued, “You will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon!”

20008.label: Jeremiah 37:18
20008.text: Jeremiah also said to King Zed·e·kiʹah: “How have I sinned against you and against your servants and against this people, so that you have put me into the prison?

20009.label: Jeremiah 37:19
20009.text: Where, now, are your prophets who prophesied to you, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you and against this land’?

20010.label: Jeremiah 37:20
20010.text: Now listen, please, O my lord the king. May you grant, please, my request for favor. Do not send me back to the house of Je·honʹa·than the secretary, or I will die there.”

20011.label: Jeremiah 37:21
20011.text: So King Zed·e·kiʹah ordered that Jeremiah be put in custody in the Courtyard of the Guard, and he was given a round loaf of bread daily from the street of the bakers until all the bread in the city was gone. And Jeremiah remained in the Courtyard of the Guard.

20012.label: Jeremiah 38:1
20012.text: Now Sheph·a·tiʹah the son of Matʹtan, Ged·a·liʹah the son of Pashʹhur, Juʹcal the son of Shel·e·miʹah, and Pashʹhur the son of Mal·chiʹjah heard the words that Jeremiah was speaking to all the people, saying:

20013.label: Jeremiah 38:2
20013.text: “This is what Jehovah says, ‘The one who remains in this city will die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence. But the one who surrenders to the Chal·deʹans will keep living and will have his life as a spoil and live.’

20014.label: Jeremiah 38:3
20014.text: This is what Jehovah says, ‘This city will surely be handed over to the army of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.’”

20015.label: Jeremiah 38:4
20015.text: The princes said to the king: “Please have this man put to death, for this is how he is weakening the morale of the soldiers who are left in this city, as well as that of all the people, by speaking such words to them. For this man seeks, not the peace of this people, but their calamity.”

20016.label: Jeremiah 38:5
20016.text: King Zed·e·kiʹah replied: “Look! He is in your hands, for the king cannot do anything to stop you.”

20017.label: Jeremiah 38:6
20017.text: So they took Jeremiah and threw him into the cistern of Mal·chiʹjah the son of the king, which was in the Courtyard of the Guard. They let Jeremiah down by ropes. Now there was no water in the cistern, only mud, and Jeremiah began to sink down into the mud.

20018.label: Jeremiah 38:7
20018.text: Eʹbed-melʹech the E·thi·oʹpi·an, a eunuch in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah into the cistern. Now the king was sitting in the Gate of Benjamin,

20019.label: Jeremiah 38:8
20019.text: so Eʹbed-melʹech went out of the king’s house and spoke to the king, saying:

20020.label: Jeremiah 38:9
20020.text: “O my lord the king, what these men have done to Jeremiah the prophet is evil! They have thrown him into the cistern, and he will die there because of the famine, for there is no bread left in the city.”

20021.label: Jeremiah 38:10
20021.text: Then the king commanded Eʹbed-melʹech the E·thi·oʹpi·an: “Take 30 men with you from here, and pull Jeremiah the prophet up out of the cistern before he dies.”

20022.label: Jeremiah 38:11
20022.text: So Eʹbed-melʹech took the men with him and went into the king’s house to a place beneath the treasury, and they took from there some worn-out rags and worn-out pieces of cloth and let them down by ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.

20023.label: Jeremiah 38:12
20023.text: Then Eʹbed-melʹech the E·thi·oʹpi·an said to Jeremiah: “Please put the rags and the pieces of cloth between your armpits and the ropes.” Jeremiah did so,

20024.label: Jeremiah 38:13
20024.text: and they drew Jeremiah out with the ropes and pulled him up out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the Courtyard of the Guard.

20025.label: Jeremiah 38:14
20025.text: King Zed·e·kiʹah sent for Jeremiah the prophet to come to him at the third entrance, which is in the house of Jehovah, and the king said to Jeremiah: “I have something to ask of you. Do not hide anything from me.”

20026.label: Jeremiah 38:15
20026.text: Jeremiah then said to Zed·e·kiʹah: “If I tell you, you will certainly put me to death. And if I give you advice, you will not listen to me.”

20027.label: Jeremiah 38:16
20027.text: So King Zed·e·kiʹah secretly swore to Jeremiah, saying: “As surely as Jehovah is alive, who has given us this life, I will not put you to death, and I will not hand you over to these men who are seeking to take your life.”

20028.label: Jeremiah 38:17
20028.text: Jeremiah then said to Zed·e·kiʹah: “This is what Jehovah, the God of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you surrender to the princes of the king of Babylon, your life will be spared, and this city will not be burned with fire, and you and your household will be spared.

20029.label: Jeremiah 38:18
20029.text: But if you will not surrender to the princes of the king of Babylon, this city will be handed over to the Chal·deʹans, and they will burn it with fire, and you will not escape out of their hand.’”

20030.label: Jeremiah 38:19
20030.text: Then King Zed·e·kiʹah said to Jeremiah: “I am afraid of the Jews who have deserted to the Chal·deʹans, for if I am handed over to them, they may deal cruelly with me.”

20031.label: Jeremiah 38:20
20031.text: But Jeremiah said: “You will not be handed over to them. Obey, please, the voice of Jehovah in what I am telling you, and it will go well with you, and you will continue to live.

20032.label: Jeremiah 38:21
20032.text: But if you refuse to surrender, this is what Jehovah has revealed to me:

20033.label: Jeremiah 38:22
20033.text: Look! All the women remaining in the house of the king of Judah are being brought out to the princes of the king of Babylon, and they are saying,‘The men whom you trusted have deceived you and overcome you. They have caused your foot to sink into the mud. Now they have turned away in retreat.’

20034.label: Jeremiah 38:23
20034.text: And all your wives and your sons they are bringing out to the Chal·deʹans, and you will not escape out of their hand, but you will be seized by the king of Babylon, and because of you this city will be burned with fire.”

20035.label: Jeremiah 38:24
20035.text: Zed·e·kiʹah then said to Jeremiah: “Do not let anyone know about these things, so that you do not die.

20036.label: Jeremiah 38:25
20036.text: And if the princes hear that I have spoken with you and they come and say to you, ‘Tell us, please, what you said to the king. Do not hide anything from us, and we will not put you to death. What did the king say to you?’

20037.label: Jeremiah 38:26
20037.text: you must answer them, ‘I was making a request of the king, that he not send me back to the house of Je·honʹa·than to die there.’”

20038.label: Jeremiah 38:27
20038.text: In time all the princes came in to Jeremiah and questioned him. He told them everything that the king had commanded him to say. So they said no more to him, for no one had heard the conversation.

20039.label: Jeremiah 38:28
20039.text: Until the day that Jerusalem was captured, Jeremiah remained in the Courtyard of the Guard; he was still there when Jerusalem was captured.

20040.label: Jeremiah 39:1
20040.text: In the ninth year of King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah, in the tenth month, King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon and all his army came to Jerusalem, and they besieged it.

20041.label: Jeremiah 39:2
20041.text: In the 11th year of Zed·e·kiʹah, in the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, they broke through the city wall.

20042.label: Jeremiah 39:3
20042.text: And all the princes of the king of Babylon went in and sat down in the Middle Gate, namely, Nerʹgal-shar·eʹzer the Samʹgar, Neʹbo-sarʹse·chim the Rabʹsa·ris, Nerʹgal-shar·eʹzer the Rabʹmag, and all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

20043.label: Jeremiah 39:4
20043.text: When King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah and all the soldiers saw them, they fled, going out of the city by night by way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the double wall, and they continued by the way of the Arʹa·bah.

20044.label: Jeremiah 39:5
20044.text: But the Chal·deʹan army chased after them, and they overtook Zed·e·kiʹah in the desert plains of Jerʹi·cho. They captured him and brought him up to King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon at Ribʹlah in the land of Haʹmath, where he passed sentence on him.

20045.label: Jeremiah 39:6
20045.text: The king of Babylon had the sons of Zed·e·kiʹah slaughtered before his eyes there at Ribʹlah, and the king of Babylon had all the nobles of Judah slaughtered.

20046.label: Jeremiah 39:7
20046.text: Then he blinded the eyes of Zed·e·kiʹah, after which he bound him with copper fetters to bring him to Babylon.

20047.label: Jeremiah 39:8
20047.text: The Chal·deʹans then burned down the king’s house and the houses of the people, and they tore down the walls of Jerusalem.

20048.label: Jeremiah 39:9
20048.text: Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard took into exile to Babylon the rest of the people who were left in the city, the deserters who had defected to him, and anyone who remained.

20049.label: Jeremiah 39:10
20049.text: But Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard left in the land of Judah some of the poorest people, those who had nothing at all. On that day he also gave them vineyards and fields to work.

20050.label: Jeremiah 39:11
20050.text: Now King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon gave Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard these orders concerning Jeremiah:

20051.label: Jeremiah 39:12
20051.text: “Take him and look after him; do him no harm, and grant whatever he asks of you.”

20052.label: Jeremiah 39:13
20052.text: So Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard, Neb·u·shazʹban the Rabʹsa·ris, Nerʹgal-shar·eʹzer the Rabʹmag, and all the principal men of the king of Babylon sent

20053.label: Jeremiah 39:14
20053.text: and had Jeremiah taken out of the Courtyard of the Guard and handed him over to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan to be brought to his house. So he lived among the people.

20054.label: Jeremiah 39:15
20054.text: While Jeremiah was confined in the Courtyard of the Guard, the word of Jehovah came to him, saying:

20055.label: Jeremiah 39:16
20055.text: “Go and tell Eʹbed-melʹech the E·thi·oʹpi·an, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “Here I am fulfilling my words on this city for calamity and not for good, and in that day you will see it happen.”’

20056.label: Jeremiah 39:17
20056.text: “‘But I will rescue you in that day,’ declares Jehovah, ‘and you will not be handed over to the men you fear.’

20057.label: Jeremiah 39:18
20057.text: “‘For I will surely provide you with escape, and you will not fall by the sword. You will have your life as a spoil, because you trusted in me,’ declares Jehovah.”

20058.label: Jeremiah 40:1
20058.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah after Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard let him go free from Raʹmah. He had taken him there bound with handcuffs, and he was among all the exiles of Jerusalem and of Judah who were being deported to Babylon.

20059.label: Jeremiah 40:2
20059.text: Then the chief of the guard took Jeremiah and said to him: “Jehovah your God foretold this calamity against this place,

20060.label: Jeremiah 40:3
20060.text: and Jehovah has brought it about just as he said, because you people sinned against Jehovah and did not obey his voice. That is why this has happened to you.

20061.label: Jeremiah 40:4
20061.text: Now I am releasing you today from the handcuffs that were on your hands. If it seems good to you to come with me to Babylon, come, and I will look after you. But if you do not want to come with me to Babylon, do not come. See! The entire land is before you. Go wherever you choose.”

20062.label: Jeremiah 40:5
20062.text: While Jeremiah still had not turned back, Neb·uʹzar·adʹan said: “Return to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the cities of Judah, and stay with him among the people; or go wherever you choose.” The chief of the guard then gave him a food allowance and a gift and let him go.

20063.label: Jeremiah 40:6
20063.text: So Jeremiah went to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam at Mizʹpah and stayed with him among the people who were left in the land.

20064.label: Jeremiah 40:7
20064.text: In time all the army chiefs who were in the field with their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam over the land and that he had appointed him over the men, women, and children from the poor people of the land who had not been deported to Babylon.

20065.label: Jeremiah 40:8
20065.text: So they came to Ged·a·liʹah at Mizʹpah. They were Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah, Jo·haʹnan and Jonʹa·than the sons of Ka·reʹah, Se·raiʹah the son of Tan·huʹmeth, the sons of Eʹphai the Ne·tophʹa·thite, and Jez·a·niʹah the son of the Ma·acʹa·thite, together with their men.

20066.label: Jeremiah 40:9
20066.text: Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan swore an oath to them and to their men, saying: “Do not be afraid of serving the Chal·deʹans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.

20067.label: Jeremiah 40:10
20067.text: As for me, I will stay in Mizʹpah to represent you to the Chal·deʹans who come to us. But you should gather wine, summer fruits, and oil and put them in your storage containers and settle in the cities that you have taken over.”

20068.label: Jeremiah 40:11
20068.text: And all the Jews who were in Moʹab, Amʹmon, and Eʹdom, as well as those who were in all the other lands, also heard that the king of Babylon had let a remnant stay in Judah and that he had appointed over them Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan.

20069.label: Jeremiah 40:12
20069.text: So all the Jews began returning from all the places to which they had been dispersed, and they came into the land of Judah, to Ged·a·liʹah at Mizʹpah. And they gathered wine and summer fruits in very great quantity.

20070.label: Jeremiah 40:13
20070.text: Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the army chiefs who were in the field came to Ged·a·liʹah at Mizʹpah.

20071.label: Jeremiah 40:14
20071.text: They said to him: “Do you not know that Baʹa·lis, the king of the Amʹmon·ites, has sent Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah to kill you?” But Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam did not believe them.

20072.label: Jeremiah 40:15
20072.text: Then Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah secretly told Ged·a·liʹah in Mizʹpah: “I want to go and strike down Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah, and no one will know. Why should he kill you, and why should all the people of Judah who have gathered to you be scattered and the remnant of Judah perish?”

20073.label: Jeremiah 40:16
20073.text: But Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam said to Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah: “Do not do this, for what you are saying concerning Ishʹma·el is a lie.”

20074.label: Jeremiah 41:1
20074.text: In the seventh month Ishʹma·el son of Neth·a·niʹah son of E·lishʹa·ma, who was of the royal line and one of the principal men of the king, came with ten other men to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam at Mizʹpah. As they were eating a meal together in Mizʹpah,

20075.label: Jeremiah 41:2
20075.text: Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah and the ten men who were with him rose up and struck down Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan with the sword. So he put to death the one whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.

20076.label: Jeremiah 41:3
20076.text: Ishʹma·el also struck down all the Jews who were with Ged·a·liʹah in Mizʹpah, as well as the Chal·deʹan soldiers who were there.

20077.label: Jeremiah 41:4
20077.text: On the second day after Ged·a·liʹah had been put to death, before anyone knew about it,

20078.label: Jeremiah 41:5
20078.text: there came 80 men from Sheʹchem, from Shiʹloh, and from Sa·marʹi·a. Their beards were shaved off, their garments were ripped apart, they had cut themselves, and they had grain offerings and frankincense in their hand to bring to the house of Jehovah.

20079.label: Jeremiah 41:6
20079.text: So Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah went out from Mizʹpah to meet them, weeping as he walked along. When he encountered them, he said to them: “Come to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam.”

20080.label: Jeremiah 41:7
20080.text: But when they came into the city, Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah and his men slaughtered them and threw them into the cistern.

20081.label: Jeremiah 41:8
20081.text: But there were ten men among them who said to Ishʹma·el: “Do not put us to death, for we have hidden stores of wheat, barley, oil, and honey in the field.” So he refrained from putting them to death along with their brothers.

20082.label: Jeremiah 41:9
20082.text: Now Ishʹma·el threw all the carcasses of the men he had killed into a great cistern, the one that King Aʹsa had made because of King Baʹa·sha of Israel. This was the cistern that Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah filled with the slain men.

20083.label: Jeremiah 41:10
20083.text: Ishʹma·el took captive all the rest of the people in Mizʹpah, including the daughters of the king and all the people left in Mizʹpah, whom Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard had put in the custody of Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam. Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah took them captive and went off to cross over to the Amʹmon·ites.

20084.label: Jeremiah 41:11
20084.text: When Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the army chiefs who were with him heard about all the evil that Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah had done,

20085.label: Jeremiah 41:12
20085.text: they took all the men and went off to fight against Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah, and they found him by the great waters in Gibʹe·on.

20086.label: Jeremiah 41:13
20086.text: All the people who were with Ishʹma·el rejoiced when they saw Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the army chiefs with him.

20087.label: Jeremiah 41:14
20087.text: Then all the people whom Ishʹma·el had taken captive from Mizʹpah turned around and went back with Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah.

20088.label: Jeremiah 41:15
20088.text: But Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah and eight of his men escaped from Jo·haʹnan and went to the Amʹmon·ites.

20089.label: Jeremiah 41:16
20089.text: Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the army chiefs who were with him took with them the rest of the people from Mizʹpah, those whom they had rescued from Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah after he had struck down Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam. They brought the men, the soldiers, the women, the children, and the court officials back from Gibʹe·on.

20090.label: Jeremiah 41:17
20090.text: So they went and stayed in the lodging place of Chimʹham next to Bethʹle·hem, intending to go on into Egypt

20091.label: Jeremiah 41:18
20091.text: because of the Chal·deʹans. For they had become afraid of them, since Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah had struck down Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.

20092.label: Jeremiah 42:1
20092.text: Then all the army chiefs, and Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah, Jez·a·niʹah the son of Ho·shaiʹah, and all the people, from the least to the greatest, approached

20093.label: Jeremiah 42:2
20093.text: and said to Jeremiah the prophet: “Hear, please, our request for favor, and pray in our behalf to Jehovah your God, in behalf of all this remnant, for just a few of many are left, as you can see.

20094.label: Jeremiah 42:3
20094.text: May Jehovah your God tell us the way we should walk and what we should do.”

20095.label: Jeremiah 42:4
20095.text: Jeremiah the prophet replied to them: “I have heard you, and I am praying to Jehovah your God according to your request; and every word that Jehovah answers you, I will tell you. I will not hold back a word from you.”

20096.label: Jeremiah 42:5
20096.text: They replied to Jeremiah: “May Jehovah be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not do exactly as Jehovah your God instructs us through you.

20097.label: Jeremiah 42:6
20097.text: Whether good or bad, we will obey the voice of Jehovah our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it may go well with us because we obey the voice of Jehovah our God.”

20098.label: Jeremiah 42:7
20098.text: Now ten days later the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah.

20099.label: Jeremiah 42:8
20099.text: So he called for Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and for all the army chiefs who were with him and for all the people, from the least to the greatest.

20100.label: Jeremiah 42:9
20100.text: He said to them: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says, to whom you sent me to present your request for favor before him:

20101.label: Jeremiah 42:10
20101.text: ‘If you will indeed remain in this land, then I will build you up and not tear you down, and I will plant you and not uproot you, for I will feel regret over the calamity I have caused you.

20102.label: Jeremiah 42:11
20102.text: Do not be afraid because of the king of Babylon, whom you fear.’ “‘Do not be afraid because of him,’ declares Jehovah, ‘for I am with you, to save you and to rescue you out of his hand.

20103.label: Jeremiah 42:12
20103.text: And I will show you mercy, and he will have mercy on you and return you to your own land.

20104.label: Jeremiah 42:13
20104.text: “‘But if you say, “No, we will not remain in this land!” and you disobey the voice of Jehovah your God

20105.label: Jeremiah 42:14
20105.text: by saying, “No, we will go instead to the land of Egypt, where we will not see war or hear the sound of the horn or hunger for bread; there is where we will live,”

20106.label: Jeremiah 42:15
20106.text: then hear the word of Jehovah, O remnant of Judah. This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “If you are absolutely determined to go to Egypt and you go there to reside,

20107.label: Jeremiah 42:16
20107.text: then the very sword you are afraid of will catch up with you there in the land of Egypt, and the very famine you fear will follow after you to Egypt, and there you will die.

20108.label: Jeremiah 42:17
20108.text: And all the men who are determined to go to Egypt to reside there will die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence. None of them will survive or escape the calamity that I will bring on them.”’

20109.label: Jeremiah 42:18
20109.text: “For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Just as my anger and my wrath were poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my wrath will be poured out on you if you go to Egypt, and you will become a curse, an object of horror, a malediction, and a reproach, and you will never again see this place.’

20110.label: Jeremiah 42:19
20110.text: “Jehovah has spoken against you, O remnant of Judah. Do not go to Egypt. You should know for a certainty that I have warned you today

20111.label: Jeremiah 42:20
20111.text: that your error will cost you your lives. For you sent me to Jehovah your God, saying, ‘Pray in our behalf to Jehovah our God, and tell us everything that Jehovah our God says, and we will do it.’

20112.label: Jeremiah 42:21
20112.text: And I told you today, but you will not obey the voice of Jehovah your God or do anything he sent me to tell you.

20113.label: Jeremiah 42:22
20113.text: Therefore, know for a certainty that by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence you will die in the place where you desire to go and reside.”

20114.label: Jeremiah 43:1
20114.text: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all these words from Jehovah their God, every single word that Jehovah their God had sent him to tell them,

20115.label: Jeremiah 43:2
20115.text: Az·a·riʹah the son of Ho·shaiʹah, Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah, and all the presumptuous men said to Jeremiah: “What you are saying is a lie! Jehovah our God has not sent you to say, ‘Do not go to Egypt to reside there.’

20116.label: Jeremiah 43:3
20116.text: But Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah is inciting you against us to hand us over to the Chal·deʹans, to put us to death or to take us into exile in Babylon.”

20117.label: Jeremiah 43:4
20117.text: So Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the army chiefs and all the people disobeyed the voice of Jehovah to remain in the land of Judah.

20118.label: Jeremiah 43:5
20118.text: Instead, Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the army chiefs took with them all the remnant of Judah who had returned to reside in the land of Judah from all the nations where they had been dispersed.

20119.label: Jeremiah 43:6
20119.text: They took the men, the women, the children, the daughters of the king, and everyone whom Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard had left with Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan, as well as Jeremiah the prophet and Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah.

20120.label: Jeremiah 43:7
20120.text: And they went into the land of Egypt, for they did not obey the voice of Jehovah, and they went as far as Tahʹpan·hes.

20121.label: Jeremiah 43:8
20121.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to Jeremiah in Tahʹpan·hes, saying:

20122.label: Jeremiah 43:9
20122.text: “Take in your hand large stones, and hide them in the mortar in the brick terrace at the entrance of the house of Pharʹaoh in Tahʹpan·hes, with the Jewish men looking on.

20123.label: Jeremiah 43:10
20123.text: Then say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “Here I am sending for Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and I will place his throne right above these stones that I have hidden, and he will extend his royal tent over them.

20124.label: Jeremiah 43:11
20124.text: And he will come in and strike the land of Egypt. Whoever is meant for deadly plague will be for deadly plague, and whoever is meant for captivity will be for captivity, and whoever is meant for the sword will be for the sword.

20125.label: Jeremiah 43:12
20125.text: And I will set the houses of the gods of Egypt on fire, and he will burn them and lead them captive. He will wrap the land of Egypt around himself just as a shepherd wraps himself in his garment, and he will depart from there in peace.

20126.label: Jeremiah 43:13
20126.text: And he will break to pieces the pillars of Beth-sheʹmesh in the land of Egypt, and he will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.”’”

20127.label: Jeremiah 44:1
20127.text: The word that came to Jeremiah for all the Jews living in the land of Egypt, those living in Migʹdol, Tahʹpan·hes, Noph, and the land of Pathʹros, saying:

20128.label: Jeremiah 44:2
20128.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘You have seen all the calamity that I brought on Jerusalem and on all the cities of Judah, and today they are in ruins, without an inhabitant.

20129.label: Jeremiah 44:3
20129.text: It is because of the evil things that they did to offend me by going and making sacrifices and serving other gods whom they had not known, neither you nor your forefathers.

20130.label: Jeremiah 44:4
20130.text: I kept sending all my servants the prophets to you, sending them again and again, saying: “Please do not do this detestable thing that I hate.”

20131.label: Jeremiah 44:5
20131.text: But they did not listen or incline their ear to turn back from their evil by not making sacrifices to other gods.

20132.label: Jeremiah 44:6
20132.text: So my wrath and my anger were poured out and burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, and they became a ruin and a wasteland, as they are today.’

20133.label: Jeremiah 44:7
20133.text: “And now this is what Jehovah, the God of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Why are you causing a great calamity to yourselves, so that every man and woman, child and infant, will perish from Judah, leaving you without a remnant?

20134.label: Jeremiah 44:8
20134.text: Why should you offend me with the works of your hands by sacrificing to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to reside? You will perish and become an object of cursing and a reproach among all the nations of the earth.

20135.label: Jeremiah 44:9
20135.text: Have you forgotten the wicked deeds of your forefathers and the wicked deeds of the kings of Judah and the wicked deeds of their wives, as well as your own wicked deeds and the wicked deeds of your wives, that were done in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

20136.label: Jeremiah 44:10
20136.text: Down to this day they have not humbled themselves, they have shown no fear, nor have they walked in my law and my statutes that I set before you and your forefathers.’

20137.label: Jeremiah 44:11
20137.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Here I am determined to bring calamity on you, to destroy all Judah.

20138.label: Jeremiah 44:12
20138.text: And I will take the remnant of Judah who were determined to go to the land of Egypt to reside there, and they will all perish in the land of Egypt. They will fall by the sword and perish by the famine; from the least to the greatest, they will die by the sword and by famine. And they will become a curse, an object of horror, a malediction, and a reproach.

20139.label: Jeremiah 44:13
20139.text: I will punish those dwelling in the land of Egypt just as I punished Jerusalem, with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence.

20140.label: Jeremiah 44:14
20140.text: And the remnant of Judah who have gone to reside in the land of Egypt will not escape or survive to return to the land of Judah. They will long to return and dwell there, but they will not return, except for a few escapees.’”

20141.label: Jeremiah 44:15
20141.text: All the men who knew that their wives had been making sacrifices to other gods and all the wives who were standing there, who formed a large group, and all the people who were living in the land of Egypt, in Pathʹros, answered Jeremiah:

20142.label: Jeremiah 44:16
20142.text: “We will not listen to the word that you have spoken to us in the name of Jehovah.

20143.label: Jeremiah 44:17
20143.text: Instead, we will surely carry out every word that our mouths have spoken, to make sacrifices to the Queen of Heaven and to pour out drink offerings to her, just as we, our forefathers, our kings, and our princes did in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem when we were satisfied with bread and were well-off, when we saw no calamity at all.

20144.label: Jeremiah 44:18
20144.text: From the time we quit making sacrifices to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything and have perished by the sword and by the famine.”

20145.label: Jeremiah 44:19
20145.text: The women added: “And when we were making sacrifices to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, was it without the consent of our husbands that we made sacrificial cakes shaped in her image and we poured out drink offerings to her?”

20146.label: Jeremiah 44:20
20146.text: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, to the men and their wives and to all the people who were speaking to him:

20147.label: Jeremiah 44:21
20147.text: “The sacrifices that you, your forefathers, your kings, your princes, and the people of the land made in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem —Jehovah remembered them and they came up into his heart!

20148.label: Jeremiah 44:22
20148.text: Finally Jehovah could no longer put up with your evil practices and the detestable things you had done, and your land became a devastated place, an object of horror and cursing, without an inhabitant, as it is today.

20149.label: Jeremiah 44:23
20149.text: It is because you have made these sacrifices and because you have sinned against Jehovah by not obeying the voice of Jehovah and following his law, his statutes, and his reminders that this calamity has come upon you, as is the case today.”

20150.label: Jeremiah 44:24
20150.text: Jeremiah continued to say to all the people and to all the women: “Hear the word of Jehovah, all you of Judah who are in the land of Egypt.

20151.label: Jeremiah 44:25
20151.text: This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘What you and your wives have spoken with your mouths, you have fulfilled with your hands, for you said: “We will surely carry out our vows to make sacrifices to the Queen of Heaven and to pour out drink offerings to her.” You women will surely carry out your vows and perform your vows.’

20152.label: Jeremiah 44:26
20152.text: “Therefore hear the word of Jehovah, all you of Judah who are living in the land of Egypt: ‘“Here I swear by my own great name,” says Jehovah, “that my name will no longer be called on in an oath by any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt who says, ‘As surely as the Sovereign Lord Jehovah is alive!’

20153.label: Jeremiah 44:27
20153.text: Now I am watching over them to bring calamity and not something good; all the men of Judah in the land of Egypt will perish by the sword and by the famine, until they cease to exist.

20154.label: Jeremiah 44:28
20154.text: Only a few will escape the sword and return from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah. Then all the remnant of Judah who came to the land of Egypt to reside there will know whose word has come true, mine or theirs!”’”

20155.label: Jeremiah 44:29
20155.text: “‘And this is the sign for you,’ declares Jehovah, ‘that I will punish you in this place, so that you will know that my words promising calamity against you will surely come true.

20156.label: Jeremiah 44:30
20156.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Here I am giving Pharʹaoh Hophʹra, the king of Egypt, into the hand of his enemies and of those seeking to take his life, just as I gave King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah into the hand of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon, who was his enemy and who sought to take his life.”’”

20157.label: Jeremiah 45:1
20157.text: This is the word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah when he wrote in a book these words dictated by Jeremiah in the fourth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah:

20158.label: Jeremiah 45:2
20158.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says concerning you, Barʹuch,

20159.label: Jeremiah 45:3
20159.text: ‘You have said: “Woe to me, for Jehovah has added grief to my pain! I am weary from my groaning, and I have found no resting-place.”’

20160.label: Jeremiah 45:4
20160.text: “You should say to him, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Look! What I have built up I am tearing down, and what I have planted I am uprooting—the entire land.

20161.label: Jeremiah 45:5
20161.text: But you are seeking great things for yourself. Stop seeking such things.”’ “‘For I am about to bring a calamity on all flesh,’ declares Jehovah, ‘and wherever you may go, I will grant you your life as a spoil.’”

20162.label: Jeremiah 46:1
20162.text: This is the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations:

20163.label: Jeremiah 46:2
20163.text: For Egypt, concerning the army of Pharʹaoh Neʹcho the king of Egypt, who was along the Eu·phraʹtes River and was defeated at Carʹche·mish by King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon in the fourth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah:

20164.label: Jeremiah 46:3
20164.text: “Prepare your bucklers and large shields,And advance to the battle.

20165.label: Jeremiah 46:4
20165.text: Harness the horses and mount, you horsemen. Take your positions and put on your helmets. Polish the lances and put on your coats of mail.

20166.label: Jeremiah 46:5
20166.text: ‘Why do I see them terror-stricken? They are retreating, their warriors are crushed. They have fled in panic, their warriors have not turned around. There is terror all around,’ declares Jehovah.

20167.label: Jeremiah 46:6
20167.text: ‘The swift cannot flee, and the warriors cannot escape. In the north, by the bank of the Eu·phraʹtes River,They have stumbled and fallen.’

20168.label: Jeremiah 46:7
20168.text: Who is this coming up like the Nile River,Like the rivers of surging waters?

20169.label: Jeremiah 46:8
20169.text: Egypt comes up just like the Nile River, Like rivers of surging waters,And it says, ‘I will go up and cover the earth. I will destroy the city and those inhabiting it.’

20170.label: Jeremiah 46:9
20170.text: Go up, you horses! Drive madly, you chariots! Let the warriors advance,Cush and Put, who handle the shield, And the Luʹdim, who handle and bend the bow.

20171.label: Jeremiah 46:10
20171.text: “That day belongs to the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, the day of vengeance for taking revenge on his adversaries. And the sword will devour and satisfy itself and take its fill of their blood, for the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, has a sacrifice in the land of the north by the Eu·phraʹtes River.

20172.label: Jeremiah 46:11
20172.text: Go up to Gilʹe·ad to get balsam, O virgin daughter of Egypt. In vain you have multiplied your remedies,For there is no cure for you.

20173.label: Jeremiah 46:12
20173.text: The nations have heard your dishonor, And your outcry has filled the land. For warrior stumbles against warrior,And they both fall down together.”

20174.label: Jeremiah 46:13
20174.text: This is the word that Jehovah spoke to Jeremiah the prophet regarding the coming of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon to strike down the land of Egypt:

20175.label: Jeremiah 46:14
20175.text: “Declare it in Egypt, proclaim it in Migʹdol. Proclaim it in Noph and in Tahʹpan·hes. Say, ‘Take your positions and prepare yourselves,For a sword will devour all around you.

20176.label: Jeremiah 46:15
20176.text: Why have your powerful men been swept away? They did not stand their ground,For Jehovah has pushed them down.

20177.label: Jeremiah 46:16
20177.text: In great numbers they are stumbling and falling. They are saying to one another: “Get up! Let us return to our people and our homelandBecause of the cruel sword.”’

20178.label: Jeremiah 46:17
20178.text: There they have proclaimed,‘Pharʹaoh king of Egypt is just a meaningless noiseWho has let the opportunity pass by.’

20179.label: Jeremiah 46:18
20179.text: ‘As surely as I am alive,’ declares the King, whose name is Jehovah of armies,‘He will come in like Taʹbor among the mountainsAnd like Carʹmel by the sea.

20180.label: Jeremiah 46:19
20180.text: Prepare your baggage for exile,O daughter inhabiting Egypt. For Noph will become an object of horror;It will be set afire and left without an inhabitant.

20181.label: Jeremiah 46:20
20181.text: Egypt is like a good-looking heifer,But stinging flies will come against her from the north.

20182.label: Jeremiah 46:21
20182.text: Even her hired soldiers in her midst are like fattened calves,But they have also turned back and fled together. They could not stand their ground, For the day of their disaster has come upon them,Their time of reckoning.’

20183.label: Jeremiah 46:22
20183.text: ‘Her sound is like that of a slithering serpent,For they come after her in force, with axes,Like men cutting down trees.

20184.label: Jeremiah 46:23
20184.text: They will cut down her forest,’ declares Jehovah, ‘though it seemed impenetrable. For they are more numerous than locusts, without number.

20185.label: Jeremiah 46:24
20185.text: The daughter of Egypt will be put to shame. She will be handed over to the people of the north.’

20186.label: Jeremiah 46:25
20186.text: “Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Now I am turning my attention to Aʹmon from No, to Pharʹaoh, to Egypt, to her gods, and to her kings—yes, to Pharʹaoh and all those trusting in him.’

20187.label: Jeremiah 46:26
20187.text: “‘And I will hand them over to those seeking to take their life, to King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon and his servants. But afterward she will be inhabited as in times past,’ declares Jehovah.

20188.label: Jeremiah 46:27
20188.text: ‘As for you, do not be afraid, my servant Jacob,And do not be terrified, O Israel. For I will save you from far awayAnd your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return and be calm and undisturbed,With no one to make them afraid.

20189.label: Jeremiah 46:28
20189.text: So do not be afraid, my servant Jacob,’ declares Jehovah, ‘for I am with you. I will make an extermination among all the nations where I dispersed you, But you I will not exterminate. I will discipline you to the proper degree, But I will by no means leave you unpunished.’”

20190.label: Jeremiah 47:1
20190.text: This is the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Phi·lisʹtines, before Pharʹaoh struck down Gazʹa.

20191.label: Jeremiah 47:2
20191.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Look! Waters are coming from the north. They will become a flooding torrent. And they will flood the land and everything in it,The city and those inhabiting it. The men will cry out,And everyone dwelling in the land will wail.

20192.label: Jeremiah 47:3
20192.text: At the sound of the pounding hooves of his stallions,At the rattling of his war chariotsAnd the rumbling of his wheels,Fathers will not even turn around for their sons,For their hands fall limp,

20193.label: Jeremiah 47:4
20193.text: Because the day that is coming will destroy all the Phi·lisʹtines; It will cut off from Tyre and Siʹdon every remaining ally. For Jehovah will destroy the Phi·lisʹtines,Who are the remaining ones from the island of Caphʹtor.

20194.label: Jeremiah 47:5
20194.text: Baldness will come to Gazʹa. Ashʹke·lon has been silenced. O remnant of their valley plain, How long will you keep making cuts on yourself?

20195.label: Jeremiah 47:6
20195.text: Ah! The sword of Jehovah! How long will you not be quiet? Go back into your sheath. Take your rest and be silent.

20196.label: Jeremiah 47:7
20196.text: How can it be quietWhen Jehovah has given it a command? Against Ashʹke·lon and the seacoast, There is where he has assigned it.”

20197.label: Jeremiah 48:1
20197.text: For Moʹab, this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Neʹbo, for she has been destroyed! Kir·i·a·thaʹim has been put to shame and captured. The secure refuge has been put to shame and shattered.

20198.label: Jeremiah 48:2
20198.text: They no longer praise Moʹab. In Heshʹbon they have plotted her downfall: ‘Come, let us put an end to her as a nation.’ You too, O Madʹmen, should keep silent,For the sword is following you.

20199.label: Jeremiah 48:3
20199.text: There is the sound of an outcry from Hor·o·naʹim, Of destruction and great collapse.

20200.label: Jeremiah 48:4
20200.text: Moʹab has been broken down. Her little ones cry out.

20201.label: Jeremiah 48:5
20201.text: On the ascent of Luʹhith they weep continually as they climb. And on the way down from Hor·o·naʹim they hear cries of distress over the catastrophe.

20202.label: Jeremiah 48:6
20202.text: Flee, escape for your lives! You must become like a juniper tree in the wilderness.

20203.label: Jeremiah 48:7
20203.text: Because you trust in your works and in your treasures,You will also be captured. And Cheʹmosh will go into exile,Together with his priests and his princes.

20204.label: Jeremiah 48:8
20204.text: The destroyer will come in on every city,And no city will escape. The valley will perish,And the level land will be annihilated, just as Jehovah has said.

20205.label: Jeremiah 48:9
20205.text: Set up a marker for Moʹab,For as she falls into ruins she will flee,And her cities will become an object of horror,Without an inhabitant.

20206.label: Jeremiah 48:10
20206.text: Cursed is the one who carries out the mission of Jehovah neglectfully! Cursed is the one who holds back his sword from bloodshed!

20207.label: Jeremiah 48:11
20207.text: The Moʹab·ites have been undisturbed since their youth,Like wine that has settled on the dregs. They have not been poured from one vessel into another,And they have never gone into exile. That is why their taste has remained the same,And their aroma has not changed.

20208.label: Jeremiah 48:12
20208.text: “‘Therefore look! the days are coming,’ declares Jehovah, ‘when I will send men to overturn them. They will turn them over and empty out their vessels, and they will smash their large jars to pieces.

20209.label: Jeremiah 48:13
20209.text: And the Moʹab·ites will be ashamed of Cheʹmosh, just as the house of Israel is ashamed of Bethʹel, which was their confidence.

20210.label: Jeremiah 48:14
20210.text: How dare you say: “We are mighty warriors, ready for battle”?’

20211.label: Jeremiah 48:15
20211.text: ‘Moʹab has been destroyed,Her cities have been invaded, And their choicest young men have been slaughtered,’ Declares the King, whose name is Jehovah of armies.

20212.label: Jeremiah 48:16
20212.text: The disaster on the Moʹab·ites is coming soon,And their downfall is approaching quickly.

20213.label: Jeremiah 48:17
20213.text: All those around them will have to sympathize with them,All those knowing their name. Tell them: ‘O how the mighty rod has been broken, the staff of beauty!’

20214.label: Jeremiah 48:18
20214.text: Come down from your glory,And sit down in thirst, O daughter inhabiting Diʹbon, For the destroyer of Moʹab has come against you,And he will bring your fortified places to ruin.

20215.label: Jeremiah 48:19
20215.text: Stand by the road and watch, inhabitant of A·roʹer. Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping, ‘What has happened?’

20216.label: Jeremiah 48:20
20216.text: Moʹab has been put to shame and struck with terror. Wail and cry out. Proclaim in Arʹnon that Moʹab has been destroyed.

20217.label: Jeremiah 48:21
20217.text: “Judgment has come to the level land, against Hoʹlon, Jaʹhaz, and Mephʹa·ath;

20220.label: Jeremiah 48:24
20220.text: against Keʹri·oth and Bozʹrah; and against all the cities of the land of Moʹab, those far and near.

20221.label: Jeremiah 48:25
20221.text: ‘The strength of Moʹab has been cut down;His arm has been broken,’ declares Jehovah.

20222.label: Jeremiah 48:26
20222.text: ‘Make him drunk, for he has exalted himself against Jehovah. Moʹab wallows in his vomit,And he is an object of ridicule.

20223.label: Jeremiah 48:27
20223.text: Was Israel not an object of ridicule to you? Was he found among thieves,So that you should shake your head and speak against him?

20224.label: Jeremiah 48:28
20224.text: Leave the cities and live on the crag, inhabitants of Moʹab,And become like a dove that nests along the sides of the gorge.’”

20225.label: Jeremiah 48:29
20225.text: “We have heard about the pride of Moʹab—he is very haughty—About his arrogance, his pride, his haughtiness, and the loftiness of his heart.”

20226.label: Jeremiah 48:30
20226.text: “‘I know his fury,’ declares Jehovah,‘But his empty talk will come to nothing. They will do nothing.

20227.label: Jeremiah 48:31
20227.text: That is why I will wail over Moʹab,For all Moʹab I will cry outAnd moan for the men of Kir-heʹres.

20228.label: Jeremiah 48:32
20228.text: With more than the weeping for Jaʹzer, I will weep for you, O vine of Sibʹmah. Your flourishing shoots have crossed the sea. To the sea, to Jaʹzer, they have reached. Upon your summer fruit and your grape harvestThe destroyer has descended.

20229.label: Jeremiah 48:33
20229.text: Rejoicing and joyfulness have been removed from the orchardAnd from the land of Moʹab. I have caused the wine to stop flowing from the winepress. No one will be treading with shouts of joy. The shouting will be different shouting.’”

20230.label: Jeremiah 48:34
