20230.text: “‘There is an outcry from Heshʹbon clear to E·le·aʹleh. They raise their voice clear to Jaʹhaz, From Zoʹar to Hor·o·naʹim to Egʹlath-she·liʹshi·yah. Even the waters of Nimʹrim will become desolate.

20231.label: Jeremiah 48:35
20231.text: I will cause to cease from Moʹab,’ declares Jehovah,‘The one bringing an offering on the high placeAnd the one making sacrifices to his god.

20232.label: Jeremiah 48:36
20232.text: That is why my heart will moan for Moʹab like a flute, And my heart will moan for the men of Kir-heʹres like a flute. For the wealth he has produced will perish.

20233.label: Jeremiah 48:37
20233.text: For every head is bald, And every beard is clipped. There are cuts on every hand, And there is sackcloth on their hips!’”

20234.label: Jeremiah 48:38
20234.text: “‘On all the roofs of MoʹabAnd in all her public squares,There is nothing but wailing. For I have broken MoʹabLike a discarded jar,’ declares Jehovah.

20235.label: Jeremiah 48:39
20235.text: ‘How she is terrified! Wail! How Moʹab has turned his back in shame! Moʹab has become an object of ridicule,Something terrifying to all those around him.’”

20236.label: Jeremiah 48:40
20236.text: “For this is what Jehovah says: ‘Look! Just like an eagle that swoops down, He will spread his wings over Moʹab.

20237.label: Jeremiah 48:41
20237.text: The towns will be captured,And her strongholds will be seized. In that day the heart of Moʹab’s warriorsWill be like the heart of a woman in childbirth.’”

20238.label: Jeremiah 48:42
20238.text: “‘And Moʹab will be annihilated from being a people, For it is against Jehovah that he has exalted himself.

20239.label: Jeremiah 48:43
20239.text: Terror and the pit and the trap are before you,O inhabitant of Moʹab,’ declares Jehovah.

20240.label: Jeremiah 48:44
20240.text: ‘Anyone fleeing the terror will fall into the pit,And anyone coming up from the pit will be caught in the trap.’ ‘For I will bring on Moʹab the year of their punishment,’ declares Jehovah.

20241.label: Jeremiah 48:45
20241.text: ‘In the shadow of Heshʹbon, those fleeing stand powerless. For a fire will come out of HeshʹbonAnd a flame from within Siʹhon. It will consume the forehead of MoʹabAnd the skull of the sons of tumult.’

20242.label: Jeremiah 48:46
20242.text: ‘Woe to you, O Moʹab! The people of Cheʹmosh have perished. For your sons have been taken captive,And your daughters have gone into exile.

20243.label: Jeremiah 48:47
20243.text: But I will gather the captives of Moʹab in the final part of the days,’ declares Jehovah. ‘Down to this point is the judgment on Moʹab.’”

20244.label: Jeremiah 49:1
20244.text: For the Amʹmon·ites, this is what Jehovah says: “Does Israel have no sons? Does he have no heir? Why has Malʹcam taken possession of Gad? And why are his people living in Israel’s cities?”

20245.label: Jeremiah 49:2
20245.text: “‘Therefore look! the days are coming,’ declares Jehovah,‘When I will cause the alarm signal of war to be heard against Rabʹbah of the Amʹmon·ites. She will become a desolate mound,And her dependent towns will be set on fire.’ ‘And Israel will take possession of those who dispossessed him,’ says Jehovah.

20246.label: Jeremiah 49:3
20246.text: ‘Wail, O Heshʹbon, for Aʹi has been destroyed! Cry out, O dependent towns of Rabʹbah. Put on sackcloth. Wail and rove about among the stone pens, For Malʹcam will go into exile,Together with his priests and his princes.

20247.label: Jeremiah 49:4
20247.text: Why do you brag about the valleys, About your flowing plain, O unfaithful daughter,Who trusts in her treasuresAnd who says: “Who will come against me?”’”

20248.label: Jeremiah 49:5
20248.text: “‘Here I am bringing something dreadful on you,’ declares the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies,‘From all those around you. You will be dispersed in every direction,And no one will gather those who flee.’”

20249.label: Jeremiah 49:6
20249.text: “‘But afterward I will gather the captives of the Amʹmon·ites,’ declares Jehovah.”

20250.label: Jeremiah 49:7
20250.text: For Eʹdom, this is what Jehovah of armies says: “Is there no longer any wisdom in Teʹman? Has good advice perished from those with understanding? Has their wisdom rotted?

20251.label: Jeremiah 49:8
20251.text: Flee, turn back! Go and dwell down in the depths, O inhabitants of Deʹdan! For I will bring disaster on EʹsauWhen the time comes to turn my attention to him.

20252.label: Jeremiah 49:9
20252.text: If grape gatherers came in to you,Would they not leave some behind for gleaning? If thieves came in by night,They would cause only as much ruin as they wanted.

20253.label: Jeremiah 49:10
20253.text: But I will strip Eʹsau bare. I will uncover his places of concealment,So that he cannot hide. His children and his brothers and his neighbors will all be destroyed, And he will be no more.

20254.label: Jeremiah 49:11
20254.text: Leave your fatherless children,And I will preserve them alive,And your widows will trust in me.”

20255.label: Jeremiah 49:12
20255.text: For this is what Jehovah says: “Look! If those not sentenced to drink the cup must drink it, should you be left completely unpunished? You will not be left unpunished, for you must drink it.”

20256.label: Jeremiah 49:13
20256.text: “For by myself I have sworn,” declares Jehovah, “that Bozʹrah will become an object of horror, a reproach, a devastation, and a curse; and all her cities will become perpetual ruins.”

20257.label: Jeremiah 49:14
20257.text: I have heard a report from Jehovah,An envoy has been sent among the nations, saying: “Gather yourselves together and come against her;Prepare for battle.”

20258.label: Jeremiah 49:15
20258.text: “For look! I have made you insignificant among the nations,Despised among men.

20259.label: Jeremiah 49:16
20259.text: The shuddering you caused has deceived you,The presumptuousness of your heart,O you who reside in the retreats of the crag,Occupying the highest hill. Although you build your nest high up like an eagle,I will bring you down from there,” declares Jehovah.

20260.label: Jeremiah 49:17
20260.text: “And Eʹdom must become an object of horror. Everyone passing along by her will stare in horror and whistle on account of all her plagues.

20261.label: Jeremiah 49:18
20261.text: Just as in the overthrow of Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah and of their neighboring towns,” Jehovah says, “no one will dwell there, and no man will settle there.

20262.label: Jeremiah 49:19
20262.text: “Look! Someone will come up against the secure pastures like a lion from the dense thickets along the Jordan, but in a moment I will make him run away from her. And I will appoint over her the chosen one. For who is like me, and who will challenge me? What shepherd can stand before me?

20263.label: Jeremiah 49:20
20263.text: Therefore hear, O men, the decision that Jehovah has made against Eʹdom and what he has thought out against the inhabitants of Teʹman: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged away. He will make their dwelling place desolate because of them.

20264.label: Jeremiah 49:21
20264.text: At the sound of their falling, the earth has quaked. There is an outcry! The sound has been heard as far as the Red Sea.

20265.label: Jeremiah 49:22
20265.text: Look! Just like an eagle he will ascend and swoop down, And he will spread out his wings over Bozʹrah. In that day the heart of the warriors of EʹdomWill become like the heart of a woman in childbirth.”

20266.label: Jeremiah 49:23
20266.text: For Damascus: “Haʹmath and Arʹpad have been put to shame,For they have heard a bad report. They melt in fear. There is anxiety in the sea that cannot be calmed.

20267.label: Jeremiah 49:24
20267.text: Damascus has lost courage. She has turned to flee, but panic has seized her. Distress and pain have taken hold of her,Like a woman who is giving birth.

20268.label: Jeremiah 49:25
20268.text: How is it that the city of praise has not been abandoned,The town of exultation?

20269.label: Jeremiah 49:26
20269.text: For her young men will fall in her public squares,And all the soldiers will perish in that day,” declares Jehovah of armies.

20270.label: Jeremiah 49:27
20270.text: “I will set the wall of Damascus on fire,And it will consume the fortified towers of Ben-haʹdad.”

20271.label: Jeremiah 49:28
20271.text: For Keʹdar and the kingdoms of Haʹzor, which King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon struck down, this is what Jehovah says: “Rise up, go up to Keʹdar,And destroy the sons of the East.

20272.label: Jeremiah 49:29
20272.text: Their tents and their flocks will be taken,Their tent cloths and all their goods. Their camels will be carried off,And they will cry out to them, ‘Terror is all around!’”

20273.label: Jeremiah 49:30
20273.text: “Flee, go far away! Go and dwell down in the depths, O inhabitants of Haʹzor,” declares Jehovah. “For King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon has devised a strategy against you,And he has thought out a plan against you.”

20274.label: Jeremiah 49:31
20274.text: “Rise up, go up against the nation that is at peace,Dwelling in security!” declares Jehovah. “It has no doors or bars; they live in isolation.

20275.label: Jeremiah 49:32
20275.text: Their camels will become plunder,And their abundant livestock a spoil. I will scatter them to every wind, Those who clip their hair at the temples, And I will bring their disaster from every direction,” declares Jehovah.

20276.label: Jeremiah 49:33
20276.text: “And Haʹzor will become a lair of jackals,A perpetual desolation. No one will dwell there,And no man will settle in her.”

20277.label: Jeremiah 49:34
20277.text: This is the word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Eʹlam in the beginning of the reign of King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah:

20278.label: Jeremiah 49:35
20278.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies says, ‘Here I am breaking the bow of Eʹlam, the source of their mightiness.

20279.label: Jeremiah 49:36
20279.text: I will bring in on Eʹlam the four winds from the four extremities of the heavens, and I will scatter them to all these winds. There will not be a nation to which the dispersed ones of Eʹlam will not go.’”

20280.label: Jeremiah 49:37
20280.text: “I will shatter the Eʹlam·ites before their enemies and before those seeking to take their life; and I will bring calamity on them, my burning anger,” declares Jehovah. “And I will send the sword after them until I have exterminated them.”

20281.label: Jeremiah 49:38
20281.text: “And I will set my throne in Eʹlam, and I will destroy from there the king and the princes,” declares Jehovah.

20282.label: Jeremiah 49:39
20282.text: “But in the final part of the days, I will gather the captives of Eʹlam,” declares Jehovah.

20283.label: Jeremiah 50:1
20283.text: The word that Jehovah spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chal·deʹans, through Jeremiah the prophet:

20284.label: Jeremiah 50:2
20284.text: “Declare it among the nations and proclaim it. Raise a signal and proclaim it. Do not hide anything! Say, ‘Babylon has been captured. Bel has been put to shame. Merʹo·dach has become terrified. Her images have been put to shame. Her disgusting idols have become terrified.’

20285.label: Jeremiah 50:3
20285.text: For a nation has come against her from the north. It makes her land an object of horror;No one is dwelling in her. Both man and beast have taken flight;They have gone away.”

20286.label: Jeremiah 50:4
20286.text: “In those days and at that time,” declares Jehovah, “the people of Israel and the people of Judah will come together. They will weep as they walk, and together they will seek Jehovah their God.

20287.label: Jeremiah 50:5
20287.text: They will ask the way to Zion, with their faces turned in that direction, saying, ‘Come and let us join ourselves to Jehovah in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’

20288.label: Jeremiah 50:6
20288.text: My people have become a flock of lost sheep. Their own shepherds caused them to stray. They led them away onto the mountains, roaming from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting-place.

20289.label: Jeremiah 50:7
20289.text: All those finding them have devoured them, and their enemies have said, ‘We are not guilty, because they sinned against Jehovah, against the dwelling place of righteousness and the hope of their forefathers, Jehovah.’”

20290.label: Jeremiah 50:8
20290.text: “Flee out of the midst of Babylon,Go out of the land of the Chal·deʹans, And be like the leading animals before the flock.

20291.label: Jeremiah 50:9
20291.text: For here I am raising up and bringing against BabylonAn assembly of great nations from the land of the north. They will come against her in battle formation;From there she will be captured. Their arrows are like those of a warriorCausing bereavement of children; They do not come back without results.

20292.label: Jeremiah 50:10
20292.text: Chal·deʹa will become a spoil. All those taking spoil from her will be fully satisfied,” declares Jehovah.

20293.label: Jeremiah 50:11
20293.text: “For you kept rejoicing, you kept exultingWhen pillaging my own inheritance. For you kept pawing like a heifer in the grass,And you kept neighing like stallions.

20294.label: Jeremiah 50:12
20294.text: Your mother has been put to shame. She who gave birth to you has been disappointed. Look! She is the least of the nations,A waterless wilderness and a desert.

20295.label: Jeremiah 50:13
20295.text: Because of the indignation of Jehovah she will not be inhabited; She will become utterly desolate. Anyone passing by Babylon will stare in horrorAnd whistle because of all her plagues.

20296.label: Jeremiah 50:14
20296.text: Come against Babylon in battle formation on every side,All you who are bending the bow. Shoot at her, spare no arrow, For it is against Jehovah that she has sinned.

20297.label: Jeremiah 50:15
20297.text: Shout a war cry against her on every side. She has surrendered. Her pillars have fallen, her walls are torn down, For it is the vengeance of Jehovah. Take your vengeance on her. Do to her just as she has done.

20298.label: Jeremiah 50:16
20298.text: Cut off the sower from BabylonAnd the one handling the sickle in harvesttime. Because of the cruel sword, each will return to his own people,Each one will flee to his own land.

20299.label: Jeremiah 50:17
20299.text: “The people of Israel are scattered sheep. Lions have dispersed them. First the king of As·syrʹi·a devoured them; then King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon gnawed on their bones.

20300.label: Jeremiah 50:18
20300.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Here I will deal with the king of Babylon and with his land in the same way that I dealt with the king of As·syrʹi·a.

20301.label: Jeremiah 50:19
20301.text: And I will bring Israel back to his pasture, and he will graze on Carʹmel and on Baʹshan, and on the mountains of Eʹphra·im and of Gilʹe·ad he will be satisfied.’”

20302.label: Jeremiah 50:20
20302.text: “In those days and at that time,” declares Jehovah,“Israel’s guilt will be searched for,But there will be none,And the sins of Judah will not be found,For I will forgive those whom I let remain.”

20303.label: Jeremiah 50:21
20303.text: “Go up against the land of Mer·a·thaʹim and against the inhabitants of Peʹkod. Let them be massacred and completely destroyed,” declares Jehovah. “Do all that I have commanded you.

20304.label: Jeremiah 50:22
20304.text: There is the sound of war in the land,A great catastrophe.

20305.label: Jeremiah 50:23
20305.text: How the forge hammer of all the earth has been cut down and broken! How Babylon has become an object of horror among the nations!

20306.label: Jeremiah 50:24
20306.text: I have laid a snare for you, and you have been caught, O Babylon,And you did not know it. You were found and captured, For it was Jehovah whom you opposed.

20307.label: Jeremiah 50:25
20307.text: Jehovah has opened his storehouse,And he brings out the weapons of his indignation. For the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, has a workIn the land of the Chal·deʹans.

20308.label: Jeremiah 50:26
20308.text: Come against her from distant places. Open up her granaries. Pile her up like heaps of grain. Destroy her completely. May she have no one left.

20309.label: Jeremiah 50:27
20309.text: Massacre all her young bulls; Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come,Their time of reckoning!

20310.label: Jeremiah 50:28
20310.text: There is the sound of those fleeing,Those escaping from the land of Babylon,To declare in Zion the vengeance of Jehovah our God,The vengeance for his temple.

20311.label: Jeremiah 50:29
20311.text: Summon archers against Babylon,All who are bending the bow. Camp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her according to her activity. Do to her just as she has done. For she has acted arrogantly against Jehovah,Against the Holy One of Israel.

20312.label: Jeremiah 50:30
20312.text: So her young men will fall in her public squares, And all her soldiers will perish in that day,” declares Jehovah.

20313.label: Jeremiah 50:31
20313.text: “Look! I am against you, O defiant one,” declares the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies,“For your day must come, the time that I will call you to account.

20314.label: Jeremiah 50:32
20314.text: You, O defiant one, will stumble and fall,With no one to raise you up. And I will set your cities on fire,And it will consume everything around you.”

20315.label: Jeremiah 50:33
20315.text: This is what Jehovah of armies says: “The people of Israel and Judah are oppressed,And all those taking them captive have held onto them. They have refused to let them go.

20316.label: Jeremiah 50:34
20316.text: But their Repurchaser is strong. Jehovah of armies is his name. He will surely plead their legal case, In order to give rest to the land And to bring agitation to the inhabitants of Babylon.”

20317.label: Jeremiah 50:35
20317.text: “There is a sword against the Chal·deʹans,” declares Jehovah,“Against the inhabitants of Babylon and against her princes and against her wise ones.

20318.label: Jeremiah 50:36
20318.text: There is a sword against the empty talkers, and they will act foolishly. There is a sword against her warriors, and they will become terrified.

20319.label: Jeremiah 50:37
20319.text: There is a sword against their horses and their war chariots,And against all the mixed populations in her midst,And they will become like women. There is a sword against her treasures, and they will be plundered.

20320.label: Jeremiah 50:38
20320.text: There is a devastation on her waters, and they will be dried up. For it is a land of graven images, And because of their frightful visions they keep acting with madness.

20321.label: Jeremiah 50:39
20321.text: Therefore, the desert creatures will dwell with the howling animals,And in her the ostriches will dwell. She will never again be inhabited,Nor will she be a place of residence throughout all generations.”

20322.label: Jeremiah 50:40
20322.text: “Just as with God’s overthrow of Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah and of their neighboring towns,” declares Jehovah, “no one will dwell there, and no man will settle there.

20323.label: Jeremiah 50:41
20323.text: Look! A people is coming in from the north;A great nation and grand kings will be raised upFrom the remotest parts of the earth.

20324.label: Jeremiah 50:42
20324.text: Bow and javelin they wield. They are cruel and will show no mercy. Their sound is like the roaring sea, As they ride on their horses. Like one man, they line up in battle formation against you, O daughter of Babylon.

20325.label: Jeremiah 50:43
20325.text: The king of Babylon has heard the report about them, And his hands drop down. Anguish seizes him,Pain like that of a woman giving birth.

20326.label: Jeremiah 50:44
20326.text: “Look! Someone will come up against the secure pastures like a lion from the dense thickets along the Jordan, but in a moment I will make them run away from her. And I will appoint over her the chosen one. For who is like me, and who will challenge me? What shepherd can stand before me?

20327.label: Jeremiah 50:45
20327.text: Therefore hear, O men, the decision that Jehovah has made against Babylon and what he has thought out against the land of the Chal·deʹans. Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged away. He will make their dwelling place desolate because of them.

20328.label: Jeremiah 50:46
20328.text: At the sound of Babylon’s capture, the earth will quake,And an outcry will be heard among the nations.”

20329.label: Jeremiah 51:1
20329.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Here I am raising up a destructive windAgainst Babylon and the inhabitants of Leb-kaʹmai.

20330.label: Jeremiah 51:2
20330.text: I will send winnowers to Babylon,And they will winnow her and make her land empty;They will come against her on all sides in the day of calamity.

20331.label: Jeremiah 51:3
20331.text: Let the archer not bend his bow. And let no one stand up in his coat of mail. Show no compassion for her young men. Devote all her army to destruction.

20332.label: Jeremiah 51:4
20332.text: And they will fall slain in the land of the Chal·deʹans,Pierced through in her streets.

20333.label: Jeremiah 51:5
20333.text: For Israel and Judah are not widowed from their God, from Jehovah of armies. But their land is full of guilt from the standpoint of the Holy One of Israel.

20334.label: Jeremiah 51:6
20334.text: Flee out of the midst of Babylon,And escape for your life. Do not perish because of her error. For it is the time for Jehovah’s vengeance. He is paying her back for what she has done.

20335.label: Jeremiah 51:7
20335.text: Babylon has been a golden cup in the hand of Jehovah;She made all the earth drunk. From her wine the nations have drunk; That is why the nations have gone mad.

20336.label: Jeremiah 51:8
20336.text: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and is broken. Wail over her! Get balsam for her pain; perhaps she may be healed.”

20337.label: Jeremiah 51:9
20337.text: “We tried to heal Babylon, but she could not be healed. Leave her and let us go, each to his own land. For her judgment has reached to the heavens;It is as high as the clouds.

20338.label: Jeremiah 51:10
20338.text: Jehovah has brought about justice for us. Come, let us recount in Zion the work of Jehovah our God.”

20339.label: Jeremiah 51:11
20339.text: “Polish the arrows; take up the circular shields. Jehovah has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, Because he intends to bring Babylon to ruin. For this is the vengeance of Jehovah, the vengeance for his temple.

20340.label: Jeremiah 51:12
20340.text: Lift up a signal against the walls of Babylon. Strengthen the guard, post the watchmen. Prepare those in ambush. For Jehovah has devised the strategy,And he will carry out what he has promised against the inhabitants of Babylon.”

20341.label: Jeremiah 51:13
20341.text: “O woman who resides on many waters, With abundant treasures, Your end has come, the limit of your profit-making.

20342.label: Jeremiah 51:14
20342.text: Jehovah of armies has sworn by himself, ‘I will fill you with men, as numerous as locusts,And they will shout in triumph over you.’

20343.label: Jeremiah 51:15
20343.text: He is the Maker of the earth by his power,The One who established the productive land by his wisdom And who stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

20344.label: Jeremiah 51:16
20344.text: When he makes his voice heard,The waters in the heavens are in turmoil,And he causes clouds to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain,And he brings the wind out of his storehouses.

20345.label: Jeremiah 51:17
20345.text: Every man acts unreasonably and without knowledge. Every metalworker will be put to shame because of the carved image; For his metal image is a falsehood,And there is no spirit in them.

20346.label: Jeremiah 51:18
20346.text: They are a delusion, a work of mockery. When their day of reckoning comes, they will perish.

20347.label: Jeremiah 51:19
20347.text: The Share of Jacob is not like these things,For he is the One who formed everything,Even the staff of his inheritance. Jehovah of armies is his name.”

20348.label: Jeremiah 51:20
20348.text: “You are a war club for me, a weapon for battle,For with you I will smash nations. With you I will bring kingdoms to ruin.

20349.label: Jeremiah 51:21
20349.text: With you I will smash the horse and its rider. With you I will smash the war chariot and its rider.

20350.label: Jeremiah 51:22
20350.text: With you I will smash man and woman. With you I will smash old man and boy. With you I will smash young man and woman.

20351.label: Jeremiah 51:23
20351.text: With you I will smash shepherd and his flock. With you I will smash farmer and his team of animals. With you I will smash governors and deputy rulers.

20352.label: Jeremiah 51:24
20352.text: And I will repay Babylon and all the inhabitants of Chal·deʹaFor all the evil that they have committed in Zion before your eyes,” declares Jehovah.

20353.label: Jeremiah 51:25
20353.text: “Here I am against you, O destructive mountain,” declares Jehovah,“You destroyer of the whole earth. I will stretch out my hand against you and roll you down from the cragsAnd make you a burned-out mountain.”

20354.label: Jeremiah 51:26
20354.text: “People will not take from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone,Because you will become desolate forever,” declares Jehovah.

20355.label: Jeremiah 51:27
20355.text: “Lift up a signal in the land. Blow a horn among the nations. Appoint the nations against her. Summon against her the kingdoms of Arʹa·rat, Minʹni, and Ashʹke·naz. Commission against her a recruiting officer. Make the horses come up like bristling locusts.

20356.label: Jeremiah 51:28
20356.text: Appoint against her the nations,The kings of Meʹdi·a, its governors and all its deputy rulersAnd all the lands they rule over.

20357.label: Jeremiah 51:29
20357.text: And the earth will quake and tremble,For the thoughts of Jehovah against Babylon will be carried outTo make the land of Babylon an object of horror, without an inhabitant.

20358.label: Jeremiah 51:30
20358.text: The warriors of Babylon have quit fighting. They sit in their strongholds. Their strength has failed. They have become like women. Her homes have been set on fire. Her bars have been broken.

20359.label: Jeremiah 51:31
20359.text: One courier runs to meet another courier,And one messenger to meet another messenger,To report to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured on every side,

20360.label: Jeremiah 51:32
20360.text: That the fords have been seized, That the papyrus boats have been burned with fire,And that the soldiers are terrified.”

20361.label: Jeremiah 51:33
20361.text: For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor. It is the time to tread her down solid. Very soon the time of the harvest will come for her.”

20362.label: Jeremiah 51:34
20362.text: “King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon has devoured me; He has thrown me into confusion. He has set me down as an empty vessel. He has swallowed me down like a big snake; He has filled his stomach with my fine things. He has rinsed me away.

20363.label: Jeremiah 51:35
20363.text: ‘May the violence done to me and to my person come upon Babylon!’ says the inhabitant of Zion. ‘And let my blood come upon the inhabitants of Chal·deʹa!’ says Jerusalem.”

20364.label: Jeremiah 51:36
20364.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah says: “Here I am pleading your legal case, And I will execute vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea and make her wells dry.

20365.label: Jeremiah 51:37
20365.text: And Babylon will become piles of stones, A lair of jackals, An object of horror and something to whistle at,Without an inhabitant.

20366.label: Jeremiah 51:38
20366.text: All together they will roar just like young lions. They will growl like lion cubs.”

20367.label: Jeremiah 51:39
20367.text: “When they are inflamed, I will set out their banquet and make them drunk,In order that they may exult; Then they will sleep a lasting sleep,From which they will not wake up,” declares Jehovah.

20368.label: Jeremiah 51:40
20368.text: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter,Like rams along with the goats.”

20369.label: Jeremiah 51:41
20369.text: “O how Sheʹshach has been captured, How the Praise of the whole earth has been seized! How Babylon has become an object of horror among the nations!

20370.label: Jeremiah 51:42
20370.text: The sea has come up over Babylon. By the multitude of its waves she has been covered.

20371.label: Jeremiah 51:43
20371.text: Her cities have become an object of horror, a waterless land and a desert. A land where no one will live and where no man will pass through.

20372.label: Jeremiah 51:44
20372.text: I will turn my attention to Bel in Babylon,And I will take out of his mouth what he has swallowed. To him nations will stream no more,And the wall of Babylon will fall.

20373.label: Jeremiah 51:45
20373.text: Get out of her midst, my people! Escape for your lives from the burning anger of Jehovah!

20374.label: Jeremiah 51:46
20374.text: Do not be fainthearted or afraid about the report to be heard in the land. In one year the report will come,And the next year another report,Of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.

20375.label: Jeremiah 51:47
20375.text: Therefore look! the days are comingWhen I will turn my attention to the graven images of Babylon. All her land will be put to shame,And all her slain will fall in her midst.

20376.label: Jeremiah 51:48
20376.text: The heavens and the earth and everything in themWill shout joyfully over Babylon, For the destroyers will come to her out of the north,” declares Jehovah.

20377.label: Jeremiah 51:49
20377.text: “Not only did Babylon cause the slain of Israel to fall But also at Babylon the slain ones of all the earth have fallen.

20378.label: Jeremiah 51:50
20378.text: You who escape the sword, keep going, do not stand still! Remember Jehovah from far away,And may Jerusalem come up into your heart.”

20379.label: Jeremiah 51:51
20379.text: “We have been put to shame, for we have heard taunts. Humiliation has covered our faces,For foreigners have come against the holy places of the house of Jehovah.”

20380.label: Jeremiah 51:52
20380.text: “Therefore look! the days are coming,” declares Jehovah,“When I will turn my attention to her graven images,And throughout all her land the wounded will groan.”

20381.label: Jeremiah 51:53
20381.text: “Even if Babylon should ascend to the heavens, Even if she should fortify her towering strongholds,From me her destroyers will come,” declares Jehovah.

20382.label: Jeremiah 51:54
20382.text: “Listen! There is an outcry from Babylon, The sound of great disaster from the land of the Chal·deʹans,

20383.label: Jeremiah 51:55
20383.text: For Jehovah is destroying Babylon,He will silence her great voice,And their waves will roar like many waters. The sound of their voice will be heard.

20384.label: Jeremiah 51:56
20384.text: For the destroyer will come upon Babylon; Her warriors will be captured, Their bows will be shattered,For Jehovah is a God of retribution. He will surely repay.

20385.label: Jeremiah 51:57
20385.text: I will make her princes and her wise men drunk, Her governors and her deputy rulers and her warriors,And they will sleep a lasting sleep,From which they will not wake up,” declares the King, whose name is Jehovah of armies.

20386.label: Jeremiah 51:58
20386.text: This is what Jehovah of armies says: “The wall of Babylon, though broad, will be completely demolished, And her gates, though high, will be set on fire. The peoples will toil for nothing;The nations will weary themselves just to feed the fire.”

20387.label: Jeremiah 51:59
20387.text: This is the word that Jeremiah the prophet gave as a command to Se·raiʹah son of Ne·riʹah son of Mah·seiʹah when he went with King Zed·e·kiʹah of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign; Se·raiʹah was the quartermaster.

20388.label: Jeremiah 51:60
20388.text: Jeremiah wrote in one book all the calamity that would come upon Babylon, all these words written against Babylon.

20389.label: Jeremiah 51:61
20389.text: Furthermore, Jeremiah said to Se·raiʹah: “When you come to Babylon and see her, you must read aloud all these words.

20390.label: Jeremiah 51:62
20390.text: Then say, ‘O Jehovah, you have said against this place that it will be destroyed and left without an inhabitant, man or beast, and that she will become desolate forever.’

20391.label: Jeremiah 51:63
20391.text: And when you finish reading this book, tie a stone to it and throw it into the middle of the Eu·phraʹtes.

20392.label: Jeremiah 51:64
20392.text: Then say, ‘This is how Babylon will sink down and never rise again because of the calamity that I am bringing on her; and they will grow weary.’” Down to this point are the words of Jeremiah.

20393.label: Jeremiah 52:1
20393.text: Zed·e·kiʹah was 21 years old when he became king, and he reigned for 11 years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Ha·muʹtal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libʹnah.

20394.label: Jeremiah 52:2
20394.text: He continued to do what was bad in Jehovah’s eyes, according to all that Je·hoiʹa·kim had done.

20395.label: Jeremiah 52:3
20395.text: It was because of Jehovah’s anger that these things took place in Jerusalem and in Judah, until he cast them out of his sight. And Zed·e·kiʹah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

20396.label: Jeremiah 52:4
20396.text: In the ninth year of Zed·e·kiʹah’s reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar of Babylon came with all his army against Jerusalem. They camped against it and built a siege wall all around it.

20397.label: Jeremiah 52:5
20397.text: And the city was under siege until the 11th year of King Zed·e·kiʹah.

20398.label: Jeremiah 52:6
20398.text: In the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, and there was no food for the people of the land.

20399.label: Jeremiah 52:7
20399.text: Finally the city wall was broken through, and all the soldiers fled from the city by night through the gate between the double wall near the king’s garden, while the Chal·deʹans were surrounding the city; and they continued by the way of the Arʹa·bah.

20400.label: Jeremiah 52:8
20400.text: But the Chal·deʹan army pursued the king, and they overtook Zed·e·kiʹah in the desert plains of Jerʹi·cho, and all his troops were scattered from his side.

20401.label: Jeremiah 52:9
20401.text: Then they seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Ribʹlah in the land of Haʹmath, and he passed sentence on him.

20402.label: Jeremiah 52:10
20402.text: And the king of Babylon slaughtered Zed·e·kiʹah’s sons before his eyes, and he also slaughtered all the princes of Judah there at Ribʹlah.

20403.label: Jeremiah 52:11
20403.text: Then the king of Babylon blinded Zed·e·kiʹah’s eyes, bound him with copper fetters, brought him to Babylon, and kept him imprisoned until the day of his death.

20404.label: Jeremiah 52:12
20404.text: In the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, that is, in the 19th year of King Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar the king of Babylon, Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard, who was an attendant of the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

20405.label: Jeremiah 52:13
20405.text: He burned down the house of Jehovah, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem; he also burned down every large house.

20406.label: Jeremiah 52:14
20406.text: And the walls surrounding Jerusalem were pulled down by the entire Chal·deʹan army that was with the chief of the guard.

20407.label: Jeremiah 52:15
20407.text: Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard took into exile some of the lowly people and the rest of the people who were left in the city. He also took the deserters who had defected to the king of Babylon as well as the rest of the master craftsmen.

20408.label: Jeremiah 52:16
20408.text: But Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard left some of the poorest people of the land to serve as vinedressers and as compulsory laborers.

20409.label: Jeremiah 52:17
20409.text: And the Chal·deʹans broke into pieces the copper pillars of the house of Jehovah and the carriages and the copper Sea that were in the house of Jehovah, and they carried all the copper away to Babylon.

20410.label: Jeremiah 52:18
20410.text: They also took the cans, the shovels, the extinguishers, the bowls, the cups, and all the copper utensils used in the temple service.

20411.label: Jeremiah 52:19
20411.text: The chief of the guard took the basins, the fire holders, the bowls, the cans, the lampstands, the cups, and the bowls that were of genuine gold and silver.

20412.label: Jeremiah 52:20
20412.text: As for the two pillars, the Sea, the 12 copper bulls under the Sea, and the carriages that King Solʹo·mon had made for the house of Jehovah, the copper of all these articles was beyond weighing.

20413.label: Jeremiah 52:21
20413.text: As for the pillars, each pillar was 18 cubits high, a measuring cord of 12 cubits could encircle it; its thickness was four fingerbreadths, and it was hollow.

20414.label: Jeremiah 52:22
20414.text: And the capital on it was of copper; and the height of the one capital was five cubits; and the network and pomegranates all around on the capital were all made of copper. The second pillar was just like it, also the pomegranates.

20415.label: Jeremiah 52:23
20415.text: There were 96 pomegranates on the sides; in all, there were 100 pomegranates around the network.

20416.label: Jeremiah 52:24
20416.text: The chief of the guard also took Se·raiʹah the chief priest, Zeph·a·niʹah the second priest, and the three doorkeepers.

20417.label: Jeremiah 52:25
20417.text: And he took from the city one court official who was the commissioner over the soldiers, seven close associates of the king who were found in the city, as well as the secretary of the chief of the army, the one mustering the people of the land, and 60 men of the common people of the land who were yet found in the city.

20418.label: Jeremiah 52:26
20418.text: Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Ribʹlah.

20419.label: Jeremiah 52:27
20419.text: The king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death at Ribʹlah in the land of Haʹmath. Thus Judah went into exile from its land.

20420.label: Jeremiah 52:28
20420.text: These are the people whom Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar took into exile: in the seventh year, 3,023 Jews.

20421.label: Jeremiah 52:29
20421.text: In the 18th year of Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar, 832 people were taken from Jerusalem.

20422.label: Jeremiah 52:30
20422.text: In the 23rd year of Neb·u·chad·nezʹzar, Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the guard took Jews into exile, 745 people. In all, 4,600 people were taken into exile.

20423.label: Jeremiah 52:31
20423.text: Then in the 37th year of the exile of King Je·hoiʹa·chin of Judah, in the 12th month, on the 25th day of the month, King Eʹvil-merʹo·dach of Babylon, in the year he became king, released King Je·hoiʹa·chin of Judah and brought him out of prison.

20424.label: Jeremiah 52:32
20424.text: He spoke kindly with him and put his throne higher than the thrones of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

20425.label: Jeremiah 52:33
20425.text: So Je·hoiʹa·chin took off his prison garments, and he regularly ate before him all the days of his life.

20426.label: Jeremiah 52:34
20426.text: A regular allowance of food was given him from the king of Babylon, day after day, until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
